agencyDescription:
The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA), a statutory board under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers.   

Guided by our vision of a Singapore where everyone can grow in fulfilling careers, we live our promise of Building Skills, Growing Careers by nurturing lifelong learning, strengthening employability and enabling career growth for all, including our own officers, through a continuous learning culture and a supportive, flexible, inclusive working environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and well-being.

So, join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the national SkillsFuture movement and building a strong Singaporean core. Together, we create opportunities, transform lives, and shape the future of work.
jobDescription: Incentives Management Division (IMD) is part of SWDA’s Incentives Management and Enforcement Group (IMEG) which contributes to pan-organisational efforts of building an effective, responsive, and inclusive CET eco-system through effective grant management, Skills Development Levy (SDL) collection, and enforcement against fraud and abuse. IMD administers Training Grants, Training Allowance and SkillsFuture Credits (Enterprise and Individual) to contribute towards the development of a responsive and high-quality CET ecosystem.
jobResponsibilities:
As a Senior Manager / Principal Manager, the successful candidate will be part of a team which manages and administers SWDA’s SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance under the SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme and Workfare Skills Support (WSS) (Level-Up) Programme.

You will be responsible for reviewing and developing business processes to support incentive programmes, augment operational efficiency and improve service delivery in the administration of Training Allowance.

Responsibilities and Competencies:

  • Stakeholder Engagement and Operations Management

    • Engage with learners, Training Providers and other stakeholders to support and manage escalated appeals and queries on verification of training allowance to ensure smooth operation in incentives administration, while ensuring compliance to grant governance framework.

    • Identify areas of risks, devise mitigating measures, and establish control measures to ensure operations align with intended policy parameters.

    • Support periodic audits by internal and external auditors.

    • Assist in the management of the outsourced service partner.

  • Process Design and Implementation

    • Design, develop and streamline operational processes for administration of Training Allowance.

    • Coordinate with business technology to implement system enhancements and support system development projects.

    • Review workflows, develop SOPs and guidelines in alignment with funding policy implementation plans.

    • Build and continuously strengthen processes and operational policies to achieve high service standards.

  • Data Management and Analysis

    • Work on datasets to perform data extraction, collation, tracking and analysis.

    • Draw insights from data analysis to facilitate administration of Training Allowance, risk management and process re-design.

    • Collate data and statistics and prepare information for reporting
jobRequirements:
You should have a customer service mindset and be committed in resolving customers’ escalated appeals and queries. In addition, you should be detailed oriented and possess the below competencies required for operations management.

  • Proficient in executing job duties with required competencies.

  • Senior Manager: At least 6 years of relevant work experience in incentives management, grant operations, or project management. This is an individual contributor role.

  • Principal Manager: At least 7 years of relevant work experience in incentives management, grant operations or project management. This role requires supervisory experience.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Self-starter who works well independently within team and across teams.

  • Detailed focused with strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Good interpersonal relationship skills and adaptability to a fast-paced work environment.

  • Able to multi-task, work independently and perform well under pressure and tight timelines.

  • Strong in analysis, verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

  • Proficient in word processing, spreadsheet (Excel) and presentation applications.

  • Knowledge in grant administration, SWDA’s Continuous Education Training (CET) grants and relevant industry experience are advantageous.

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP

jobDescription:
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our Gen AI team and develop next-generation applications powered by advanced AI technologies. This role focuses on hands-on implementation of AI-driven applications using cutting-edge AI frameworks that support MAS’ role in the Singapore's financial sector, whilst ensuring robust governance and operational excellence.

As a Software Engineer, you will implement and build production-grade web applications that leverage large language models and agentic AI systems. You will work with modern AI frameworks to develop user-facing applications that enhance productivity for AI developers, data scientists, and end users across MAS.
jobResponsibilities:
Agentic Web Application Development

Implement robust, scalable applications that enable autonomous AI agents using AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) for complex multi-step reasoning and decision-making workflows. Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces that allow users to interact with, monitor, and control AI agents performing complex tasks and workflows.

Search & Retrieval Development

Implement web services and APIs that enable efficient search and retrieval of information from large-scale data repositories (e.g. Elastic / Redis) using hybrid search capabilities. Build data ingestion pipelines and vector indexing workflows that support real-time query processing and document retrieval. Develop robust error handling and fallback mechanisms for search service integration, including query reformulation and result ranking optimisation.

User Interface & Experience Implementation
Build intuitive web interfaces that enable MAS officers to interact with complex AI systems with lower learning curve. Implement dashboards, configuration panels, and monitoring interfaces that provide clear visibility into AI application performance and behaviour.

Performance Optimisation & Scalability
Implement performance optimisations for web applications handling AI workloads. Build caching mechanisms, request queuing systems, and load balancing solutions that ensure responsive user experiences even under heavy AI processing loads.

Security & Compliance Implementation
Implement security measures including authentication, authorisation, and data protection within web applications. Ensure all developments adhere to MAS operational controls and regulatory standards through proper implementation of security features and audit logging.
jobRequirements:
• Minimum 3-5 years experience as a full stack developer, with proven track record in the production of enterprise-grade applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.

  • Strong proficiency in Python web frameworks (FastAPI, Django) and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, or Angular) and responsive web design

  • Hands-on experience with RESTful API development and integration

  • Knowledge of database integration (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and ORM frameworks

AI Framework Implementation

  • Practical experience with AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) for building AI agent workflows and state management

  • Hands-on experience with self-hosted inference services vLLM for LLM interactions and parsing

  • Practical knowledge of LLM API integration and prompt engineering

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

This is a 1-year contract position. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

•	Experience with SB-FRS/FRS 116 lease accounting and capital grant management will be an added advantage.

jobDescription:
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore's central bank and integrated financial regulator. MEPS+ (Central Banking & Devt Platforms Division) is responsible for the MAS Electronic Payment System — a mission-critical system supporting interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructure. MEPS+ serves the entire Singapore financial sector and requires 24/7 operational reliability, strict compliance with government regulatory frameworks, and close coordination with financial institutions and government agencies.

As System Manager, you are the operational and delivery owner for MEPS+ and related systems. You own the outcomes, and coordinate across software engineers, product owners, compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure system reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful delivery of enhancements and patches.
jobResponsibilities:
Operational Delivery & Application Portfolio Management

  • Own operational delivery outcomes for the MEPS+ application portfolio across interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructures. Make and recommend strategic decisions on application rationalisation, consolidation, or decommissioning to optimise portfolio efficiency.

  • Coordinate release management and delivery cycles with product owners, ensuring timely and quality deployment of enhancements, patches, and security updates across major (semi-annual) and monthly patch cycles.

  • Own Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for applications under management. Review SLI and SLO performance reports produced by the SRE team, identify trends and deviations, and escalate or drive remediation as appropriate. Set requirements for monitoring coverage and alert quality; hold the SRE team accountable for outcomes.

  • Coordinate verification of monthly and quarterly system patching with the SRE team. Ensure patch outcomes are documented and meet compliance requirements.

Tech Delivery Manager Responsibilities (During Release Cycles)

  • Lead release planning and delivery activities during major enhancement releases (semi-annual). Coordinate with product owners, development teams, testing teams, and vendors to establish release scope, timelines, and deployment readiness criteria.

  • Manage release communication to all stakeholders. Provide status updates, escalate blockers, and maintain stakeholder alignment on release objectives and timelines throughout the cycle.

  • Own release governance and quality standards for MEPS+. Define the release readiness criteria and test governance framework that the Software Engineer executes against. Review and sign off on test outcomes, patch verification results, and release readiness reports before production deployment.

Incident Management

  • Own the incident management framework for MEPS+. Define and maintain incident escalation paths, SLO targets (P1, P2, P3), and communication protocols. During major incidents, lead stakeholder communication and coordinate the response — software engineers provide technical investigation and resolution support.

  • Drive root cause analysis and post-mortems following significant incidents. Own the documentation of lessons learned and track implementation of preventive measures to reduce recurrence.

Vendor Coordination & Procurement

  • Own vendor governance for outsourced components and services. Chair vendor performance reviews, monitor SLA compliance, and make escalation decisions when vendor performance falls short. Coordinate with software engineers for detailed technical review of vendor-delivered code and fixes.

  • Lead MAS's participation in procurement activities for outsourced services, including defining tender specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, and contributing to contract negotiations.

Compliance, Governance & Risk Management

  • Coordinate RFI responses across the team, ensuring accurate and timely submission of supporting documentation.

  • Plan and lead resiliency exercises including Disaster Recovery drills, manual contingency procedures, and CyberEx participation. Validate system failover and recovery capabilities. Maintain compliance with ICT Governance policies and standards specific to government financial infrastructure.
jobRequirements:
Essential Criteria

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in managing, operating, or delivering complex mission-critical systems. Minimum 3–4 years in a delivery management, operations management, or technical programme management role with clear accountability for system reliability or release outcomes. Experience with payment systems, securities settlement, or financial infrastructure is advantageous but not required.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead incident response at an organisational level — owning stakeholder communication, driving post-mortems, and implementing systemic improvements. Track record of managing high-stakes operational environments.

  • Proven experience managing vendor relationships, chairing performance reviews, and holding vendors accountable to SLAs. Experience contributing to procurement or contract management activities.

  • Strong experience coordinating release cycles across multiple teams — development, testing, operations, and compliance — with accountability for release readiness decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical risks, operational decisions, and compliance requirements clearly to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and regulators. Strong written communication for incident reports, post-mortems, audit RFI responses, and governance documentation.

  • Comfortable working across technical domains without requiring deep hands-on expertise in every platform. Able to engage credibly with software engineers and SRE colleagues, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions based on their input.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams — incident response, release coordination, compliance activities, vendor management — without losing attention to detail or governance rigour.

Desirable Criteria

  • Familiarity with Java/J2EE application environments, Linux/RHEL systems, or SQL — sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and understand technical risk, without necessarily being a hands-on practitioner.

  • Experience with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) or cloud platforms (OpenShift, OpenStack) at a conceptual or governance level.

  • Experience with CICD pipelines, release automation, and test management frameworks.

  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. Grafana, ELK stack) from an operational governance perspective.

  • Familiarity with government IT environments and regulatory compliance frameworks (CCoP, CSP, AGO, IM8).

  • Agile delivery experience and comfort collaborating with product teams and development teams.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. ITIL, PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent).

jobDescription:
You will be part of the Law Editing and Revision Unit in the Legislation Division of the Attorney-General’s Chambers, and will be responsible for providing —
 
•	editorial services for the drafting of legislation, including checking of house-styles, formatting and language checks, fact checking, conducting policy and legal research, and legal checks, establishing and maintaining standard provisions, to ensure consistency and quality control across the Singapore Statute Book,
 
•	simple legislative drafting and legislative advisory services to the Government and statutory authorities, and
 
•	support in preparing revised editions for both Acts and subsidiary legislation.
 
This role also involves organising the timely and efficient proofing of Bills, subsidiary legislation and revised editions, coordinating and liaising between Government Ministries and statutory authorities, the law drafters, editors and publishers within the Division, Parliament Secretariat and the Government Printer to ensure timely and accurate publication in the Gazette and synchronised publication on the online legislation database.
jobResponsibilities:
Your main job responsibilities as an editor include:
 
1.	Providing legislative editorial services and drafting assistance to law drafters, including making editorial amendments for grammar, punctuation, spelling, consistency and compliance with house-styles and drafting directives, as well as simplifying the language of draft legislation, to ensure that legislation to be presented to Parliament or enacted by publication in the Gazette are accurate and error free.
 
2.	Providing advisory services to Government Ministries and statutory authorities on Parliamentary procedures and practices, less complex legal issues and established legislative procedures and processes, publication processes, and drafting approaches.
 
3.	Drafting and vetting less complex subsidiary legislation and Gazette notifications in accordance with the policies of Government Ministries and statutory authorities and in compliance with house-styles and drafting directives, and established precedents.
 
4.	Preparing accurate and error-free revised editions of Acts and subsidiary legislation for publication, including editing to simplify the language (with no change in meaning) and in a way that is consistent with house-styles and drafting directives.
 
5.	Conducting simple legal research.
 
6.	Developing a working knowledge of legislation, legislative processes, house-styles, drafting directives, editing and publishing software, and publication processes, in order to draft, edit and produce high quality work in a short time frame.
 
7.	Proofreading, and performing editorial and stylistic checks of legislation and revised edition proofs before dispatch to Government Ministries and statutory authorities, and before publication.
 
8.	Planning publication schedules for legislation and revised edition projects, including working out resource allocations, timelines and budget (if any).
 
9.	Drafting and vetting minutes of meetings and policy papers for decision/approval.
 
Additionally, you will also be required, from time to time, to provide administrative and legal support services to the Division by undertaking a wide range of administrative projects, committee work and activities to ensure the efficient operation of the Division’s activities and workplan.
jobRequirements:
Requirements:
 
1.	Preferably at least 2 years of relevant working experience, such as experience in editing. Fresh school leavers may also apply.
 
2.	Excellent command of the English language.
 
3.	Meticulous, thorough and with an eye for detail.
 
4.	Strong analytical, critical thinking and editorial and proofreading skills.
 
5.	Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
 
6.	High level of initiative and self-motivated with an inquisitive mind.
 
7.	Good organisational skills, project management skills and problem-solving skills.
 
8.	A team player who is able to work independently as well as in a team.
 
9.	Ability to learn and apply, multi-task, plan and organise work effectively ensuring deadlines are adhered to is key and critical.
 
10.	Ability to work under pressure and overtime at short notice when required (flexibility).
 
11.	Good technical aptitude for computer applications (Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat and web-based applications).
 
12.	Interest in advanced and emerging technologies will be an advantage.

bonuses and annual increments based on merit. We invest in our officers and support their career aspirations so that they

jobTitle: Assistant Manager/Manager, Brand & Content, Singapore Global Network
agencyDescription: EDB is the lead government agency responsible for planning & executing strategies to enhance Singapore's position as a global business centre and grow the Singapore Economy. We dream, design and deliver solutions that create value for investors and companies in Singapore. Through that, we attract economic opportunities and jobs for the people of Singapore and help shape our country's economic future.
jobDescription:
About Singapore Global Network

Singapore Global Network (SGN) is a division under EDB that grows and engages a 220,000-strong international community of overseas Singaporeans and friends of Singapore. Our mission is to grow Singapore’s global networks by fostering meaningful relationships and communities among international talent, entrepreneurs, students and partners worldwide, while strengthening Singapore’s position as the ideal place to work, live and play.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of SGN’s Brand & Content team, supporting the development and execution of brand and content marketing initiatives that promote SGN as an international networking community among target audience segments, and building a positive experience with members. This includes building the SGN brand experience, growing its digital channel following, promoting its product offerings, generating new members for the network, and engaging audiences through a mix of online and offline initiatives.

You will also help shape global perceptions of Singapore as an ideal city for international talent to live, work and play in. This includes promoting the many aspects of Singapore’s culture, people and environment. Using compelling storytelling techniques, you will creatively convey Singapore value propositions in a way that gets target audiences excited about the prospects and opportunities that Singapore has to offer.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating, experimenting, and collaborating — from shaping creative campaign ideas to producing inspiring content and supporting delivery across digital channels. You will work closely with internal teams, marketing agencies and brand partners to shape how Singapore is represented to global audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Brand & Campaign Management

  • Drive the ideation, development and execution of brand initiatives and marketing campaigns aimed at growing SGN’s digital following, network membership and brand experience.

  • Work with marketing agencies to develop and execute campaigns across online and offline channels.

  • Serve as the custodian of the SGN brand, responsible for reviewing the effectiveness of existing brand toolkit and proposing recommendations that help foster a stronger brand identity and affinity among audiences.

  • Identify brand partners for collaboration to enhance SGN’s value offerings to members.

Content Development & Marketing

  • Shape the content strategy for SGN and drive content development across channels, markets and audience segments.

  • Contribute content ideas and create engaging content across formats that include but are not limited to short-form videos, human-interest stories, explainer videos, editorial content, event coverage, and guides.

  • This includes working with content agencies, media publishers and partners to develop content initiatives and partnerships.

  • Collaborate with product and regional teams to drive content and campaigns aimed at promoting opportunities in Singapore among global talent and entrepreneurs.

  • Identify relevant content creators and key opinion leaders to collaborate on content and campaigns.

Measurement & Optimisation

  • Measure and report on brand, campaign and content-related performance using marketing analytics and social listening tools.

  • Help translate data and insights into learnings and recommendations for improving future campaigns and content.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for a digital native with a fun personality. Someone who is creative, energetic and with a good sense of humour, to bring out the best that Singapore and SGN has to offer.


You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 1–3 years of experience (or equivalent internships/projects) in digital marketing, content, communications, or social media. Agency and/or media production house experience is welcome but not mandatory.

  • Are a strategic thinker with hands-on experience planning and executing digital marketing campaigns, developing engaging content, and managing social media channels.

  • Enjoy creative storytelling and creating content, especially for social and digital platforms.

  • Are comfortable experimenting with short-form content and open to being behind or in front of the camera when needed (but not required to be an on-screen personality).

  • Have strong writing skills and an eye for attention to detail, from crafting captions to polishing longer-form content.

  • Are familiar with social platforms and trends, and curious about how audiences engage with content.

  • Possess basic experience with tools such as video editing apps (e.g. CapCut), analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics), or social listening tools — or are keen to learn.

  • An independent and self-motivated individual who takes ownership of deliverables and is committed to excellence in execution, as well as adept at managing priorities, timelines and achieving targets.

  • Enjoy working collaboratively in a team environment and contributing ideas and are open to feedback, learning, and developing new skills over time.

  • Are a Singapore Citizen.

We aim to ensure a reliable and secure energy supply, promote effective competition in the energy market and develop a dynamic energy sector in Singapore.

At EMA, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous learning and employee well-being. Joining us means embarking on a meaningful career where you will be part of a transformative journey towards a clean energy future, experiencing a unique adventure of discovery and growth.

jobDescription:

As we work towards net-zero goals and navigate the evolving energy landscape, we remain committed to Powering the Impossible by strengthening regional energy connections, accelerating clean energy adoption, and ensuring a resilient and reliable power system for all.

If you are looking to help shape a brighter future for Singaporeans and make a meaningful impact on our energy landscape, we invite you to join us today.
jobResponsibilities:
As part of the External Relations Department, you will work with a team to drive Singapore’s international energy engagements and cooperation. You will collaborate with governments, industry, and international partners to shape and deliver outcomes beyond Singapore. Your work will help chart the future of our energy systems and in translating ambition into action.

Within this department sits our International Relations Branch, and we are looking for a team member to play a central role in:

  • Driving bilateral engagements with international partners to advance Singapore's "Four Switches"
  • Representing Singapore at ASEAN and other high-level multilateral forums
  • Building and sustaining high-impact strategic dialogues with international counterparts and organisations such as IEA and IRENA
  • Driving landmark regional interconnectivity initiatives such as the Lao PDR–Thailand–Malaysia–Singapore Power Integration Project (LTMS-PIP), the ASEAN Power Grid, ASEAN REC Framework, and other regional initiatives.
jobRequirements:
• You are energised by the opportunity to contribute to Singapore’s energy future through international engagements.
  • You possess strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently and are comfortable engaging stakeholders across different cultural and institutional settings.
  • You are organised, collaborative, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • You are a strong team player who builds trusted relationships and works effectively across agencies, industries, and with international counterparts.

Preferred Qualifications

You are someone who:

  • Has an education in Law, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Political Science or other related disciplines
  • Has relevant experience in international relations, public policy, external engagement, or the energy sector; experience with regional or multilateral issues is an advantage.
  • Has a strong understanding of energy policy and global trends.
  • Project management experience and proficiency in other languages are advantageous.
  • Is prepared to travel overseas for work when required.

jobDescription:
Are you ready to build next-generation, sustainable cold chain logistics for life-saving biopharmaceuticals?

Republic Polytechnic's School of Engineering (SEG), in strategic partnership with industry leader SSW Group, is seeking an ambitious full-time Research Staff (12-month contract) to engineer an industrial-scale 1"m" ^3 self-sustained passive cold storage platform under a DGF-funded initiative.

Current biopharmaceutical distribution relies on massive active energy inputs and heavy daily coolant consumption. This project completely disrupts that model by building a zero-power-in-transit, high-performance thermal container (1"m"×1"m"×1"m" ) capable of locking in sub-zero temperatures (2–8°C) for over 72 continuous hours in harsh tropical environments.

Beyond standard transport, this passive design provides critical fail-safe protection against warehouse power outages and opens up new pathways for long-haul air and sea freight to distant international markets without relying on active electrical refrigeration networks.

You will lead the hands-on engineering across two breakthrough technological pillars:
- Active-Passive "Flash-Charging" Cryogenic System: A rapid-charging base station interface utilizing specialized heat exchangers and Liquid Nitrogen (LN_2) bursts to charge high-density Phase Change Material (PCM) cores and Vacuum Insulated Panels (VIP).
- Triple-Vector IoT Telemetry Engine: An ultra-low-power, cloud-connected sensor matrix tracking real-time Temperature, Relative Humidity, and Oxygen (O_2) levels to ensure absolute data transparency and regulatory compliance (HSA/FDA standards).

The successful candidate will contribute to prototype development, laboratory research, system integration, cold box temperature analysis, field validation at mimic cold storage environment, and technology commercialisation.
jobResponsibilities:
- Perform 3D CAD modelling, understand basic fluid dynamics, and heat exchanger design to eliminate thermal dead zones and maximize LN_2 thermodynamic efficiency across a 1"m" ^3 volume.
- Design, route, and balance high-pressure LN_2 cryogenic pipelines, vacuum-jacketed tubings, manifolds, and automated valve safety systems.
- Build IOT, test, and integrate low-power microcontrollers and sensor arrays (Temp,RH,O_2) with live, cloud-based telemetry dashboards.
- Perform laboratory experiments, cold storage environment trials, temperature and humidity monitoring, passive cold storage box testing, and data analysis.
- Develop, integrate, and evaluate prototype systems, sensors, and instrumentation.
- Collaborate with industry partners to support technology validation and deployment.
- Supervise final-year project students and interns involved in the project.
- Support intellectual property (IP) development, technology transfer, and commercialisation activities.
- Prepare technical reports, journal publications, presentations, and research grant proposals.
- Manage laboratory equipment & consumables, procurement, safety compliance, and research products.
jobRequirements:
- Qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal/Fluid Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Systems Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline.
- Have basic foundational understanding of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, or cold-chain storage technologies.
- Proficiency in 3D CAD modelling (Autodesk Fusion 360 or SolidWorks) and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles.
- Practical skills in embedded electronics, microcontroller programming (Arduino / ESP32), and IoT sensor integration.
- Experience or have interest in cryogenic fluids (LN_2), heat exchangers, or fluid pipeline design is a major advantage.
- A hands-on, proactive mindset with the drive to build physical prototypes and lead projects independently in a dynamic lab environment.
- Strong technical writing and data presentation skills.
- Entry-level candidates with strong final-year project experience in thermal fluids, mechatronics, or smart hardware are highly encouraged to apply.

Republic Polytechnic's School of Engineering (SEG), in collaboration with the School of Science (SAS), invites applications for a full-time Research Staff on a 12-month contract to support the DGF-funded project, "Smart Water Treatment in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) for Land-based Fish Farms."

This applied R&D project focuses on developing an innovative smart water treatment system to improve water quality, reduce ammonia, pathogens, turbidity, biofilm, and algae, and enhance the sustainability of land-based aquaculture.

The project integrates two proprietary technologies:

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Making the transition to a low-carbon economy in a secure and cost-competitive manner is critical for Singapore. With finite resources and an open economy, Singapore faces unique trade-offs and challenges in making this transition, requiring innovation in technology and policy to seize new opportunities in a carbon-constrained world.

jobDescription:
Climate change is one of the defining issues of our time. It is a complex global challenge that calls for concerted international action and collaboration between governments, industry and individuals. Singapore, as a low-lying city state, is vulnerable to the effects of climate change. Hence, we have to work together with the international community to address climate change and build a climate resilient future.

At MTI, we seek to pursue sustainable development by balancing economic needs with environmental protection and social inclusion. The transition to a low-carbon and green economy will be especially challenging for Singapore, given our scarce natural resources and open economy.
jobResponsibilities:
MTI’s Energy and Carbon (E&C) Cluster leads initiatives to reduce emissions and drive the transition to a low-carbon economy, while ensuring energy security and cost-competitiveness, and enabling Singapore to sustain economic growth. Officers in this cluster develop energy and carbon markets, plan energy infrastructure, build Singapore’s capabilities to harness low-carbon energy sources, and manage emission trajectories and carbon budgets. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Government, industry, and international partners to support sustainable economic transformation and green growth through strategic planning, policy analysis, and partnerships. 

The Carbon Markets Division within the E&C cluster drives the national development of non-energy mitigation measures and policies, such as carbon capture and storage (CCS) and high-quality carbon credits. We also work closely with agencies such as NCCS, MSE, and MOF, to formulate and coordinate strategies to ensure that Singapore is prepared for the impact of climate change - both domestically and internationally - while seizing new opportunities to create good jobs for Singaporeans.  

The team plays a critical role in charting the path forward for Singapore’s low-carbon transition. You will be part of a dynamic team responsible for formulating Singapore’s carbon mitigation strategies and policies, with a focus on carbon credits. You will examine carbon mitigation issues from multiple perspectives, assess the trade-offs, and work with other government agencies and relevant stakeholders. As the climate space is fast evolving, an officer may be deployed across different workstreams, based on the officer’s development and MTI’s organisational needs. 

Your responsibilities include one or more of the following work streams:  

• Develop and implement plans relating to carbon credits to meet our climate targets, while ensuring economic competitiveness. These include designing a robust international sourcing strategy to meet our climate targets; identifying and negotiating diverse new sources of high-quality Article 6-compliant carbon credits; collaborating with the private sector, international and multilateral organisations, and like-minded countries to secure access to Article 6-compliant carbon credits; catalysing and incentivising the development of new carbon credit project types; as well as growing the pipeline of high-integrity carbon credits projects for Singapore. 
• Develop and implement communications and engagement plans in collaboration with MTI corporate communication and engagement officers to support the implementation of the above climate strategies and policies, in close coordination with other agencies in the Singapore Government.

Even as we take steps to secure a low-carbon energy supply, we will also need to safeguard our energy security and affordability. Navigating the energy trilemma successfully will be one of the defining policy challenges of our generation and hold far-reaching implications for our economy and society.

jobTitle: Tech Risk Supervisor (Tech Risk Monitoring and Surveillance)
agencyDescription: MAS is the central bank of Singapore. Our mission is to promote sustained non-inflationary economic growth, and a sound and progressive financial centre.
jobDescription: You will be part of a dynamic team within the Technology & Cyber Risk Supervision Department (“TCRD”) in MAS that is responsible for overseeing and supervising financial institutions (“FIs”) in their cyber security and technology risk management (“TRM”) practices to ensure the resilience of Singapore’s financial sector.
jobResponsibilities:
This role supports TCRD's mission by conducting ongoing surveillance and analysing risk indicators to monitor the technology risk posture of systemically important FIs in Singapore. The officer will be involved in the following areas of work:

  • Collect data and perform sense-making on risk indicators to obtain early warning signals of potential threats and vulnerabilities that may affect the technology risk posture of systemically important FIs.

  • Conduct thematic reviews and/or surveys on systemically important FIs to assess their technology and cyber resilience.

  • Work with internal stakeholders, other government agencies, and external partners on national-level or cross-sector initiatives to monitor and analyse technology risk issues affecting the systemically important FIs.

  • Implement tools and platforms to enable data analytics, data visualisation, and reporting of insights.
jobRequirements:
• Effective team player with the ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.

  • Highly analytical and inquisitive, with a strong interest in the latest technology/cyber risk trends and developments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with industry frameworks, such as NIST Cyber Security Framework, ISO/IEC27001, CIS Controls, and/or COBIT will be advantageous.

  • Experience in applying AI/ML and data analytics techniques to derive insights from structured and unstructured data.

  • Experience in designing dashboards, key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and executive reporting

  • Proficiency in Python/R, SQL, and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) will be beneficial.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.

Digital technologies for construction design:

• Lead the annual budget and forecasting exercise, including consolidation and review of departmental submissions, and provide analysis to support management decision-making
• Prepare and submit quarterly GST returns, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and accuracy of underlying data
• Partner departments and finance coordinators by providing financial advisory and guidance, including interpreting financial data, recommending improvements and supporting adherence to financial policies
• Analyse financial data using Excel and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) to enhance reporting, strengthen insights, and support data-driven decision-making
• Drive process improvements and optimisation of finance workflows, including streamlining reporting procedures and leveraging digital tools to improve efficiency and control
jobRequirements:
What we are looking for:

We are looking for a finance professional with strong analytical capabilities and a solid foundation in financial reporting and planning. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, able to work independently, and confident in engaging stakeholders to deliver meaningful financial insights. A proactive mindset, combined with a commitment to accuracy, governance and continuous improvement, will be critical to success in this role.


[Key Competencies Required]

1. Financial Reporting
Proficiency in preparing and analysing financial statements and reports in accordance with relevant standards, ensuring accuracy, completeness and reliability of financial information. Maintains a strong focus on data integrity and audit readiness.

2. Budget Planning and Administration 
Demonstrates structured thinking in coordinating budgeting and forecasting processes, including consolidation, review and critical evaluation of financial projections. Ensures alignment between financial plans and organisational priorities.

3. Data Analytics and Visualisation
Applies analytical techniques to interpret datasets, derive insights and present information clearly using data visualisation tools to support informed decision-making.

4. Business Partnering 
Collaborates effectively with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and provide relevant, value-adding financial advice. Communicates complex financial information in a clear and accessible manner.

5. Thinking Clearly and Making Sound Judgements
Exercises sound judgement by evaluating information critically, considering different perspectives and making well-reasoned, evidence-based decisions in complex situations.

Other traits:
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy, with a commitment to maintaining high standards of financial integrity and compliance
• Self-motivated and proactive, able to take ownership of deliverables and work independently in a dynamic environment
• Curious and analytical mindset, with a willingness to question assumptions and continuously improve processes
• Effective communicator, able to present complex financial information in a clear and concise manner to both finance and non-finance stakeholders
• Collaborative team player, with the ability to build strong working relationships across departments
• Adaptable and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities and respond to evolving organisational needs

[What you can expect]
• Growth Opportunities: We champion continuous learning - not just for the public service, but for our officers as well. We actively support our officers’ career growth through:
• Scholarship and sponsorship opportunities for higher education.
• Diverse development opportunities for officers at every career stage.
• Attachment programmes, cross-functional job rotations and gig projects.
• Coaching programmes and leadership development initiatives.
• Work Environment: We provide meaningful work, practise mutual respect and encourage innovation.
• Hybrid & Flexible Work Arrangements: We provide hybrid and flexible work arrangements to support our officers’ work-life needs. We trust that our people will deliver their best, and we strive to provide the support and flexibility they need.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The appointment grade and actual job title will be commensurate with the candidate’s work experience.

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City

Develop World-Class Infrastructure

jobDescription:
The Marketing & Experience Design Division (MXDD) leads the delivery of seamless, customer-centric experiences through customer journey design, service excellence and data-informed optimisation for the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA). We are seeking a Principal Manager to lead our Customer Experience Quality Assurance, Training, Knowledge Management, and Digital Channel Development functions.
Reporting to the Deputy Director, this is a team leader position focused on customer experience (CX) with direct oversight of a team. The role spans four interconnected areas: ensuring service quality and training excellence at the outsourced One Contact Centre (OCC); maintaining and evolving a robust knowledge management ecosystem; owning the Service Portal as a key self-service channel; and co-developing and implementing emerging digital channels, including the WhatsApp 'Chat with SWDA' service and AI-enabled tools under the CRM system.
This role is designed for an experienced manager who is versatile and adaptable across the full spectrum of CX functions. You will be part of building a CX team where Principal Managers are equipped with transferable skills to hold any position within the functional area, with a particular emphasis on integrating operations, data, and technology capabilities to deliver citizen-centric services.
jobResponsibilities:
1. Service Portal Ownership and Digital/AI Tools Enablement
•	Serve as Business Owner of the Service Portal, responsible for strategic direction, content governance, self-service journey design, and continuous improvement, including dynamic FAQ systems powered by AI insights and clear channel signposting to guide citizens to the most appropriate service channel.
•	Lead the adoption and integration of agentic and AI-enabled tools within the CRM system, driving operational readiness, user acceptance testing, and capability building across teams to enhance service delivery workflows.
•	Translate operational and customer experience requirements into system specifications, working closely with technology teams on system development, user acceptance testing, operational readiness, and change adoption.
•	Maintain familiarity with AI and automation technologies in service delivery, including chatbots, generative AI, and agentic service tools.

2. WhatsApp Channel Development and Management
•	Lead the development and operationalisation of the WhatsApp 'Chat with SWDA' channel as a key digital service touchpoint, including defining topic coverage and FAQs, establishing automated routing for complex queries requiring human intervention via live chat, and trialling generative chatbot capabilities to replace rule-based chat and better meet customer expectations.
•	Develop operational policies, workflows, and customer-facing communications for the channel, and work with the technology team to build and continuously refine the system and customer interface.

3. Knowledge Management and Integrated Learning Platform Development
•	Oversee and evolve SWDA's knowledge management ecosystem, with a strategic focus on developing the KM module within the CRM system into a comprehensive, integrated platform. Beyond housing programme and policy FAQs and the Case Category Matrix, the to-go state for this KM module is to function as a centralised database of training materials and an active learning module with capabilities to track, rate, and assess the progress and proficiency levels of Customer Service Officers (CSOs).
•	Drive the development of individual skills profiles for each CSO based on proficiency data, enabling smart routing of customer cases based on the complexity of the enquiry matched to the CSO's skills profile — driving both service quality and operational efficiency.
•	Work with technology teams and the outsourced provider to define system requirements, conduct user acceptance testing, and manage the phased implementation of the KM module's expanded capabilities, ensuring proficiency tracking and skills profiling features are embedded into OCC workflows.
•	Ensure knowledge assets remain accurate, current, and responsive to programme changes, service needs, and channel rollouts.

4. Quality Assurance Strategy and Oversight
•	Lead the quality assurance strategy for the outsourced OCC, setting the strategic direction, quality standards, audit methodologies, scoring criteria, and service performance expectations. While the outsourced provider is contractually responsible for developing and operationalising the QA framework, you will provide substantive oversight and direction to ensure it is aligned with SWDA's service standards and customer experience goals.
•	Analyse audit findings, customer feedback, and service metrics to identify root causes, service gaps, and improvement opportunities, and develop business cases for quality improvement initiatives.
•	Manage the outsourced provider's performance against quality standards, address service lapses, and drive sustained improvement in customer satisfaction across all channels.

5. Training Strategy, Programme Facilitation and Capability Development
•	Lead the training strategy for the outsourced OCC, working in close partnership with the outsourced provider's Training Manager to guide the development of the training framework and oversee its implementation. While the outsourced provider is contractually responsible for developing training materials and delivering soft skills, cybersecurity awareness, and other operational training for OCC officers, your team's role is to serve as the subject matter conduit between SWDA's programme and policy divisions and the OCC.
•	Work with internal divisions to stay abreast of programme and policy changes, new rollouts, and service updates, translating these into clear, accessible briefings and training sessions to guide the OCC in day-to-day service delivery, and ensuring the outsourced provider's Training Manager has the substantive knowledge needed to develop these into bite-sized training materials for the OCC team.
•	Oversee the overall training calendar and ensure the training framework remains current and responsive to emerging service needs, new channel rollouts, and technology adoption requirements.

6. Stakeholder Engagement, Leadership and Adaptability
•	Lead, coach, and develop Senior Manager and Manager-level officers in the CX team.
•	Engage internal divisions, outsourced partners, government agencies, and technology teams to align on service quality, knowledge management, digital channel priorities, and customer-centric service improvements.
•	Manage multiple projects and influence internal and external stakeholders across functions to support digital adoption and service transformation.
•	Demonstrate strong communication, stakeholder management, sound judgement, proactiveness, adaptability, and a customer-centric mindset in complex service situations.
jobRequirements:

•	Experience as a business owner or product owner for digital service channels, CRM systems, or KM platforms is strongly preferred.

agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
agencyDescription:
"The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) was established on 2 February 1996, with the mission to develop Singapore as a premier global hub port and international maritime centre (IMC), and to advance and safeguard Singapore's strategic maritime interests.

MPA is the driving force behind Singapore's port and maritime development, taking on the roles of Port Authority, Port Regulator, Port Planner, IMC Champion, and National Maritime Representative.

MPA partners the industry and other agencies to enhance safety, security and environmental protection in our port waters, facilitate port operations and growth, expand the cluster of maritime ancillary services, and promote maritime R&D and manpower development."
jobDescription:
[What the role is]

Singapore is a global hub port and a leading maritime centre. To ensure that ships calling at our port do so safely, they are required to comply with port entry requirements. The ocean-going ships also require services such as fuel (bunker), towing and crew change. These are provided by harbour craft operating in our port. The Marine Licensing & Permits administers port entry requirements, and also licenses harbour craft operating in the Port of Singapore. To support our national decarbonisation goals, MPA has already set goals to reduce the greenhouse gas emissions of our local harbour craft, which will entail a full change in the mode of operations of our companies.
jobResponsibilities:
[What will you be working on]

Reporting to the Marine Licensing and Permits Department, which is part of the Marine Services Division, you will part of a dynamic team that is issuing licenses/permits to ensure vessels operating in Singapore meet the necessary safety standards, certifications, ethical guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

You will also be involved in formulating policies to promote the harbour craft sector, creating a pipeline of seafarers to meet the industry needs and prepare for the decarbonisation milestones of the maritime industry.

Your key responsibilities include:

1. Licensing

  • Oversee the licensing of harbour craft and pleasure craft, ensuring that vessels meet safety, manning and regulatory requirements.

  • Shape forward-looking licensing policies to modernise the harbour craft fleet and support Singapore’s maritime decarbonisation journey.

  • Manage sea space allocation for mooring buoys and develop policies to support their safe and efficient use.

2. Port clearance processes

  • Drive projects to digitalise and simplify customer-facing processes, including licensing applications, enquiries and document submissions.

  • Oversee and support 24/7 port clearance operations to ensure efficient service delivery and timely support to port users.

  • Administer and enforce port clearance requirements to maintain safe, secure and well-regulated vessel movements.

3. Industry Development & Transformation

  • Administer and enforce manpower quota policies that support the sustainable development of the harbour craft sector.

  • Review and develop manpower policies and training initiatives to attract, upskill and retain seafarers.

  • Use harbour craft industry data to identify trends, risks and opportunities that can inform policy and operational improvements.

  • Engage industry stakeholders to understand operational challenges, build support for transformation efforts and encourage the adoption of new technologies.
jobRequirements:
[What we are looking for]

We are looking for people who are keen to make a meaningful contribution to Singapore’s maritime sector. You may have experience in customer-facing service delivery, process improvement, regulatory work, licensing policy, manpower development or the maritime sector. More importantly, you should be proactive, adaptable and motivated to learn, lead change and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced operating environment.

You should have strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage diverse stakeholders both in writing and in person. You should also be comfortable working with data and using insights to support policies, strategies and operational decisions. This role offers exposure to regulatory operations, policy development, digitalisation and industry engagement, and may require occasional duties outside regular office hours.

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City

Develop World-Class Infrastructure

MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.

As Laboratory Manager, Testing and Quality Control, you will be a key member of the Blood Supply Management (BSM) division of Blood Services Group, working closely with our Scientific Head (TQC) to ensure the smooth and effective running of our Blood Donation Testing and Quality Control laboratories. Your work will directly support Singapore's National Blood Programme by maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and compliance in blood testing services.
This role also includes rotation on-call duties, providing 24-hour standby support for urgent or emergency situations.
jobResponsibilities:
Laboratory Operations Management

You will oversee the daily operations of the TQC laboratories, covering sample management, equipment and supplies management, and manpower planning. You will ensure all procedures are carried out in accordance with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), with accurate and complete records always maintained. A key part of this is continuously evaluating workflows to improve efficiency and reduce turnaround times.

Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

You will implement and maintain robust quality control systems to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of test results. This includes ensuring full compliance with regulatory frameworks such as HCSA, BATA, WSH, and AABB accreditation requirements, leading or participating in internal and external audits, and enforcing safety policies to mitigate biological and operational risks.

People Management and Development

You will supervise laboratory officers, manage roster planning, conduct performance appraisals, and oversee training and competency development. You will foster a positive, collaborative work environment that supports professional growth and high performance.

Administrative and Business Management

You will manage laboratory budgets, procurement, and inventory to ensure the timely availability of reagents, consumables, and supplies. You will also prepare performance reports and quality indicators for senior management and maintain emergency response and business continuity plans.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

You will serve as the primary liaison with Blood Resources and Clinical Services for sample collection coordination and test results management. You will evaluate and manage vendor relationships, and oversee contract management including performance monitoring, invoice verification, and renewal planning.

Technology, Systems, Projects and Innovation

You will oversee the maintenance and optimal operation of laboratory testing equipment. You will work closely with IT team and vendors to ensure the smooth and reliable operations of the Blood Bank Computer System with a sound understanding of relevant system parameters, configurations, and algorithm settings to assess their operational impact and ensure appropriate resolution. You will contribute to improvement initiatives such as testing automation, workflow digitalisation, and research coordination, and leverage data analytics and AI-assisted tools to support quality monitoring, decision-making, and operational excellence.

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.

jobResponsibilities:
As part of the team, you will play a key role in managing and enhancing the data quality of the Retirement and Health Study (RHS), a large-scale longitudinal survey with approximately 20,000 respondents across multiple waves. You will contribute to areas including questionnaire design, data processing, academic collaboration, and data science initiatives to support evidence-based policymaking.

You will undertake the full data quality assurance pipeline — developing validation rules, managing data imputation, and integrating administrative and survey data using tools such as Stata and Python. You will also review and improve the RHS questionnaire from a data quality perspective, ensuring it remains robust, relevant, and well-suited for longitudinal analysis.

Beyond data operations, you will manage academic collaborations with local universities and government agencies, assessing research proposals and reviewing drafts to ensure alignment with data governance requirements and policy objectives. You will also undertake data science and digital initiatives, including building models and automation tools to improve data quality and respondent engagement.

In this role, you will:
•	Undertake comprehensive data quality assurance activities, implementing quality control measures throughout the data lifecycle to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of datasets.
•	Undertake the organisation, storage, and retrieval of datasets, and maintain detailed documentation of data quality processes and methodologies to ensure transparency and replicability.
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams, survey companies, academic institutions, and government agencies to coordinate study planning and execution, and facilitate seamless data sharing as part of these collaborative efforts.
•	Contribute to data science projects aimed at enhancing data quality or supporting the execution of the study.
•	Identify opportunities to improve data management processes, proposing and implementing enhancements where appropriate.
jobRequirements:
We value the diverse talents and experiences that each individual brings to the table. While mastery of every requirement may not be necessary, familiarity and expertise in some of the following areas will position you for success within this team.
•	Relevant experience in statistical data processing, data management, or a related field, with familiarity in survey methodology being an advantage.
•	Experience in programming tools such as Stata, Python, or R for data processing and analysis.
•	Experience with machine learning or data science applications is an advantage.
•	Ability to work across multiple stakeholders — from survey companies and researchers to policy owners — and translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
•	Communicates effectively, both in writing and speaking.
•	Works independently and manages priorities effectively.
•	Adaptable and resourceful in handling different tasks and challenges.
 
To support Whole-of-Government statistical capabilities and provide diverse opportunities for our officers, Singapore Department of Statistics (DOS) recruits for statistical roles across the Public Service. For this role in Central Provident Fund Board (CPFB), successful candidates will be employed by DOS and seconded to CPFB. Successful candidates may also explore other career opportunities in DOS and other public agencies after their stint with CPFB. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

Being part of #TeamCPF means embarking on a challenging and rewarding career in a progressive workplace that values productivity and growth. Here’s what awaits you:

This is a purposeful role that offers opportunities to co-create and co-deliver solutions that better support migrant workers (MWs) and migrant domestic workers (MDWs).
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader to join the team as Senior Assistant Director. The role also involves leading a multi-functional team responsible for co-creating and co-delivering initiatives such as socio-recreational activities, training and employment pathways, well-being assistance, and alternative rest spaces or meaningful off-day programmes for MDWs.

agencyDescription:
The Mission of Ministry of Transport is to develop Singapore's land, sea and air transport sectors so as to enhance our economic competitiveness and quality of life in a knowledge-based economy. MOT oversees the development and regulation of the following sectors:

• Civil Aviation and Air Transport
• Maritime and Ports
• Land Transport

Besides providing an efficient and cost-effective transportation in Singapore, it also strives to make Singapore an international civil aviation and maritime centre for the region.

The ministry sets the strategic and policy direction while operations and regulatory works are carried out by the statutory boards under its charge. There are four statutory boards which are established by Acts of Parliament: the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS), the Land Transport Authority (LTA), the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) and the Public Transport Council (PTC). The ministry also oversees the operation of the Transport Safety Investigation Bureau (TSIB).

The Information Programme Centre at DSTA develops cutting-edge software solutions that harness information to empower the SAF to fight smarter and faster on the battlefield.
 
We are seeking motivated and innovative Software Engineers to develop applications that monitor, detect, and characterise RF activity across the spectrum. As a key member of the team, you will be build advanced signal analysis applications that leverage an RF processing pipeline to transform raw In-phase/Quadrature data into actionable signal insights. These applications detect emitters, classify signal types, and identify anomalies in near-real-time, enabling mission-critical decision-making.

•	Good understanding of wireless communication concepts, including RF transmission, antenna systems, propagation, modulation, and signal decoding).
•	Understanding of RF signal representation and processing fundamentals such as Fast Fourier Transform, filtering and sampling theory. Knowledge in array processing is an advantage.
•	Experience processing digital signals represented as In-phase/Quadrature data and time series data to extract meaningful information.
•	Experience applying machine learning techniques to RF signal processing is an advantage.
•	Proficiency in GIT version control.
•	Expertise in software design principles, including code modularity and maintainability.
•	Experience with containerisation technologies (e.g. Docker)
•	Experience developing or deploying applications using microservices architecture.
•	Experience with stream processing technologies (e.g. Kafka)
 
Why join us?
As a Software Engineer for RF applications, you will have the creative freedom and technical autonomy to develop software solutions that address real-world challenges. You will have the opportunity to build software and algorithms that will help us understand the potential threats to Singapore. The software that you develop will have a lasting impact on Singapore’s long-term defence and security. At DSTA, you will work with modern tech stacks and benefit from the guidance of experienced mentors within the Information community, continuously strengthening your technical expertise.   • Apply AI-enabled tools, digital inspection platforms, and data-driven methods to support predictive or condition-based maintenance.

  • Support trials, pilots and implementation of new technologies such as:

    • smart sensors for structural/condition monitoring

    • AI-driven defect detection (e.g., via imagery or video analytics)

  • Analyse asset performance data to derive insights, optimise maintenance schedules and enhance safety outcomes.

  • Communicate engineering decisions and technical assessments clearly and professionally.

Participate in trials, pilots and evaluation of new technologies or methods relevant to path management and active mobility infrastructure.

The officer will oversee and handle the following key areas of work:

jobTitle: Senior Manager (Capability Development Strategy), LDO (2-years contract)
agencyDescription:
The Civil Service College (CSC) is a statutory board under the Public Service Division, Prime Minister’s Office. We are the central learning institution for the Singapore Public Service and we partner government ministries and agencies to develop people for a first-class public service.

CSC brings together public officers from diverse backgrounds and provides them with opportunities for learning and skills upgrading. Our service-wide networks enable public officers to build capabilities, develop shared ethos and gain deeper perspectives, creating a collaborative environment for dialogue and knowledge sharing.

Through our programmes and services, CSC aims to strengthen strategic capacity in governance, leadership, public administration and management for the Singapore Public Service.
jobDescription:
You will be part of the Learning and Development Office (LDO), a corporate unit within the Civil Service College Singapore (CSC).

LDO advances capability development and organisational learning across the Public Service. We work with agencies and partners to strengthen workforce and organisational capability through research, practice development, experimentation and strategic initiatives.

This role is for someone who wants to shape how capability is built in organisations. You will work at the intersection of organisational development, capability development and workplace learning — helping stakeholders diagnose complex performance challenges, identify the right interventions, and strengthen practice across the Public Service.
jobResponsibilities:
In this role, you will lead a team to:
•	Translate strategy, research and emerging trends into practical approaches that improve organisational capability.
•	Partner stakeholders to diagnose organisational capability, learning and performance challenges.
•	Develop initiatives that strengthen capability development practice across CSC and the Public Service.
•	Design and test interventions using levers such as workplace learning, communities of practice, organisational development, change initiatives and formal learning.
•	Build partnerships and communities that advance capability development practice across agencies.
•	Contribute to thought leadership, experimentation and practice innovation within CSC.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for someone who demonstrates:
•	Relevant professional experience – at least 6 years of experience in one or more areas related to organisational development, capability development, learning and development, performance consulting, workforce transformation, change management or organisation effectiveness.
•	Relevant leadership experience – prior experience in leading or managing a team, with the ability to guide and develop others.
•	Strategic thinking and execution – ability to translate organisational priorities, research insights and emerging ideas into coherent strategies, practical initiatives and implementation plans that advance capability development.
•	Diagnostic and problem-solving capability – ability to identify root causes and systemic drivers behind organisational and performance challenges, and shape appropriate interventions.
•	Stakeholder engagement and influence – strong facilitation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work across multiple stakeholders and perspectives.
•	Adaptability and judgement – comfort working with ambiguity, complexity and evolving priorities, while exercising sound judgement on what will create practical value.
•	Learning orientation and curiosity – interest in staying updated and sharing with others on how organisations learn, adapt and improve performance.
•	Partnership and practice-building orientation – experience building partnerships, communities, cross-organisational initiatives or practice networks will be an advantage.
