We are looking for aspiring candidates to be part of a dynamic and multidisciplinary team to drive in-house applied R&D for UAS within the RAUS CoE (Aerial Systems domain), developing and maturing autonomy and system capabilities. Execute software, algorithm and system development, while ensuring alignment with Ops-Tech Masterplan and supporting transition of validated technologies into operational use.
jobResponsibilities:
•	Design, implement and validate GNC algorithms for UAVs 
•	Develop strategies not limited to path planning, trajectory generation and multi-agent coordination to fulfill the project’s intended use case
•	Study and analyze relevant classical and state‑of‑the‑art research literature to derive, adapt or extend suitable solutions for the problem domain
•	Where suitable, translate theoretical concepts from research papers into practical, implementable algorithms
•	Evaluate algorithm performance, and robustness through simulation and flight tests
•	Develop/modify/adapt and maintain flight controller software/firmware 
•	Integrate and interface with onboard sensors such as but not limited to RGB/RGB‑D cameras, LiDAR, ToF and inertial sensors, ensuring reliable data pipelines for downstream functions
•	Where needed, implement perception, localization and state estimation modules, including computer vision, sensor fusion and filtering techniques
•	Support system integration, debugging and performance verification via simulation testing, hardware/software in the loop testing and flight testing
•	Apply software development processes, including modular design, version control, testing, and configuration management
•	Document system/software architectures, algorithm designs, test methodologies and results in a clear and structured manner

jobRequirements:

•	Experience in UAS guidance, navigation and controls, path planning or multi‑robot systems is strongly preferred
•	Proficiency in C/C++ and Python for robotics/autonomy applications
•	Experience with simulation platforms such as Gazebo, AirSim, or other effective robotics/UAS simulation environments preferred
•	Familiarity with open‑source UAV flight control software such as PX4 and/or ArduPilot, including architecture, interfaces and limitations
•	Familiarity with open‑source UAV flight controller hardware (e.g. Pixhawk variants or equivalent)
•	Experience integrating navigation, localization and autonomy algorithms on Linux-based companion compute devices on the UAV (CPU and/or GPU)
•	Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2, MAVLink, and related middleware for inter‑process and vehicle communication
•	Experience with GNSS‑denied localization and navigation, sensor fusion, computer vision and/or perception‑driven autonomy
•	Exposure to RGB, RGB D, LiDAR, ToF or inertial sensors and their use in autonomous systems.
•	This role is primarily a software and autonomy engineering position; familiarity with electronics and mechanical systems is an added bonus
•	Minimum of bachelor’s degree in engineering; preferably Degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Mechatronics / System Engineering / Computer Science / Computer Engineering
•	Post-graduate degree in robotics, autonomous systems and controls would be an advantage

All new hires are appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance and will be assessed and considered for permanent tenure over time, based on performance.

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of Health’s (MOH) vision is to champion a healthy nation with our people – to live well, live long and with peace of mind. As an open country constantly exposed to an interconnected world, Singapore faces complex issues in public healthcare. MOH constantly grapples with new challenges brought on by an increasingly globalised world, a rapidly ageing population and rising expectations. MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.
jobDescription:
The Assistant Director will lead and coordinate the team’s efforts to measure, monitor, and improve the quality, safety, and value of healthcare delivery across Singapore. The role requires someone who can bridge analytical rigour with policy sensibility — translating complex healthcare data and research into actionable recommendations, while managing a team and engaging effectively with stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem.

You will be working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, lead a small team, and work collaboratively with a wide range of partners across government, healthcare institutions, and community organisations.
jobResponsibilities:
1.	Oversee the team's portfolio of research and analytics on healthcare value, safety, and performance, ensuring that the work is methodologically sound and policy-relevant.
2.	Guide the development of frameworks, performance metrics, and measurement approaches that track progress against national healthcare outcomes.
3.	Provide substantive inputs into policy development and strategic planning, drawing on data analysis, research findings, and an understanding of ground realities to craft well-reasoned recommendations for senior management.
4.	Supervise the design and execution of research studies assessing the performance and effectiveness of health systems, and ensure that insights are communicated clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
5.	Play an active role in stakeholder engagement, working with public health professionals, healthcare providers, and community organisations to align efforts and drive collective action on healthcare value and safety priorities.
6.	Lead and develop the clinical coding function, which plays a critical role in ensuring that clinical data used for analysis and policymaking is accurate, reliable, and of high quality. This includes overseeing coding standards, driving capability development, and working with healthcare institutions to strengthen clinical coding practices across the system.
7.	Represent the division at inter-agency workgroups and external platforms as required.
8.	Mentor and develop junior team members, fostering a culture of analytical rigour, curiosity, and continuous improvement within the team.
jobRequirements:
Qualifications and Skills:
1.	Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, health policy, health economics, epidemiology, or a related field with a focus on population health.
2.	Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark, R) for analyzing and visualizing population health data sets. Familiarity with Geospatial Information Systems is a bonus.
3.	Able to synthesize data points and possess good sense of realities on the ground for social determinants of health, health policy, healthcare delivery systems, global health issues, and population health management strategies.
4.	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider short- and long-term implications when translating population health data into actionable insights and interventions.
5.	Excellent communication skills and the ability to proactively identify opportunities for collaboration with diverse stakeholders, including public health professionals, community leaders, and healthcare providers.
6.	Relevant experience in the healthcare sector, intelligence or strategic planning is advantageous, and will be considered favorably. 

Key Competencies Required:
•	Thinking Clearly & Making Sound Judgements — Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations, with the ability to grasp timelines, operating context, and ground realities.
•	Learning & Putting Skills into Action — Possesses the drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge, and new ways of working, and encourages the same in the team.
•	Improving & Innovating — Ability to seek continual improvements and to innovate and experiment while managing the risks involved.
•	Working Effectively with Stakeholders — Ability to mobilise and rally partners and stakeholders towards a collective purpose, and to engage senior counterparts with confidence and credibility.
•	Leading & Developing People — Ability to guide, mentor, and develop team members, and to foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture.

The project also involves enhancing P.I.C.K., an existing machine learning system that classifies web-scraped clothing prices into CPI product categories. The intern will contribute to developing web-scraping, Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions to improve P.I.C.K. and extend it to additional CPI groups, supporting more efficient CPI compilation.
jobResponsibilities:
a)	Support the development of an experimental CPI series based on the multilateral index approach.
i.	developing python scripts and/or ML models to clean and classify scanner data into pre-defined expenditure categories
ii.	computation of multilateral indices, with reference to what other National Statistical Offices have done
iii.	analysis of the multilateral indices e.g., how it compares to the existing CPI

b)	Enhance the existing Machine Learning (ML) algorithm (P.I.C.K.) to improve the homogeneity of product classification and expand the use of enhanced version to other CPI groups, such as household durables.

jobDescription:
NOVA: Non-cooked Food Data Orchestration, Validation and Automation

For the compilation of Non-Cooked Food (NCF) CPI, Prices Division obtains electronic price data from various supermarket chains on a monthly basis and conducts bi-weekly field surveys for prices of perishable items at wet markets. Following which, the data are validated and processed before compilation.  

The intern is expected to support the development and implementation of automation solutions for Non-Cooked Food CPI data processing.
jobResponsibilities:
(1) assisting with extracted OCR-based data cleaning/transformation, 
(2) integrating datasets from multiple sources to prepare consolidated summary on price changes
(3) incorporate automated data cleaning/validation techniques to improve workflow e.g. outlier detection by comparing price data across various data sources, verifying data quality, e.t.c. 
(4) preparing dashboards on key insights/trends on NCF
(5) assisting in data analysis and generating statistical outputs such as 'Shrinkflation' statistics 

The intern is expected to contribute to the development of web-scraping scripts, ML and LLM scripts to leverage on the latest digital tools to compile and process data more efficiently.

jobDescription:
The Government can only deliver on our urban transformation plans with a strong Built Environment (BE) sector.

The Manpower & Productivity Team plays an important role to ensure that our BE sector is well supported by manpower, technologies, capabilities and other enablers (e.g. public procurement, innovation programmes, enterprise development support), to deliver on our building aspirations. 

As our manpower and land constraints tighten, this role involves working with WOG and industry stakeholders to balance difficult trade-offs, rethink existing policies and approaches, and try out creative solutions to unleash the potential of the BE sector.
jobResponsibilities:
Key areas of work could include:
(i)	Accelerating the adoption of advanced BE technologies through a variety of levers (e.g. innovation, grants, procurement, regulations) so that we can build better and build faster;
(ii)	Monitoring the health and capacity of the BE sector to meet our development needs, and engendering a pro-enterprise environment for our BE sector to thrive; and
(iii)	Developing a strong core of local capabilities and talents as we embark on more complex and challenging projects, as well as projects in emerging areas (e.g. coastal protection).
(iv)	Recalibrating our foreign worker policies so that the construction sector has access to the necessary manpower while managing possible disamenities and taking good care of our foreign workforce; 

The officer can expect a rigorous and rewarding experience that will sharpen highly transferrable skills in policy analysis, balancing trade-offs, stakeholder management, scheme design, data analysis, public communications, amongst others. 

The officer will also gain exposure to a variety of policy domains including foreign and local manpower policies, industry development, technology and innovation, procurement policies, legislation etc.
jobRequirements:
1. A team player who fits into the division’s dynamic and vibrant culture.
2. Strong communicator who can build strong working relationships with a wide range of WOG and industry stakeholders.
3. Self-motivated, resourceful, open to challenges and have the “can-do” spirit.
4. Enjoys rigorous analysis, problem-solving and data-driven policy work.

As MTI’s de facto “CEO’s Office”, the CP team works closely with senior management to translate strategy intent into action and to steward our resources effectively.  The team plays a central role in driving organisation-wide alignment, ensuring sound governance and enabling the delivery of MTI’s Strategic Priorities.

(i)	Leading corporate planning for the MTI family, including the annual work planning process and the planning and management of senior leadership platforms, to promote strategic alignment and coherence across the organisation 
(ii)	Driving strategic resource management for the MTI family, including supporting the prioritisation and allocation of budget and manpower resources to key economic projects, in alignment with MTI’s Vision and Mission.

jobDescription: The Customer Experience Division (CXD) plays a vital role in the Ministry of Social and Family Development’s mission by ensuring a positive and consistent service experience for our customers. Our team drives customer experience (CX) initiatives, fosters a strong service culture, and ensures that the quality of services delivered across all channels meets high standards.
jobResponsibilities:
We are looking for a dynamic and independent officer to elevate our customers’ experience and make a difference in the lives of the people we serve. In the Planning and Development team, you will develop end-to-end service policies, using customer and operational insights to identify service issues, and drive evidence-based service improvements across MSF. Depending on the officer’s experience, the officer will support or lead the following areas, working under the guidance of a Team Lead. This includes (a) driving customer experience strategy and service policy; (b) building and applying service intelligence through data and insights; (c) driving service transformation priorities; and (d) providing enterprise service governance. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

Drive customer experience strategy and service policy
•	Develop and review enterprise CX policies, plans and strategies that advance MSF's service goals and lift the customer experience consistently across touchpoints and channels 
•	Translate MSF’s service direction and priorities into implementation plans and initiatives that strengthen service practices and outcomes across divisions 

Build and apply service intelligence through data and insights
•	Plan and implement the annual Voice of Customer (VoC) / customer satisfaction study end-to-end — methodology and questionnaire design, stakeholder engagement, vendor procurement and management, and fieldwork — to produce reliable enterprise level insights on service performance.
•	Integrate customer and operational insights from multiple sources (VoC, Global Services Benchmarking, Contact Centre reports, emails and calls) to diagnose systemic service issues, shape policy and service-development priorities and recommend practical improvements to close service gaps.
•	Develop and review policy parameters to facilitate building of service intelligence, including the comprehensive capture of public-facing correspondence across MSF

Enable service transformation 
•	Develop and support the adoption of enterprise service rules and guardrails to assure service quality, including user service development-stress testing to surface and mitigate service risks and blind spots before launch
•	Partner Operational Groups and stakeholders to map customer journeys, prioritise high-impact journeys for review, and pilot new service models that improve outcomes at enterprise scale. 
Provide enterprise service governance
•	Support the Customer Experience Steering Committee, whose mandate is to provide enterprise leadership, governance and oversight on service experience and performance matters, to enable consistent and citizen-centric service outcomes across MSF.

a.	At least 1 year of relevant experience. Candidates considered for more senior designations should have commensurately deeper experience in leading complex projects, policy development, research or stakeholder engagement. 
b.	Strong analytical and sensemaking skills, with the ability to synthesise quantitative and qualitative findings into actionable recommendations.
c.	Strong thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify systemic causes and surface service delivery issues.
d.	Ability to engage stakeholders effectively, facilitate collaboration and build alignment.
e.	Strong written and spoken communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly.
f.	Experience in customer research and satisfaction studies and survey design would be an advantage.
g.	Familiarity with data analytics, dashboarding and visualisation tools would be an advantage.

Join us in making a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and helping to build a better Singapore. Apply now to join our CXD team and help us shape the future of service delivery at MSF!

Key Responsibilities

Data Analytics & AI
• Perform end-to-end data analytics, including data preparation, exploration, statistical analysis, modelling and visualisation, to generate actionable insights.
• Design, develop, test and evaluate statistical, machine learning and AI models for business and regulatory use cases.
• Apply advanced analytics techniques such as predictive modelling, classification, anomaly detection and natural language processing.

Data & AI Use Cases
• Engage business users to identify opportunities where data analytics and AI can address business and regulatory challenges.
• Translate business needs into defined use cases and determine appropriate approaches based on data availability, feasibility and expected value.
• Develop proofs-of-concept and implement production-ready solutions, incorporating user feedback and operational requirements.
• Assess solution effectiveness and identify opportunities for enhancement, reuse and scale.

Data & AI Platform
• Support the development, enhancement and maintenance of ACRA’s Data and AI Platform for analytics, machine learning and generative AI workloads.
• Gather user requirements and translate them into functional and technical requirements for platform enhancements.
• Contribute to data pipelines, analytical datasets and other platform components supporting analytics and AI solutions.
• Work with technology teams and vendors on platform development, integration, troubleshooting and implementation.
• Support the planning and prioritisation of platform releases and use cases, taking into account organisational priorities, technical readiness and dependencies.

Planning, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement
• Support management in departmental planning, prioritisation of initiatives, work planning and tracking of key deliverables.
• Provide advice on data and AI priorities, platform capabilities, emerging technologies and resource requirements.
• Apply appropriate data governance, security and responsible AI practices, including consideration of data quality, model performance and explainability.
• Keep abreast of developments in data analytics and AI and assess their potential application within ACRA.
• Work closely with business units, technology teams, data specialists and vendors to deliver solutions and provide subject matter expertise.

Requirements

• Relevant experience in data analytics, data science, machine learning or AI, with strong hands-on experience developing analytics and AI solutions.
• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience in data analysis, statistical and machine learning libraries.
• Experience in data preparation, exploratory analysis, statistical modelling, machine learning and model evaluation.
• Good understanding of databases, data pipelines, data platforms and modern data architectures.
• Experience delivering analytics or AI solutions from problem definition through development, evaluation and implementation.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of complex assignments.

Good to Have
• Experience in predictive modelling, anomaly detection, natural language processing or other advanced analytics.
• Experience developing generative AI and LLM-based solutions, including RAG, prompt engineering and model evaluation.
• Familiarity with Databricks or equivalent modern data and AI platforms for data engineering, analytics and AI/model development.
• Experience with cloud-based data and AI services, data engineering, MLOps/LLMOps or model monitoring.
• Experience with business intelligence and data visualisation tools.

• Experience applying data analytics or AI to regulatory, risk, compliance or operational use cases.

agencyDescription:

jobDescription: SENIOR/ MANAGER, DATA PARTNERSHIPS — TRANSPORT AI PROGRAMME, LTA SINGAPORE
jobResponsibilities:
Singapore's land transport network moves millions of people every day. As AI reshapes what's possible in transport operations, the Land Transport Authority is investing in AI capabilities that will meaningfully improve how the network is sensed, managed, and optimised — for commuters, operators, and public officers alike.

AI systems are only as good as the data that powers them. We are looking for a Senior/ Manager to establish and lead our data acquisition and partnership function — the foundational capability that will enable our organisation to develop meaningful, operationally relevant data use cases and AI-enabled applications.

Beyond internal organisational data, operationally relevant datasets may be found across government agencies, industry partners, and contractors — each governed by their own access controls, sharing frameworks, and institutional considerations. You will be required to understand our concept of operations well enough to determine what data is needed, and pursue access to that data through establishing relationships, agreements and organisational infrastructure required to bring the right data in securely and sustainably.

What You Will Be Working On

You will lead a team to translate our concept of operations into a prioritised multi-modal data acquisition roadmap, identifying what data we need and sequencing efforts by operational value and feasibility. Your work also involves stakeholder engagement, negotiating access with government agencies, statutory boards, industries and research institutions.

As part of data acquisition, you will lead your team to define and enforce standards for how data is received — covering file formats, data schemas, metadata requirements, and update cadences. This ensures that datasets from disparate sources can be reliably ingested, integrated, and made ready for analytical and AI workloads. Where partners or contractors are unable to meet these standards natively, you will work with them to find practical solutions or manage the necessary transformation processes internally.

You will also be responsible for identifying and building the right platform for consolidating data from multiple sources, particularly where contractor or sensitive datasets introduce security and classification constraints that may rule out standard environments. You will work with technical, legal, and cybersecurity colleagues to arrive at an appropriate approach.

Underpinning all of this is sound data governance — ensuring that what we acquire is handled compliantly, with appropriate agreements and access controls in place. You will work closely with analytical, AI development and product teams to ensure that acquired data is properly onboarded and ready for use case development.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge in Computer Science, Infocomm Technology, Engineering, or a related field, with at least 8 years of relevant experience including 3 or more years in a leadership capacity. Experience in data governance, inter-agency coordination, or data strategy is strongly preferred.

  • Prior public service experience or experience working closely with government agencies, government data security and classification frameworks will be a significant advantage.

  • You should bring demonstrated experience in negotiating data access or managing data sharing arrangements in a government or operationally complex environment.

  • Experience building or leading a team of data scientists and engineers to deliver data pipeline, warehouse and data sharing capabilities.

  • Experience in working in cross-functional teams and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate operational data needs into a prioritised data strategy.

  • Familiarity with, data cataloguing, metadata management, or platform environments is a plus.

jobDescription:
The Procurement Function reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). The Assistant Director, Procurement plays a strategic leadership role in driving procurement excellence across the organisation. The incumbent will lead the development and execution of procurement strategies that deliver value, strengthen governance, optimise spending, mitigate risks, and ensure business continuity.

As a key member of the Procurement team, you will provide leadership and direction in:

• Strategic sourcing and category management
• Procurement policy, governance and compliance
• Contract and supplier relationship management
• Stakeholder engagement and business partnering
• Procurement transformation and digitalisation
• Procurement operations and continuous improvement

The role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound judgement, stakeholder influence, and the ability to translate business needs into effective procurement solutions that support organisational objectives.
jobResponsibilities:
Strategic Sourcing and Category Management

  • Lead the development and implementation of sourcing strategies for assigned spend categories to achieve value-for-money outcomes, operational efficiencies, and sustainable cost savings.

  • Partner stakeholders to optimise requirements and specifications while leveraging HPB's overall purchasing power.

  • Monitor market conditions, industry trends, and supply risks to ensure continuity of essential services and critical supplies.

  • Drive procurement planning and demand management initiatives to strengthen procurement outcomes.

Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders by providing clear, practical, and consistent procurement guidance throughout the procurement lifecycle.

  • Influence and engage stakeholders to make informed sourcing decisions and adopt best procurement practices.

  • Champion a value-driven procurement culture by repositioning procurement from a reactive function to a strategic business partner.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Develop, review, and strengthen procurement policies, frameworks, and governance processes to ensure compliance with Government procurement requirements and organisational policies.

  • Review and assess procurement strategies, evaluation outcomes, and award recommendations before submission for approval.

  • Identify procurement and contract-related risks, establish key risk indicators, and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Ensure transparency, accountability, and good governance across procurement activities.

Contract and Supplier Management

  • Foster strategic supplier relationships to obtain market intelligence, industry insights, emerging innovations, and leading practices.

  • Drive supplier performance management and contract governance to maximise contract value and minimise operational risks.

  • Analyse critical contract failure points and implement proactive measures to enhance contract performance and service delivery.

Procurement Transformation and Analytics

  • Leverage data analytics and market intelligence to support decision-making, develop sourcing strategies, and maximise return on investment.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline procurement processes, enhance efficiency, and improve user experience through digitalisation and automation.

  • Support procurement transformation initiatives and continuous improvement programmes across the organisation.
jobRequirements:
Qualifications and Experience

  • At least 8 years of relevant procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management experience, with demonstrated experience in leading strategic procurement initiatives in public sector and/or commercial sector.

  • Professional procurement certification such as CPM, CPSM, MCIPS, or equivalent will be an advantage.

  • Experience in managing eSourcing platforms and digital procurement solutions.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong expertise in strategic sourcing, category management, contract management, supplier relationship management, and procurement governance.

  • Advanced knowledge of procurement risk management and supplier evaluation methodologies.

  • Proven ability to develop procurement policies, frameworks, and operating procedures.

Leadership and Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively across all organisational levels.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and sound judgement.

  • Proactive, resilient, and results-oriented with a passion for driving procurement excellence and organisational value.

Key Success Factors

  • The successful candidate will be a strategic procurement leader who can balance governance with business needs, influence stakeholders effectively, leverage data-driven insights, and drive procurement transformation while delivering measurable value to the organisation.

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to translate insights into actionable procurement strategies.

  • Good knowledge of Government Procurement Instructions Manual (GPIM), GeBIZ, and related procurement systems will be advantageous.

Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract in the first instance.

agencyDescription: EDB is the lead government agency responsible for planning & executing strategies to enhance Singapore's position as a global business centre and grow the Singapore Economy. We dream, design and deliver solutions that create value for investors and companies in Singapore. Through that, we attract economic opportunities and jobs for the people of Singapore and help shape our country's economic future.
jobDescription:
About EDB
The Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB), a government agency under the Ministry of Trade and Industry, is responsible for strategies that enhance Singapore’s position as a global centre for business, innovation, and talent. We undertake investment promotion and industry development, and work with international businesses, both foreign and local, by providing information, connection to partners and access to government incentives for their investments. Our mission is to create sustainable economic growth, with vibrant business and good job opportunities for Singapore.

For more information on EDB, please visit www.edb.gov.sg

About Innovation Strategy & Partnerships (ISP)(Corporate Innovation)
ISP, Corporate Innovation is the venture building arm of EDB. Our aim is to support the creation and scaling of high potential new ventures from Singapore to become globally leading businesses. To do so, we are spearheading novel ways of partnering with companies on their corporate venturing journeys and with established global founders as they build their next ventures from Singapore. This includes embarking on joint venture building sprints alongside partner corporates / global founders, supporting corporate-startup partnership initiatives, co-investment with corporates to risk-share early-stage growth of their ventures and active portfolio value creation support to scale each venture.
jobResponsibilities:
Job Responsibilities

This is an individual contributor role, and you will be part of a dynamic team to develop and execute new strategies and initiatives to drive corporate innovation and venturing, with a focus on startup partnerships.

  • Build and cultivate relationships with large corporations and multi-national companies to grow their innovation and venturing activities in Singapore.

  • Design tailored engagements with corporations based on their needs, tapping on whole-of-government offerings, and EDB products and services to create value for clients (e.g. capability building, startup pilots, bespoke incentive packages, non-financial support).

  • Build sound understanding of corporates’ challenges, as well as local, regional, global industry trends and innovation ecosystems, to identify gaps and opportunities.

  • Work with private and public sector partners, multipliers and other ecosystem players, to drive corporate innovation and startup partnerships.

  • Design and spearhead thematic or sector-specific partnering initiatives, in conjunction with other EDB divisions and public / private sector stakeholders, to encourage corporate-startup collaboration in areas of interest.

  • Lead and organise international publicity and marketing activities to drive greater awareness and profiling of corporate innovation and startup partnerships.

  • Design and execute new strategies to deepen Singapore’s value propositions in corporate innovation and startup partnerships.
jobRequirements:
• 4 - 6 years of relevant working experience in strategy development, account management, new business development and / or partnerships

  • Demonstrated ability coordinate multi-stakeholder partnerships and translate strategies into executable outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage and influence senior leaders and diverse stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical ability that can be applied in designing of systems-level programmes, research and understanding of opportunity areas, distillation of qualitative and quantitative data into insights, development and assessment of venture opportunities.

  • Possess the following attributes:

  • Positive, can-do attitude

  • Adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity and change

  • Confident, with high level of resourcefulness

  • Independent, but collaborative team player

  • Strong organisational and time management skills

  • Singaporean.

Good to have

  • Experience in corporate or startup innovation ecosystem (e.g. corporate innovation or incubation, accelerators, venture capital value creation)

  • Practitioners of agile, lean and user-centred design methodologies / market research analysis.

We review applications and interview on a rolling basis. Applicants can expect to receive an application outcome within 8 weeks of application date.

jobDescription: With expertise in quantitative methodologies spanning the entire data lifecycle, the individual will work closely with other business users to enhance understanding of Singapore's visitors, markets and tourism products. jobResponsibilities:
1. Data Analytics

a) Apply statistical techniques to process and analyse datasets. This includes working with large, complex datasets and multiple data sources.

b) Perform data wrangling and transformation to prepare raw data into analysis-ready formats, applying statistical/ data analytics techniques to extract insights from data, and utilising data visualisation tools to communicate findings effectively.

c) Translate complex data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

d) To deliver insights that addresses business questions.

2. Project and Reporting Management

a) Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to manage the data and ensure relevance of data collected, data quality as well as compliance to data management guidelines.

b) Act as a data custodian to key datasets managed by the team, serving as the in-house subject matter expert.

c) Collaborate with stakeholders as relevant to ensure smooth project delivery and implementation.

d) Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as business analysts, product managers, stakeholders to integrate and deploy and transform appropriate data feeds into reports, insights and dashboards on visualisation platforms.

3. Tracking, Stakeholder Management & Advisory

a) Prepare and manage relevant tourism performance data compilation, tracking, reporting and analysis.

b) Understand key business and research outcomes of stakeholders and provide relevant advice and/or support.

c) Provide sound quantitative data advisory, such as in areas of data collection and manipulation approaches, data quality, data management and analysis.

4. Data Capability

a) Lead, manage and drive greater use of data among business users to answer business questions.

b) To share best practices within the organisation with the aim of uplifting data capability.
jobRequirements:
· Trained in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline

· At least 5 years of relevant working experience in data collection, data pre-processing, data wrangling, data analytics and data visualisation, with proven track record in carrying out more advanced data analytics.

· Strong analytical skills with a good eye for detail and possess an aptitude/experience in solving strategic and/or analytical problems using quantitative approaches

· Strong organisation, project and time management skills

· Ability to integrate and synthesise research and/or data across multiple sources to derive meaningful conclusions that are relevant to business needs

· Experience in modelling, creating, editing and publishing dashboards using visualisation tools, such as QlikSense and QuickSight is advantageous

· Ability to communicate clearly complex data/concepts and outcomes of analysis so that learnings can be translated into strategies

· Working experience in managing research and analytics projects

· Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment is advantageous

· Strong presentation and communication skills with ability to express complex ideas in a layman manner

· Mature and comfortable presenting to and interacting with senior management

· Proven track record in engaging stakeholders from within and outside of the organisation

· Strong command of written and spoken English

· Possess statistical knowledge and comfortable working with numbers

· Proficient in data manipulation and usage of analytics tools e.g. R, Python, SQL

· Proficient in Advanced Excel and Power Pivot

jobDescription:
The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.

Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.

You will be a part of HPB’s Healthy Ageing Programme Department, which strives to help older adults to improve and maintain their functional ability through healthy lifestyle practices and increase the quality and years of healthy life. As Singapore’s healthcare and aged care systems transform under national directives such as Healthier SG and Age Well SG, HPB drives the national implementation of the Active Ageing Programme (AAP) strategy in close collaboration with Active Ageing Centres (AACs), Regional Health Systems (RHSes), and whole-of-government agencies to initiate, encourage and empower seniors to adopt and sustain healthy habits, and age well independently through community-based programmes and self-directed initiatives .
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of the Healthy Ageing Programme Department, you will lead the product vision, design and implementation of digital programmes on Healthy 365 to support older adults in building healthy ageing behaviours, with a focus on regular physical activity. You will lead the longer-term product roadmap, set priorities and shape product iterations, engage key stakeholders and ensure alignment with HPB's healthy ageing strategy.

You will translate programme objectives into clear product logic and user journeys, make decisions on feature prioritisation and enhancements, and lead user experience testing to ensure the products remains fit for purpose. Working closely with subject matter experts including physiotherapists and sports science specialists, you will lead the development of curriculum structure and content, ensuring accuracy and safety. You will also work with platform and IT teams to drive user acceptance testing, resolve implementation challenges and ensure launch readiness.

You will assess feature effectiveness, guide product and curriculum decisions, and recommend refinements to support the longer-term vision for the programmes. Beyond your core product role, you will also support the department in monitoring and analysing outcomes across key programmes — including deeper-dive analyses to surface strategic insights and improve programme outcomes.
jobRequirements:
An ideal candidate will be a dynamic and self-motivated individual with at least 5 years of relevant working experience in digital product strategy, product management, service design, or related roles. Experience in healthy ageing and physical activity programming would be advantageous.

The candidate should also possess:

  • A degree in a relevant discipline such as information systems, business, public health, or a related field.
  • Strong product ownership and decision-making skills, with the ability to weigh user needs, operational feasibility and strategic priorities to make sound and timely recommendations.
  • Good understanding of user-centred design principles and behavioural science, with the ability to apply these practically to design product experiences that drive behaviour change.
  • Strong structured thinking and content organisation skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear product logic and communicate it effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with comfort interpreting data, identifying trends and using evidence to guide decisions and prioritisation.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams, align diverse perspectives and drive execution in a fast-moving environment.

Successful candidates will be offered a 1-year contract.

jobResponsibilities:
As a BA/Senior BA, you will be embedded in a product team and play a central role in bridging business needs with technical delivery. Your responsibilities will include:

a)	Requirements and Process Design: You will gather, analyse, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagements. This includes developing a thorough understanding of existing "as-is" workflows to identify inefficiencies and co-designing optimised "to-be" processes. You will translate these requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria that keep product development aligned with business objectives.

b)	Stakeholder and Vendor Management: You will serve as the primary liaison between non-technical business stakeholders (including senior management), IT engineering teams, and third-party vendors. This involves facilitating decision-making, managing competing priorities, communicating trade-offs clearly, and proposing practical implementation options.

c)	Testing and Quality Assurance: You will define test cases, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validate system outputs, and manage defect resolution in close collaboration with the technical team.

As an integral member of a product team, you will also:
•	Provide timely input and clarifications to the development team before and during sprints to ensure shared understanding of requirements, and verify that completed features meet business intent
•	Work with users to develop test scenarios and support UAT
•	Support product showcases to management and channel continuous feedback from business stakeholders back to the development team
•	Monitor post-production performance and track customer feedback to inform product iterations
•	Lead After Action Reviews to surface learning points, identify issues, and drive corrective actions
jobRequirements:
•	At least 4 years of relevant experience across the following areas:

a)	Requirements Gathering — Experience eliciting, analysing, and documenting business and functional requirements using techniques such as interviews, workshops, and surveys.

b)	Stakeholder Management — Demonstrated ability to liaise between non-technical stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendors; facilitate decision-making; manage expectations; and communicate complex ideas to diverse audiences.

c)	Process Improvement — Experience in business process modelling, analysis, and re-engineering, including applying process improvement methodologies to design optimised workflows in the context of system enhancements.

d)	Testing and Quality Assurance — Experience defining test cases, coordinating UAT, validating system outputs, and managing defect resolution with technical teams.

e)	Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) would be advantageous - Demonstrated understanding of how to integrate, govern, and prompt LLMs in a product or delivery context. This includes the ability to translate business problems into AI-ready requirements, and to design effective prompts that generate user stories, surface insights, or automate workflows.

•	Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and vice versa. You should be comfortable with making informed decisions on product direction and feature prioritisation, including pushing back on requests where necessary with clear and reasoned justification.

•	Strong analytical skills — able to break down complex problems, identify patterns, and draw meaningful conclusions from diverse data sources — and ability to quickly pick up new domains, technologies, and methodologies as business needs evolve. 

•	Good interpersonal skills and the ability to manage relationships across a wide range of stakeholders (internal users, management, and vendors).

*PWDs are welcome to apply

agencyDescription:

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.

Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.

You will be a part of HPB’s Healthy Ageing Programmes which strives to help seniors lead healthier and longer lives by improving and maintaining their functional ability through healthy lifestyle practices and social connectedness. With transformation to the healthcare and the aged care system brought about by national directives such as Healthier SG and Age Well SG, HPB will need to foster closer collaborations with other parts of the healthcare system including General Practitioners (GPs), Active Ageing Centres (AACs) and Regional Health Systems (RHSes) to encourage seniors to participate in active ageing initiatives, adopt and sustain healthy habits on their own and stay healthy and active.
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of the Healthy Ageing Programmes team, you will support the development and implementation of HPB’s senior volunteer capability and implementation plans to support Active Ageing Programmes (AAPs) in the community as part of the national efforts to encourage and sustain senior social participation through curated volunteering opportunities. This will include working with partners to develop and operationalise meaningful volunteer opportunities that enable seniors to conduct community-based AAPs across Active Ageing Centres (AACs) nationwide, and progressively building capability of AACs to independently design, implement and sustain physical activity initiatives of their own.

You will support the development of practical training curriculum, learning resources and implementation guides for senior volunteers to be equipped with the skills and confidence to support volunteer-led low-barrier physical activities like brisk walking activities and simple exercise workouts. The training approach will be informed by the competencies required for various volunteer opportunities and designed to accommodate the diverse backgrounds and capabilities of senior volunteers, ensuring they are implementable by seniors with varying levels of experience.

You will collaborate with stakeholders like AACs, local Institutes of Higher Learning (IHL) and Regional Health Clusters — to co-develop volunteer opportunities and access capability requirements to support the implementation of volunteer-led programmes in the community, aligned with national senior volunteering initiatives and roll out plans. You will also work with partners to identify future capability needs and implementation models that would enable AACs to independently recruit, train and deploy volunteer-led physical activity programmes.

You will contribute to capability development efforts by translating policy intent into practical and meaningful volunteer opportunities in the community, whilst enabling AACs and community partners with capabilities to independently design and sustain physical activity initiatives. Through this, you will support HPB’s mission to extend healthy life years through national directives under Age Well SG and Healthier SG, enabling residents to age-in-place and enjoy better quality of life.
jobRequirements:
An ideal candidate will be a self-motivated individual with at least 3-5 years of working experience in programme development and implementation, and learning and development. Prior experience working with senior populations or in the health, social or community care sectors is preferred. Experience in community engagement, volunteer management and working with vendors would be an advantage. The candidate should also possess:

  • A degree in Social Work, Public Health, Human Resources, Education, Psychology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and their application to volunteer capability building initiatives, particularly for senior populations with diverse backgrounds and capabilities.
  • Strong collaborative and stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence in working across multidisciplinary teams and with external partners.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining focus on long-term strategic outcomes.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to distil complex concepts clearly and concisely for different target audiences including seniors, community partners and government stakeholders.

Successful candidates will be offered a 1-year contract

jobTitle: Senior / Health Policy Analyst (Finance Partnerships & Governance - IP)
agencyDescription:
The Ministry of Health’s (MOH) vision is to champion a healthy nation with our people – to live well, live long and with peace of mind. As an open country constantly exposed to an interconnected world, Singapore faces complex issues in public healthcare. MOH constantly grapples with new challenges brought on by an increasingly globalised world, a rapidly ageing population and rising expectations. MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.
jobDescription:
You will be working with a team to formulate, review, and implement policies relating to Integrated Shield Plans (IPs) and riders, with the objective of ensuring that private health insurance remains a sustainable pillar of healthcare financing and does not contribute to healthcare cost escalation arising from over-consumption, over-servicing, and over-charging. At the same time, you will help ensure that IPs and riders keep up with medical advancements.

You will be working in a fast-paced and challenging environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders at the same time.
jobResponsibilities:
You will:

1.	Review policies governing IP and rider benefits and coverage, including ensuring improving the design of such benefits shape the desired consumer behaviour and work with the rest of the national healthcare financing framework to contain healthcare cost growth. This will have to be done in collaboration with both public and private sector stakeholders, including healthcare providers and private insurers. 

2.	Ramp up public understanding of IPs and other healthcare financing schemes to help consumers make informed healthcare decisions, as well as assess and address public appeals and feedback on healthcare financing schemes.

3.	Develop, monitor, and analyse health insurance statistics for policy reviews, annual Committee of Supply debates, and Parliamentary discussions and to promote consumer transparency.
jobRequirements:
Key Competencies Required:

•	Thinking Clearly & Making Sound Judgements – Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations; ability to grasp timelines, operating context and ground realities.

•	Learning & Putting Skills into Action - Possesses the drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge and new ways of working.

•	Improving & Innovating – Ability to seek continual improvements, and to innovate and experiment while managing the risks involved. 

•	Working Effectively with Stakeholders – Ability to mobilise and rally partners and stakeholders towards a collective purpose.

•	Design for implementation and communications – Develop policy that factors in strategic communications considerations upfront and has a grounded perspective of implementation considerations. 

•	Systems thinking – Connect issues with larger system and identify inter-dependencies across issues and domains.

•	Degree in any discipline; background in economics or life/biomedical/health sciences would be an advantage.

•	Prior experience in healthcare sector, insurance sector or a policy-related role is an advantage 

•	Good quantitative skills and data literacy, with knowledge of Excel; Experience with Stata or SQL is an advantage

•	Good writing and communication skills

agencyDescription: Sentosa Development Corporation (SDC) was established on 1 September 1972 as a Statutory Board under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. From business conventions to beach parties, Sentosa caters to an extensive range of needs and interests. SDC has evolved and grown over the years. It currently oversees the following business and commercial units – Sentosa Leisure Management Pte Ltd, Sentosa Golf Club, Sentosa Cove Resort Management Pte Ltd and Mount Faber Leisure Group.
jobDescription:
Sentosa is Singapore's island resort getaway and one of the nation's best-loved leisure destinations, a place woven into the country's shared memories for more than five decades. It is also on the cusp of the greatest transformation in its history: the Greater Sentosa Master Plan will progressively reimagine the island over the next two decades, strengthening its identity as Singapore's “Island Playground and Sanctuary in a Global City.”

As Senior Manager, Brand, you lead how Sentosa shows up in the world and turn brand strategy into experiences guests can feel. You hold the brand standard across everything the team creates, you bring marquee partners into the Sentosa world in ways that raise the island's appeal, and you help transform on-island spaces into experiences worth returning for.

You lead a small, high-craft brand team and develop a Deputy Manager alongside you. The role asks for someone equally comfortable holding a room of senior partners and holding the line on a brand principle. You are a brand builder who works in the details and stands behind the decisions.
jobResponsibilities:
The Senior Manager, Brand, leads the stewardship and elevation of the Sentosa brand across the island experience. Together with a Deputy Manager, this role forms the brand team that acts as guardian of the brand – holding a consistent, best-in-class brand standard across everything the Marketing & Guest Experience (MGX) division creates, on and off the island.

The role carries three connected mandates: overall brand governance, brand partnerships that build brand visibility and desirability, and the transformation of on-island spaces into distinctive, return-worthy experiences. As Sentosa progresses the Greater Sentosa Master Plan, the brand must stay true to the soul and identity of the island while shaping the next generation of world-class experiences, deepening its appeal to Singaporeans and visitors alike. Reporting to the Head of Brand & Product Marketing, the role operates within a shared brand-governance framework alongside the international and commercial partnerships lead, ensuring one coherent brand across the full portfolio. The measure of success is a Sentosa brand that locals feel ownership of, and partners want to be part of.

Brand Governance & Stewardship

  • Act as guardian of the Sentosa brand, upholding a consistent and best-in-class brand standard across all on- and off-island marketing, partnerships, and guest touchpoints.

  • Own the brand framework – positioning, promise, voice, and visual identity, translating it into clear, usable guidance that raises the quality of work across the division.

  • Operate within a shared brand-governance framework with the international and commercial partnerships lead, maintaining one coherent brand across the full partnership portfolio.

  • Bring brand judgement to strategic decisions, holding the line on brand principles even under commercial or operational pressure.

Brand Partnerships for Brand Visibility

  • Originate and lead the on-island and experiential brand partnership portfolio, namely marquee, consumer-facing partners that elevate the brand and drive desirability, footfall, and cultural relevance.

  • Assess and shape partnerships against the divisional selection criteria (Reach and Brand Alignment as essentials, plus at least two of Brand Love, Clout, and Legacy), ensuring every partnership is true to the brand and elevates it.

  • Represent Sentosa with marquee partners and senior stakeholders, holding high-value relationships independently and with presence.

  • Turn signature partnerships into repeatable playbooks and case studies that strengthen future partnership pitches.

On-Island Space Transformation

  • Lead the reimagining of on-island spaces into distinctive, brand-led experiences that give Singaporeans and visitors compelling reasons to return, across different times of the day and seasons of life.

  • Partner across divisions to translate brand thinking into physical placemaking, activations, and guest experiences that express the brand promise.

  • Drive the improvement and automation of the on-island review and booking experience, streamlining how guests discover and access island experiences.

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and develop a Deputy Manager, building brand craft, campaign-planning capability, and delivery discipline within the brand team.

  • Manage brand campaigns end-to-end – from strategic brief through execution to post-campaign evaluation – with clear objectives, KPIs, and timelines.

  • Manage brand and partnership budgets with financial rigour, optimising spend to maximise brand impact and return.
jobRequirements:
• At least 10 years of brand and marketing experience, with a proven record of building and stewarding a brand and leading a team in a supervisory capacity.

  • Demonstrated success originating and closing high-value brand partnerships, ideally with global or lifestyle brands.

  • Strong brand judgement and instinct for cultural relevance, with a feel for why a partnership or idea is right for the brand beyond the numbers.

  • The presence to hold a senior room independently, driving conversations and stakeholder relationships without needing to be prompted.

  • Experience developing talent and holding a high standard while bringing the best out of a team.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and comfort operating in a matrixed environment with shared governance across teams.

  • Experience in destination, hospitality, lifestyle, attractions, integrated-resort marketing or FMCG.

  • Familiarity with placemaking, experiential activations, or physical brand expression.

  • An existing network within Singapore's tourism, lifestyle, or creative-agency ecosystem.

jobDescription: As members of our Security Operations Centre (SOC) Team, you will be at the forefront of cybersecurity defence, playing a critical role in safeguarding HDB's ICT infrastructure. Whether delivering timely and actionable threat intelligence to help the organisation anticipate, detect and respond effectively to evolving cyber threats, or engineering and maintaining a robust security operations capability by equipping the SOC with the right tools, platforms and technologies, you will be an integral part of a team dedicated to keeping HDB's digital environment secure.
jobResponsibilities:
Cyber Threat Intelligence Analysis

  • Continuously review and enhance the cyber intelligence framework to provide a systematic and organized framework for collecting, processing, and leveraging intelligence to enhance HDB's cybersecurity posture and decision-making capabilities.

  • Integrate the cyber intelligence framework with the HDB's Security Operations Centre (SOC) and incident response team and ensure that the intelligence gathered is effectively used to detect, prevent, and respond to cyber threats.

  • Continuously monitor and collect information from multiple sources, including threat intelligence feeds, security vendors, dark web forums, social media, and other online platforms, to identify emerging cyber threats and attack trends.

  • Analyse the collected threat intelligence data to identify patterns, trends, and potential cybersecurity risks.

  • Prioritize and triage threats based on their relevance and potential impact to HDB.

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of threat actors, their motivations, capabilities, and tactics, and provide insights on potential risks and impacts to the organization's systems, networks, and data.

  • Produce regular and ad-hoc reports, briefings, and alerts on emerging threats, trends, and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management, incident response teams, and other cybersecurity teams. The report shall also provide technical information in a clear and actionable format for various stakeholders.

  • Provide timely and accurate intelligence support on a rostered 24/7 standby duty, and when activated during security incidents, assist incident response teams in understanding the nature and scope of the threat, and provide guidance on containment, remediation and recovery strategies.

  • Support vulnerability management efforts by analysing threat intelligence data to identify vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and potential targets, and prioritize patching and mitigation activities.

SOC Engineering

  • Research and evaluate new and emerging security tools, platforms and technologies, and assess their technical feasibility and suitability for integration into the organisation's existing security infrastructure and workflows.

  • Liaise with product vendors to conduct Proof-of-Concept (POC) and technical evaluation of security tools, platforms and technologies.

  • Responsible for the procurement and implementation of security tools, platforms and technologies.

  • Perform knowledge transfer, prepare documentation, and hand over the operations of newly implemented security tools, platforms and technologies to the Security Operations team.

Process Innovation and Automation

  • Design and refine SOC processes and procedures to enhance operational efficiency and reduce response times.

  • Implement automation and artificial intelligence solutions to optimise SOC operations, improve threat detection and response capabilities.

Professional Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in diverse SOC activities including security monitoring, threat hunting and incident response to broaden your expertise and accelerate career development within HDB's growing cybersecurity function.
jobRequirements:
• Have demonstrable experience and in-depth knowledge in cyber threat intelligence analysis and SOC engineering.

  • Possess strong experience with various cybersecurity technologies including IDS/IPS, firewalls, SIEM platforms, email security, web security, cloud security, and endpoint security solutions.

  • Have at least 2 years of experience as an engineer and/or cyber intelligence analyst in a SOC environment or equivalent cybersecurity engineering/operations role.

  • Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Can work effectively under pressure, meet critical deadlines, and make sound decisions during security incidents.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Have experience in cyber intelligence analysis, implementation of security monitoring and detection solutions, and project management.

  • Hold professional certifications such as EC-Council Certified Threat Intelligence Analyst (CTIA), SIEM, SOAR and XDR/EDR product certifications, or other relevant cybersecurity qualifications.

Good to Have:

  • Knowledge of cloud security frameworks and experience with modern security orchestration tools.

Established in 2001, the Health Promotion Board’s (HPB) vision is to build a nation of healthy people.

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.

Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.[TV2.1]
You will be a part of HPB’s Preventive Health Programmes & Rewards Division, specifically within the Rewards Department, where you will play an integral role in driving, designing and/or implementing reward-based initiatives that inspire Singapore residents to embrace healthier lifestyles, thereby advancing HPB's vision of "A Nation of Healthy People".
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of the Rewards Department, you will serve as the Business Development Manager responsible for the following strategic areas:

Business Development: You will serve as the authoritative voice on rewards management, guiding internal divisions and external stakeholders on the strategic and responsible use of Healthpoints, vouchers and non-monetary rewards. You will evaluate and approve reward use cases proposed by internal stakeholders, healthcare clusters and public agencies, balancing programme objectives, policy alignment, user impact and risk considerations. You will also drive new rewards-related initiatives from conceptualisation to operationalisation, while ensuring robust governance, documentation, risk and audit controls.

Customer Care Management: You will lead the customer support function, working with the Customer Support team to oversee outsourced agents to ensure consistent service delivery across all communication channels. You will own escalation management, drive improvements to user satisfaction metrics, and maintain governance oversight of customer support platforms.

User Experience Management: You will place users at the heart of every design decision, championing a human-centred approach that ensures the Healthy 365 in-app rewards experience is intuitive, meaningful, and reflective of the rewards programme's brand identity. By providing strategic direction to UI/UX teams and outsourced vendors, you will drive continuous improvements grounded in user research, feedback, and behavioural insights. Beyond the app itself, you will collaborate closely with marketing and programme teams to ensure a coherent rewards experience is carried through consistently across all external stakeholder initiatives, so that users encounter a seamless and trustworthy journey at every interaction.

Budget & Process Management: You will oversee budget tracking and marksmanship, provide regular updates on project roadmaps and KPI performance, and proactively identify improvements to rewards fulfilment and customer support processes. You will work with data, technology and programme teams to analyse reward usage trends, translate insights into strategic recommendations, and ensure adequate risk mitigation and audit controls across key work processes.

jobDescription: [LTA-PT] DEPUTY / MANAGER, BUS INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT
jobResponsibilities:
Play a pivotal role in transforming our public transport landscape by spearheading the development of bus infrastructure, including integrated transport hubs, bus interchanges and bus depots.

Working alongside government agencies, planners, technical professionals, and public transport operators, you will lead the strategic planning, review, and development of critical bus infrastructure projects that will shape the future of public transport in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities Include:

1. Planning and Site Assessment

Collaborate with planners and relevant agencies to identify and assess the suitability of sites for bus infrastructure. Coordinate the development of the bus infrastructure design, assess commuter connectivity requirements and identify necessary traffic improvements to ensure comprehensive infrastructure coverage around the development.

2. Project Management and Design Oversight

Lead project management activities to ensure target milestones are met. Work closely with developers, contractors and project teams to resolve issues arising during development by conducting regular design reviews and progress meetings. Ensure designs are fit for purpose, operations and maintenance friendly and provide pleasant commuter as well as staff experiences.

3. Stakeholder Coordination and Funding

Work with relevant divisions to obtain funding approval for infrastructure development and prepare the necessary tender documents. Drive consultations and engagements with relevant stakeholders, including public transport operators, to safeguard design provisions to ensure operational and maintainability needs are met.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge in Engineering or Project Management.

  • Strong analytical thinking, communication excellence, leadership abilities, and compelling presentation skills that inspire confidence and drive results.

  • Possess strong accountability, initiative, and resourceful problem-solving capabilities who thrives both as an independent contributor and collaborative team member.

  • We welcome applications from experienced professionals who are ready to launch their careers in shaping our transport infrastructure.

agencyDescription: The mission of the Singapore Land Authority is to optimise land resources for the economic and social development of Singapore. jobDescription: Support the enhancement and updating of SLA’s High-Resolution Map (HRMap) by developing methods to automate the discovery, detection, and collection of publicly available geospatial information. The intern will review existing HRMap layers and identify datasets that can be continuously monitored (e.g. new buildings, MRT stations, roads, and facilities). The intern will develop proof-of-concept workflows using web crawling, data extraction, and AI/LLM techniques to capture and structure update signals from public sources. In addition, the intern will enhance existing systems to detect building-level changes (e.g. new construction, demolition, redevelopment, or address updates) and support automated updates to the HRMap building layer. This project aims to improve data currency, reduce manual maintenance effort, and strengthen automated change detection capabilities for national mapping.
jobResponsibilities:
• Review HRMap datasets to identify candidates for automated change detection. ​
  • Develop web crawling and data extraction workflows from public information sources.
  • Apply AI/LLM techniques to extract structured geospatial change information from unstructured text (e.g. news, announcements).
  • Design and prototype logic for detecting building and infrastructure changes (e.g. new, modified, or removed features).
  • Validate extracted data and prepare structured outputs for HRMap integration.
  • Document workflows, methodologies, and findings.
jobRequirements:
• Pursuing tertiary qualifications in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Geomatics, or related fields.
  • Basic programming skills in Python.
  • Interest in web scraping, data engineering, AI/LLMs, or geospatial technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work both independently and in a team.
  • Relevant coursework or academic projects related to the role
  • Initiative to seek feedback and continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Able to commit between August 2026 to February 2027 or September 2026 to March 2027.
  • Please include your availability in your CV.
