agencyDescription:
The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is a uniformed organisation under the purview of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The main role of SCDF is to provide fire-fighting, rescue and emergency ambulance services; mitigating hazardous materials incidents, as well as formulate, implement and enforce regulations on fire safety and civil defence shelter matters.

In 1982, the National Civil Defence Plan was launched which spearheaded the emergency preparedness for the nation. With the enactment of the Civil Defence Act in 1986, the SCDF was established as an independent organisation under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). In the same year, the Hotel New World collapse paved the way for joint operations between the SCDF and Singapore Fire Service (SFS). Due to the similarity in roles and functions, the SCDF and SFS were formally integrated on 15 April 1989.

Over the years, the SCDF has improved its life saving operations through innovations and programmes to enhance her fire-fighting, rescue capabilities and public education plans. The Light Fire Attack Vehicle (The Red Rhino) and Tracked Fire-Fighting Vehicle are some of the customized solutions which the force has developed to increase its operational capabilities. The SCDF also actively engages the local community through its wide-ranging public educational programmes and community-based activities to enhance the resilience and emergency preparedness of the civilian population.

Today, the Force is recognised by the population as a professional body of well-trained officers and men geared to respond to all types of life-threatening emergencies round-the-clock. An operationally ready SCDF, working hand-in-hand with a prepared and resilient population, helps to ensure that the nation is capable of handling any untoward eventualities.

HTX is Singapore's Science and Technology agency that brings together diverse scientific and engineering capabilities to develop transformative, operationally ready solutions for public safety. As a statutory board under the Ministry of Home Affairs, HTX works at the forefront of science and technology to empower the Home Team with cutting-edge capabilities. Guided by our mission to amplify, augment and accelerate the Home Team's advantage, we are committed to keeping Singapore the safest place on planet Earth.

Being part of 3i, they are the technology development domain of RAUS CoE focuses on advancing robotics and unmanned systems through innovative research, design, and development. Within this domain, the embodied AI R&D pillar integrates cutting-edge AI models into robotic platforms, enabling seamless interaction with the physical world. The role involves designing robot planners for autonomous task execution, developing robot skills for Home Team operations, and managing datasets for AI model training. Key responsibilities include optimizing embodied AI systems through advanced techniques like reinforcement learning, Sim2Real transfer, and domain randomization, while leveraging high-accuracy physics and rendering engines. 

In addition, the role includes deploying these systems in real-world environments, ensuring scalability, robustness, and continuous performance enhancements based on operational feedback.
jobResponsibilities:
-Develop algorithms that enable robots to perceive their environment, process sensory data and make decisions in real time. 
-Implement machine learning models such as reinforcement learning, or imitation learning to train robot for specific tasks.
-Implement grounding on embodied AI systems to ensure high level reasoning is accurately transformed into physical actions.
-Design and integrate AI model with robotic hardware, including sensors, actuators and control systems.
-Develop and fine-tune robot planners that translate task plans into actionable motions and control systems.
-Ensure embodied AI system adhere to hardware constraints and respond efficiently to dynamic environments.
-Deploy AI models onto physical robots, ensuring that they can scale and perform reliably across different platforms and operational scenarios.
-Monitor the performance of embodied AI systems in real-world environments and iterate for continuous improvement
jobRequirements:
-Tertiary Education in engineering; preferably Degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Mechatronics / Robotics/ Computer Science / Artificial intelligence (AI) or related fields
-Post-graduate degree would be an advantage.
-A strong academic and research background in robotics or AI would be an added advantage.
-Minimum of 2 years’ experience in robotics, AI or related fields.
-Good understanding of machine learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, sensor fusion, robotics simulation (e.g., Issac SIM, MuJoCo), and model deployment.
-Experience in developing robotics involving sensor fusion and AI would be an added advantage.
-Excellent team player.
-Self-motivated and committed with a sense of urgency to deliver the desired outcome.
-Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines as well as result oriented.
-A creative, problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate technical challenges and uncertainty.
-Strong analytical, planning and project management skills. PMP, system engineering or equivalent certification would be an advantage.

As a statutory board under the Ministry of Home Affairs, HTX works at the forefront of science and technology to empower the Home Team with cutting-edge capabilities. Guided by our mission to amplify, augment and accelerate the Home Team's advantage, we are committed to keeping Singapore the safest place on planet Earth.

This role reports to the Head of Maritime Systems (MS) under the Robotics, Automation, and Unmanned Systems Centre of Expertise (RAUS CoE), who is responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining the Unmanned Maritime Systems (UMS) capability for the Home Team Departments (HTDs).

The job holder will perform capability development work, either through agile development or Systems Engineering, in collaboration with key strategic partners. He/she will be required to translate proof-of-concept solutions into viable operational capabilities, and conduct Operational Test & Evaluation (OT&E) to validate the final products before transitioning them into operational systems. The job holder must ensure that all products that pass OT&E are integrated into operational systems, either via mid-life upgrades or as part of next-generation platforms and systems.

Additionally, the job holder will be responsible for the deployment and sustainment of UMS for HTDs. He/she must ensure that the delivered UMS capabilities achieve the desired outcomes of the Ops-Tech Masterplan and support Day 1 delivery programmes to meet operational needs on time. The role also involves overseeing Day 2 operations to ensure that the Home Team’s UMS fleet is well-maintained, highly available, and experiences minimal downtime.
jobResponsibilities:
-Deliver, deploy and maintain UMS for HTDs
-Perform the system integration of multi-variate components, e.g., platforms, sensors, mission payloads, autonomy and Command, Control & Communication (C3) systems etc.
-Liaise and work with multiple stakeholders (i.e. ops users, collaborators and vendors etc) to deliver projects, ensuring that the budget, requirements and schedules are adhered to.
-Manage the sustainment contracts of operational UMS and ensure operational systems go through proper maintenance regime throughout the in-service period.
-Provide regular updates to senior management on project progress, highlighting project milestones, issues and expenditure.
-Translate MS technology from multi-year R&T (TRL 4 to 7) programme workstreams into viable operational capability.
-Conduct OT&E to validate the final articles before transiting into operational systems.
-Ensure proper integration and testing of all hardware and software components as part of OT&E.
-Perform tech insertion into operational systems either via mid-life upgrade or into next generation platforms/systems.
-Work closely with Head DevOps/MS to determine the best approach (buy-vs-build-vs-hybrid) to deliver desired operational capability within the shortest reasonable timeframe. 
-Monitor and ensure timely delivery of milestones for the R&T workstreams.
jobRequirements:
-Minimum of bachelor’s degree in engineering; preferably Degree in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Mechatronics / System Engineering / Computer Science (Post-graduate degree would be an advantage)
-Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in project and technology management, preferably with MS experience
-No experience welcome to apply
-Preferably with basic knowledge of cybersecurity governance best practices and implementation
-Preferably with basic knowledge of communication/datalink/networks
-Preferably with practical experience in applying systems engineering methodology to develop large and complex systems
-Good communication skills and excellent team player
-Self-motivated and committed with a sense of urgency to deliver the desired outcome 
-Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines as well as result oriented
-Strong analytical, planning and project management skills. PMP, system engineering or equivalent certification would be an advantage

All new hires are appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance and will be assessed and considered for permanent tenure over time, based on performance.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be updated on the status of their applications within 4 weeks upon closing of the advertisement.

jobDescription: [LTA-T&ID] MANAGER / DEPUTY / ASSISTANT MANAGER, DEPLOYMENT OPS (CENTRE FOR AUTONOMOUS MOBILITY)
jobResponsibilities:
The Centre for Autonomous Mobility (CAM) leads Singapore’s national effort to deploy autonomous vehicles (AVs) safely and at scale. AVs will reshape how Singapore moves — across use cases spanning passenger cars, public buses and goods vehicles. In the Deployment Ops team, you take each AV deployment from plan to operating service – owning the programme schedule, driving delivery across workstreams, and managing the operators, developers, infrastructure stakeholders, to ensure AVs are deployed smoothly.

Plan and manage each deployment programme

  • Work with operators and developers to evaluate, review and fine-tune service routes and concepts of operations.
  • Build and own the programme plan, schedule and milestones for each AV deployment, tracking progress against baseline and reporting status.
  • Identify risks, dependencies and bottleneck early, to develop mitigation plans to keep deployments on track.
  • Align deployment operational plans with longer-term AV deployment strategy and transport plans, so that AV services improve overall transport connectivity.

Drive deployment operations on the ground

  • Run deployments end to end — from planning through AV applications, vehicle approvals, testing and service launch — keeping multiple workstreams on tight timelines.
  • Work with industry and technology partners to resolve issues quickly and get vehicles tested and deployed on schedule.
  • Oversee operational readiness and develop standard operating procedures for the smooth running of AV services once launched – monitor performance, surface issues, manage incidents, and drive continuous improvement.

Coordinate across stakeholders

  • Bring together industry players, operators, government agencies and internal teams, aligning their requirements, securing their support, and resolving operational issues.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications, industry media teams and CAM’s Engagement team to align public announcements and high-signature events around key deployment milestones.

Communicate deployment progress to leadership

  • Prepare clear progress reports on deployment plans, and statuses for senior management, including distilling complex operational detail into clear recommendations.

If you’re excited by public service, and the challenge of putting genuinely transformative technology on the road for the wider public, we want to hear from you.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge preferably in Engineering or a related field.
  • Hands-on programme management and project planning.
  • Experience in operations management, contracts or vendor management.
  • Has a strong programme or project management track record
  • At least 2 years planning and delivering medium-to-large-scale projects or programmes.
  • Organised and meticulous — comfortable owning detailed plans, tracking progress against baseline, and keeping many moving parts on schedule while working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Works well across stakeholders — listens, builds alignment across cross-functional teams and external partners, and drives to outcomes independently while having the right instincts to know when to escalate for decision-making.
  • Communicates clearly — writes and reports well, with an eye for detail.
  • Takes initiative and stays calm in ambiguity — AV deployment is new ground, so plans will change and you’ll help shape them.

jobDescription:
Join a team reimagining the future of our digital services. We are transforming OneMotoring into an intelligent Digital Shopfront that makes every interaction simpler, faster, and more delightful. Powered by AI, it will thoughtfully augment how digital services are designed, delivered and experienced, creating the next-generation platform that keeps your world moving.

As Senior Developer, AI Applications, you will design and build the AI features that make the platform intelligent, and the backend integrations that bridge data insights from across many backend systems. You will turn AI concepts into reliable products that work in production.
jobResponsibilities:
What You’ll Do

  • Build secure integrations: Design and implement well-defined API connections to data vaults and legacy systems. Apply suitable authentication, caching and error-handling patterns to make older systems safe and reliable for modern use.

  • Embed AI in applications: Design the AI-assisted components that help turn plain-language descriptions into digital touchpoints, workflows, and configurable services.

  • Engineer the retrieval layer: Design how the platform retrieves and grounds information for AI features, including embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines. Ensure AI responses are accurate, explainable, and useful.

  • Review vendor AI approaches: Enforce the engineering bar for vendor-delivered AI applications. Review pull requests, AI pipelines, and guardrails, and work with the engineering team to ensure accuracy, security, and maintainability are upheld.

  • Make AI reliable in production: Build monitoring, evaluation, and guardrails around AI features. Build stakeholder confidence by detecting model underperformance, validating outputs, and designing graceful fallbacks when AI cannot provide a reliable answer.

  • Work across the platform: Partner with technical teammates to ensure AI features and backend integrations fit cleanly into the wider architecture and system design.

  • Own your features end to end: Track how features perform after launch. Use usage data to refine the AI pipeline until they deliver meaningful value for users.
jobRequirements:
About You

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a backend or full-stack engineer, including at least 2 years building applied AI features used by real users.

  • You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs, including prompt design, semantic search, function calling, and structured output parsing.

  • You understand retrieval-augmented generation concepts. You know when retrieval is the right solution and when it is not, and how to improve context accuracy.

  • You treat AI safety and reliability as core engineering work. Hallucination handling, output validation, evaluation, and graceful degradation are built into how you work.

  • You can navigate a full-stack development environment in Python alongside a modern frontend framework. You are comfortable working with developers to embed AI in systems.

  • You understand how systems talk to each other. You can confidently work with middleware and API gateways to wrap legacy systems safely for modern consumption.

  • You have solid application security foundations, including compliance, OWASP, and zero-trust secure application design. You build with security in mind from the start.

  • You are comfortable turning rough product ideas into technical designs. You do not settle and keep improving the system until you would trust the result yourself.

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.

jobDescription: The candidate will oversee fire safety and workplace safety and health (WSH) matters across URA's buildings and facilities at the Marina Bay Area and the Common Service Tunnel. You will oversee the delivery of fire safety and workplace safety and health services, and ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, contractual obligations and organisational policies. Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. It maintains an oversight of national cybersecurity functions and works with sector leads to protect Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure. jobResponsibilities:
Responsibilities 

1. Office Management and Digitalisation 

Support broader office transformation and continuous improvement initiatives, including cross-functional projects that enhance productivity, service quality, and employee experience.  

• Serve as the primary point of contact and project lead for office management digitalisation and transformation initiatives, overseeing projects from conceptualisation and planning through implementation and post-implementation review.  

• Identify, evaluate, and recommend digitalisation opportunities to streamline office management processes, reduce manual work, improve service delivery and enhance overall operational efficiency.  

• Conduct end-to-end reviews of existing workflows, processes and systems, identify operational gaps and inefficiencies, and develop appropriate digital or process improvement solutions.  

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, technology teams, vendors and external service providers to gather requirements, define project scope, coordinate implementation, and ensure alignment with operational needs.  

• Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables, proactively monitoring progress and addressing issues to ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines and requirements.  

• Coordinate user requirements gathering, system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), implementation and rollout of new digital solutions and enhancements.  

• Facilitate change management and user adoption, including the development of user guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), communications, and training where required.  

• Monitor the effectiveness of implemented solutions and conduct post-implementation reviews to assess outcomes, identify areas for further improvement and ensure intended operational benefits are achieved.  

• Maintain proper project documentation, records, process maps and implementation materials to support governance, knowledge management and business continuity.  

• Keep abreast of emerging technologies, automation tools and digital solutions that could enhance office management operations and recommend suitable applications where appropriate.  

• Undertake other digitalisation, transformation and office management-related duties as assigned. 

 

2. Business Continuity Planning 

Support the organisation’s response and business continuity efforts, with specific responsibility for office management, logistics and administrative readiness.  

• Participate in and support agency BCP exercises, including planning, coordination, execution and post-exercise review activities.  

• Serve as part of the BCP for Logistics coordinating office management-related logistics and resources required to support emergency operations and response activities.  

• Develop and maintain appropriate operational procedures, checklists and contingency arrangements to ensure office management functions can respond effectively during emergencies.  

• Assess and plan for emergency office supply and resource requirements, ensuring sufficient stock levels and timely availability of essential supplies to support operational needs.  

• Manage the procurement, storage, inventory and replenishment of emergency supplies, including regular stock checks and monitoring of expiry dates or replacement requirements, where applicable.  

• Develop and maintain an appropriate inventory and tracking system for emergency supplies to strengthen accountability, visibility and readiness.  

• Plan, administer and monitor business continuity budgets and funds, ensuring appropriate utilisation, financial accountability and compliance with prevailing procurement and financial procedures.  

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders, relevant agencies, vendors and service providers to ensure timely mobilisation and provision of office management resources during emergency situations.  

• Provide timely status updates, reports and escalation of resource requirements to the Reporting Officer (RO), management and relevant agencies to facilitate informed decision-making and operational response.  

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date business continuity documentation, including inventory records, procurement records, contact lists, procedures and other operational information.  

• Conduct periodic readiness checks and reviews of office management emergency resources and arrangements and recommend improvements to address identified gaps or changing operational requirements.  

• Participate in post-exercise and post-incident reviews, document lessons learnt and implement follow-up actions to strengthen future preparedness and response capabilities.  

• Support business continuity and recovery activities relating to office operations to facilitate the timely resumption of essential workplace functions following an emergency or disruption.  

• Undertake other business continuity and office management-related responsibilities as assigned.
jobRequirements:
Requirements 

• Tertiary education in the Built Environment, or equivalent. 

• Good communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate effectively with stakeholders. 

• Effective communication and reporting skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence and negotiate with stakeholders. 

• Ability to make informed decisions under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously. 

• Prior working experience in public sector office administration, digitalisation and procurement is an advantage. 

If you share our passion to make a difference in the cyber security landscape, take up the challenge and apply now.  

All applicants will be notified of whether they are shortlisted or not within four weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

jobDescription:
CSIT develops cutting-edge products to safeguard Singapore's national security interests. We are seeking Full Stack Software Engineers to join a specialized team building next-generation analytical platforms designed to drastically reduce threat detection times. In this role, you will go beyond traditional development; you will engineer intelligent automation solutions and AI-powered features that transform raw, high-volume data streams into actionable insights. Your work will directly empower our analysts to detect threats across critical domains, including but not limited to Cybersecurity.

We are not just looking for coders; we are seeking mission-driven engineers who want their technical contributions to have a tangible impact on the safety of our nation.
jobResponsibilities:
• Full-Stack Engineering: Architect, develop, and optimize scalable web applications and high-performance APIs using JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java. You will build systems where latency matters and reliability is non-negotiable.
• AI Feature Integration: Move beyond theory by implementing emerging AI patterns into production. You will deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for precise semantic search, design autonomous agents for complex analytical tasks, and build LLM-driven conversational interfaces that augment human decision-making.
• Data Persistence & Retrieval: Design robust data solutions using MongoDB and Elasticsearch to handle high-volume transactions and standard CRUD operations. You will extend these capabilities with advanced vector search and embedding strategies to power our next-generation AI features.
• Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Ensure the resilience and scalability of our mission-critical applications by managing CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native services to guarantee seamless uptime under pressure.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with UI/UX designers, data engineers, and product managers to deliver seamless, high-quality digital experiences that meet the rigorous needs of analysts.
jobRequirements:
• Background in Computer Science or a related field, with proven hands-on experience in software development.
• Proficiency in building dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React.js and the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem.
• Proven experience building efficient, secure RESTful APIs with frameworks such as Express.js, Fastify, FastAPI, Spring Boot, or equivalent enterprise-grade tools.
• Hands-on experience managing data persistence and search layers using MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, or comparable NoSQL and search engines.
• Familiarity with common design patterns, writing scalable code, and successfully integrating services within complex, distributed systems.

Nice-to-haves:
• Exposure to cloud-native development and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes).
• Hands-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks.
• Prior experience building AI-enabled enterprise platforms, automation systems, or high-traffic applications.
• Familiarity with AI engineering, including integrations, prompt engineering, and embedding strategies.
• Exposure to advanced search architectures, specifically vector search, semantic search, and RAG patterns.

jobTitle: Senior / Health Policy Analyst (Finance Policy – MediShield Life Benefits)
agencyDescription:
The Ministry of Health’s (MOH) vision is to champion a healthy nation with our people – to live well, live long and with peace of mind. As an open country constantly exposed to an interconnected world, Singapore faces complex issues in public healthcare. MOH constantly grapples with new challenges brought on by an increasingly globalised world, a rapidly ageing population and rising expectations. MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.
jobDescription:
You will be part of the team which formulates, reviews and implements policies to develop Singapore’s healthcare financing framework, with a focus on MediShield Life, to keep healthcare affordable and sustainable for all Singaporeans. This role will require you to work collaboratively with policy and clinical groups within MOH, healthcare institutions and other public agencies to develop and implement MediShield Life policies. 

You will be working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
jobResponsibilities:
As part of the MediShield Life team, you will contribute towards 

•	Reviewing MediShield Life benefits to ensure adequate protection against large healthcare bills and sustainable coverage of innovative high-cost technologies, balancing against impact on premiums.  This may require you to:
     o	Analyse claims and utilisation data from a variety of sources to identify gaps and make recommendations to address them. 
     o	Work with MOH divisions to evaluate new models of care, align on service strategies, or assess clinical and cost-effectiveness of medical interventions 
     o	Work with stakeholders overseeing other mainstream financing schemes and private insurance to develop holistic proposals for extension/review of existing financing coverage;
     o	Work closely with the scheme’s actuaries to determine premium impact of any benefit enhancement 
     o	Consult healthcare institutions and clinicians to understand the impact of changes in financing. 

•	Overseeing the implementation of new or revised policies relating to MediShield Life benefits, including working with internal and external stakeholders to enhance claims systems, assessing appeals for coverage, and resolving operational issues arising from claim management.

•	Working with legal stakeholders to draft and effect amendments to legislation that support changes in coverage policy and safeguard leverage on the MediShield Life fund.


Beyond the above, you will also:

•	Contribute to the policy-ops feedback loop, by addressing parliamentary questions and public queries

•	Work with partner agencies and stakeholders to enhance public communications of healthcare financing schemes

•	Provide secretariat support to the MediShield Life Council and its sub-committees in carrying out their functions
jobRequirements:
Key Competencies Required:
•	Thinking Clearly & Making Sound Judgements – Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations; ability to grasp timelines, operating context and ground realities.
 
•	Learning & Putting Skills into Action - Possesses the drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge and new ways of working. 

•	Improving & Innovating – Ability to seek continual improvements, and to innovate and experiment while managing the risks involved. 

•	Working Effectively with Stakeholders – Ability to mobilise and rally partners and stakeholders towards a collective purpose.

Other

•	Tertiary education in any discipline. Background in economics would be advantageous
•	Excellent writing, presentation and negotiation skills, experience in public policy formulation and/or scheme administration in the social sector would be an advantage
•	Strong quantitative skills to analyse data. Proficiency in Stata, Python or R is an advantage, on top of Excel proficiency
•	Motivated and resilient, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

jobDescription: CSIT develops cutting-edge products to safeguard Singapore's national security interests. In this role, you will go beyond traditional data engineering; you will architect intelligent systems that ingest unstructured data, generate vector embeddings, and unlock semantic search capabilities to uncover critical insights from massive datasets. jobResponsibilities:
• Data Pipeline Engineering: Architect, design, and maintain reliable, high-throughput pipelines that ingest, route, and process vast volumes of unstructured data. You will integrate AI models for automated data classification and information extraction, while ensuring latency and throughput meet mission-critical standards.
• Data Transformation & Enrichment: Develop and optimize transformation logic that parses complex content, implements chunking strategies, and generates high-quality vector embeddings for downstream retrieval. You will ensure data is enriched and structured for maximum analytical value.
• Hybrid Retrieval Systems: Build and support robust hybrid indexing systems that seamlessly combine high-speed keyword search with vector-based semantic search. You will engineer solutions that allow analysts to retrieve precise insights from enriched content instantly.
• Multimedia Processing: Engineer scalable solutions for video analysis and image recognition, integrating computer vision models to extract actionable metadata from diverse media formats within our data streams.
• Engineering Excellence: Uphold rigorous data quality and pipeline reliability standards while actively contributing innovative ideas to leverage AI for scaling operations. You will champion best practices in code quality, testing, and system observability.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with frontend engineers, data scientists, and product managers to deliver seamless, high-performance data services that meet the rigorous needs of national security operations.
jobRequirements:
• Background in Computer Science or a related field, with proven hands-on experience in data engineering or software development.
• Experience in building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to process, transform, and validate large datasets.
• Good grasp of data quality principles, pipeline reliability patterns, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-haves:
• Exposure to vector databases, text embedding techniques, LLM integration, or semantic search frameworks (curiosity and a willingness to master AI concepts are highly valued).
• Familiarity with container-based environments (Docker/Kubernetes) and modern CI/CD practices.
• Experience with multimedia processing tools or computer vision libraries.
• Background in handling high-volume, unstructured data in cloud-native environments.

jobResponsibilities:
You will play a pivotal role in strengthening the organisation's cybersecurity posture by designing, operationalising, and governing a robust ICT governance framework across enterprise IT systems and programmes. This encompasses establishing clear policies, standards, and controls that ensure the secure, resilient, and compliant management of the organisation's technology landscape — enabling informed decision-making, accountability, and continuous improvement in an evolving threat environment.

What you will be working on:

You will be responsible for some of the following areas:

· ICT Security Governance:

Develop and implement enterprise-wide ICT security programmes as follows:

i. Establish the cybersecurity governance structure for HDB to ensure that the security posture is robust, resilient, and pragmatic.

ii. Enhance and update the IT security policy, standards, procedures so that it stays relevant against the evolving cyber security landscape.

iii. Manage the compliance with Whole-of-Government (WOG) ICT/SS Security Policies, Initiatives, Measures and applicable Government Instruction Manual to further strengthen HDB ICT security posture.

iv. Establish the governance and administer the Third-Party Management Policy and Procedure.

· Cybersecurity Awareness Outreach

Manage and implement the Cybersecurity Awareness Framework to promote IT security awareness and outreach programme as follows:

i. Raise HDB management and staff’s security awareness on the importance of ICT Security to ensure HDB’s information assets are protected.

ii. Create good staff cyber security hygiene through regular ICT Security outreach programme such as the annual ICT Security Awareness Talk, security advisories, conducting Phishing exercises and road shows.

iii. Identify various channels for the conduct of the security program such as cyber range exercises, technical certification, gamification.

· Identity & Access Management

To establish procedures and standards for the Identity and Access management in HDB as follows:

i. To administer and manage the user accounts and privileged access to safeguard the confidentiality of ICT assets and systems in HDB.

ii. To setup, maintain and manage the access controls to HDB’s applications.

iii. To manage the lifecycle of HDB’s Digital Certificate.

· Quality Audit and Security Reviews

i. To serve as an independent party to ensure the conduct of quality auditing and report to Management on audits observations and recommendations.

ii. To conduct regular security reviews and compliance checks on HDB’s applications and infrastructure to maintain HDB ICT security posture.

You are also to keep pace of the latest industry ICT security practices and technologies as well as emerging threats and vulnerabilities to recommend appropriate controls to improve HDB ICT security posture.
jobRequirements:
You will be a Great Fit if you:

· Possess a strong background and interest in ICT Security, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering (Computing/Telecommunication), Cybersecurity and/or Digital Forensic or equivalent.

· Have strong knowledge and experience in information and cybersecurity risks, controls, vulnerability assessment/penetration testing, compliance, and industry IT/cyber security best-practices.

· Have at least 2 years of direct and relevant full-time ICT security work experience.

· Preferably possess one or more appropriate IT security certifications, such as CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CISA, CEH, etc.

Added advantage for candidates with knowledge in any of the following:

· Domain knowledge on access control; telecommunications and network security; cloud security; Cybersecurity & information security governance and risk management; software development security; cryptography; security architecture and design; operations security; security incident response and management; business continuity and disaster recovery planning; legal regulations, investigations, and compliance; physical (environmental) security.

· Knowledge in IT security principles and IT controls as well as industry best practices and frameworks pertaining to IT Controls (IM8, COBIT, ISO27001/2 etc).

· Good understanding of the current IT/Cyber Security landscape.

Good to Have:

· Good interpersonal and communication skills.

· Demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and have good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with good attention to detail.

· Conduct research on ICT and cybersecurity technologies where necessary to perform the assigned tasks.

· Good command of written and oral English.

MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.

jobTitle: Assistant Manager/ Manager, Integrated Programme (1 year contract)
agencyDescription:
Established in 2001, the Health Promotion Board’s (HPB) vision is to build a nation of healthy people.

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
In our transformative journey towards precision public health, HPB aims to bring healthy living to more diverse population segments and deepen engagement with those who are already participants of HPB and partners’ programmes through a mix of digital and onground activities. Central to this is the Healthy 365 mobile application - Singapore's national digital healthy lifestyle companion, designed to nudge and support healthy behaviours across multiple domains through a continuous and personalised health journey.

You will be a part of HPB’s Integrated Solutions and Programme Planning Office (ISPPO), responsible to plan, manage, co-design and implement innovative population health projects via smart technological solutions such as wearables, artificial intelligence and machine learning. We collaborate across internal and external stakeholders in a multiple-pronged approach in programme offering to pioneer new technology solutions in transforming preventive health & health promotion initiatives.
jobResponsibilities:
The Integrated Programme (IP) Department leverages technology, behavioural insights and data-driven strategies to create shifts from a programme-centric view to a customer-centric view where personalised goals and recommendations will be served on the Healthy 365 mobile app to users. This new shift has emerged in view of HPB’s ambition towards a holistic and personalised digital delivery of lifestyle interventions, and with HealthierSG in supporting residents in following through with their Health Plan recommendations.

The team will have to understand and connect the plans within the Programmes Group, and across Divisions in aligning objectives and outcomes towards goals. Work will cut cross-functionally with domain experts, developers, and marketing teams to design intuitive, engaging, and customer-centric digital experiences. This would involve conducting user research to drive the evolution of our mobile app offerings, ensuring they meet real user needs and deliver business impact.

As a key member the IP Department, you will be responsible to:

  • Support the design, development and implementation of innovative digital programmes that promote healthy lifestyles and user engagement, including proof-of-concepts (POCs) and proof-of-value (POV) initiatives aligned with organisational priorities.
  • Apply behavioural science principles to support programme design, personalisation and behaviour change through evidence-based interventions, including gamification and reward strategies.
  • Develop and support programme evaluation activities by analysing quantitative and qualitative data to measure programme outcomes, user impact and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Engage and coordinate with internal stakeholders, domain experts, technical teams, government agencies and external partners to support programme planning, delivery and implementation.
  • Support project delivery by coordinating project plans, milestones, risks, issues, budgets and stakeholder communications to ensure timely implementation.
  • Participate in solution testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) by validating requirements, tracking issues and supporting implementation readiness.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project records, budget tracking, analytics and evaluation reports to support effective programme governance.
jobRequirements:
Join us if you are a motivated and collaborative individual with minimally 2- 4 years of relevant experience in digital programme management, project coordination, product development or related work. You should be comfortable working across teams, managing multiple priorities and contributing to the development and delivery of digital initiatives that support meaningful user engagement.

You should also possess:

  • Relevant experience in supporting the planning, implementation and evaluation of digital or technology-enabled programmes.
  • Good understanding of agile methodology and project management principles would be advantageous
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, including business, technical and design teams, to support programme delivery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret information and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • Experience in solution testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) or digital implementation activities would be advantageous.

Successful candidates will be offered a 1-year contract

This is an exciting opportunity to solve some of the most critical issues facing preventive health in Singapore today. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to engage senior stakeholders from across the government and businesses, and influence decision making on public health policies. The successful candidate will also work closely with industry and academic experts, as part of the consultation and strategy development process.

The Policy and Strategy Development Division is part of the Policy, Research and Surveillance Group in the Health Promotion Board. The Division’s mission is formulating public health policies and strategies, as HPB progresses beyond promotional approaches to employ regulatory and policy levers to modify health behaviours. Areas of focus include obesity control (food and physical activity), substance abuse (tobacco and alcohol), as well as emerging areas of public health concerns. Specifically, we are looking for someone who can manage the technical aspects of national labelling schemes (e.g. Nutri-Grade).
jobResponsibilities:
• Review and analyse public health findings and market data from a wide range of sources, including ground insights, and develop evidence-based policies and strategies that address public health gaps in the general and targeted populations (e.g. ability to apply technical knowledge to support policy or strategy).

  • Lead in consultations with government agencies, companies and experts, to address key stake holders and their concerns, with the objective of achieving successful and sustainable policy and strategy implementation.

  • Collaborate with regulatory agencies and the industry to operationalize solutions, understanding the business operating environment and be able to translate strategy into actions accordingly, where necessary.

  • Monitor and evaluate policies and strategies to assess impact and review approaches, where necessary, to collaborate with relevant stakeholders e.g. academic institutions and government agencies

  • Foster strategic alliances, both local and international, to support policy advocacy and lead conversations on emerging public health issues.

  • Be able to handle queries from industry and members of public.

  • Meticulous, detailed oriented especially in handling and managing different sources of data and making sense of that.

  • At least 3-5 years of experience in developmental planning and secretariat roles, preferably with public policy experience.

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to identify, define and propose policy solutions for national preventive health problems.

  • Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to maintain strong stakeholder partnerships.

  • Excellent oral and written communication

  • Strong ability to work effectively in an environment that is team focused and across divisions, fluid and fast-paced.

jobTitle: Dty Principal Engineer/Snr Engineer/Exec Engineer (Nuclear Regulatory Ecosystem)
agencyDescription:
The National Environment Agency (NEA) is the leading public organisation responsible for ensuring a clean and sustainable environment for Singapore. Its key roles are to improve and sustain a clean environment, promote sustainability and resource efficiency, maintain high public health standards, provide timely and reliable meteorological information, and encourage a vibrant hawker culture. NEA works closely with its partners and the community to develop and spearhead environmental and public health initiatives and programmes. It is committed to motivating every individual to care for the environment as a way of life, in order to build a liveable and sustainable Singapore for present and future generations.

For more information, visit www.nea.gov.sg
jobDescription:
The Radiation Protection and Nuclear Science Group in the National Environment Agency (NEA) is the national authority for radiation protection in Singapore and serves to protect the public, radiation workers and the environment from the harmful effects of radiation. Its Nuclear Safety Division is responsible for developing capabilities, plans and ecosystems to support national nuclear safety & security assessment, radiological emergency response, and nuclear regulatory development efforts. The division is also responsible for ensuring that Singapore fulfils its obligations to international conventions and agreements with respect to the safe and peaceful use of nuclear material and technology.

Singapore is studying the potential deployment of nuclear energy as part of its long-term energy strategy. Singapore will also need to prepare for the possibility of nuclear power deployment by other countries in the region. These endeavours involve planning and strategizing the development of legal and regulatory infrastructure required for a potential nuclear power programme and building up capabilities in nuclear safety, emergency preparedness and response and radiation protection.

You will be a key member of the team that will play a pivotal role in developing a robust domestic nuclear research and technical support ecosystem to support Singapore’s efforts in studying the safety of nuclear energy.

This is a rare opportunity to be at the forefront of Singapore’s nuclear energy journey.
jobResponsibilities:
Nuclear is a complex and emotive topic, and requires a diverse range of expertise to fully assess its implications for Singapore.

By joining this team, you will have the opportunity to shape Singapore’s nuclear regulatory landscape, collaborate with international experts, and contribute to nuclear safety, security, safeguards and radiation protection capability building efforts domestically and regionally.

You will be involved in:

  • Master planning the development of Singapore’s nuclear research and technical support ecosystems.
  • Developing and coordinating with academic, research, and industrial partners to build nuclear safety, security and safeguards and radiation protection capabilities nationally.
  • Implementing and administering nuclear research funding initiatives.
  • Initiating and participating in audit exercises to ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures for grant management.
jobRequirements:
The job might be for you if you possess:

  • Experience and /or qualifications in Engineering, Research Ecosystem Development and Project Management related fields.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant working experience.
  • Excellent analytical, coordination and communication (written and verbal) skills are critical for this position.
  • Able to communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Able to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Able to work in a team and independently with minimal supervision.
  • Able to work efficiently and meet tight deadlines.
  • A committed team player who is highly meticulous, with a strong interest in shaping Singapore's nuclear regulatory landscape.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.
jobDescription: You will support MND Strategic Planning Division (SPD) in several projects. In particular, there are significant shifts in land planning that need to be made to tighten linkages with our economic strategy, as well as to meet the diverse accommodation needs of Singaporeans and foreigners.
jobResponsibilities:

jobDescription: The Built Environment (BE) sector is integral to the design, construction and maintenance of Singapore’s cityscape and infrastructure. However, the sector will need to confront the existential challenges of global climate change, energy and manpower constraints, changing demographics and values, and ageing infrastructure in the coming years. Addressing these challenges requires the ability to manage the trade-offs between the desired outcomes of greater safety, resiliency, quality, sustainability, liveability and as well as to strike a balance between industry regulation and development/promotion.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of a passionate policy team in MND’s Infrastructure Division which serves as an advocate for businesses within the Built Environment (BE) sector, seeking and acting on suggestions on how rules and regulations imposed on the industry can be improved, saving businesses time, effort and money, while creating a nimble, forward looking and agile regulatory regime. 

You will champion regulatory innovation by steering rules review efforts across the BE sector. This includes staffing our Political Office Holders for the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on Pro-Enterprise Rules Review which reviews cross-cutting regulatory issues across the Whole-of-Government and reduces compliance burden for businesses.  You will also support regulatory reviews to improve productivity across the BE sector, including through the Action Team to Improve Built Environment Productivity chaired by the Minister for National Development. This will involve working with agencies and industry stakeholders to identify regulatory, process and implementation issues that may affect productivity, and propose practical measures to streamline requirements, strengthen coordination and support sector-wide transformation.

Further, you will lead the transformation of the sector through various initiatives, including encouraging digitalisation and adoption of regulatory technologies across the sector.  In your capacity as Secretariat for the BE Rules Review Panel (RRP) chaired by PS/ND, you will work across 11 public agencies that perform regulatory functions in the BE sector.  You will also serve as the deskhead for the Professional Engineers Board, giving you direct exposure to professional development and sector governance. 

Through your work, you will have the exciting opportunity to translate strategic intent and objectives to policy moves and programmes, and work closely with ministries and agencies across the Whole-of-Government.  Depending on your level of seniority and experience, you may be given the opportunity to lead a small team.

agencyDescription:

As an open country constantly exposed to an interconnected world, Singapore faces complex issues in public healthcare. MOH constantly grapples with new challenges brought on by an increasingly globalised world, a rapidly ageing population and rising expectations. MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.
jobDescription: This role is to support the team that oversees the operations of HOusehold Means Eligibility System (HOMES), a central system that supports means-test of government schemes.

jobDescription: This role involves working on a project to review the current taxonomy and file plans to develop a common organisational taxonomy.
jobResponsibilities: The project will involve activities like planning, data collection, construction, and validation, which will deliver the taxonomy that will be maintained by the knowledge management team. Key activities include describing data and information entities, comparing them with the records retention schedule to identify similarities and differences, assigning names to develop standardised nomenclature, and classifying them into a hierarchical structure of groups called taxa. The main deliverable of this project is a revised organisational taxonomy which is robust, comprehensive, and can be updated regularly over time.
jobRequirements: Library and information management skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills.

jobDescription:

jobResponsibilities:
Our Customer Service Department serves as the primary interface between our organisation and CPF members. As part of the Customer Service Team, you will play a crucial role in assisting CPF members in making well-informed decisions about their CPF savings by understanding and addressing their information needs with a professional and compassionate approach. 

In this role, you will:
•	Manage and deliver personalised service to address CPF members' enquiries related to CPF schemes and services through various channels, including but not limited to calls (video calls included), counters, text messaging, contact centres and service centres.
•	Engage with CPF members in an inviting, friendly, and professional manner to deliver exceptional experiences and nurture lasting relationships.
•	Identify and address CPF members’ needs, with a goal of achieving total satisfaction.
jobRequirements:
We value the diverse talents and experiences that each individual brings to the table. While mastery of every requirement may not be necessary, familiarity and expertise in some of the following areas will position you for success within this team.
•	Demonstrates strong customer service to handle inbound and outbound phone calls, email requests, and face-to-face interactions using a friendly, helpful approach.
•	Relevant experience in a call centre environment.
•	Possesses strong communication skills, including active listening and clear articulation.
•	Ability to solve problems, alleviate conflicts, and escalate issues tactfully.
•	Capable of learning quickly and thinking on the spot to resolve any issues with a customer-first business mentality.
•	Ability to provide support, answer questions, and resolve issues efficiently.

The seniority of appointment and actual corporate job title will commensurate with individual work experiences.

We welcome candidates without working experience to apply. To help us better understand your academic background, please provide an official or unofficial copy of your academic transcript, as well as any other relevant documents or certificates that you believe would support your application.

Please be advised that upon initial appointment, the successful candidate will assume the role of Customer Service Associate. The official title of Customer Service Executive will be conferred following the successful completion of our structured modular training.

Position is on a 1-year full-time contract directly under the payroll of CPF Board with an option to renew, contingent upon confirmation and subject to organisational needs. Additionally, there is potential for emplacement into a permanent position.

Your Application Journey
We believe in keeping our hiring process clear, respectful of your time, and focused on helping you put your best foot forward.

1.	Application Review: Submit your CV and our team will review your application.

2.	HR Phone Call: If your profile is suitable, we’ll reach out for a short and friendly phone call to learn more about you and share more about the role.

3.	Online Assessments: Candidates who progress from the phone call will be invited to complete online assessments, including an AI-powered customer service simulation designed to reflect real-life customer interactions.

4.	Interview: Selected candidates will attend an interview with the team and receive a realistic preview of the Customer Service Executive role.

5.	Reference Checks & Offer: We’ll conduct reference checks and extend an offer to successful candidates.

Application Outcome
We’ll update you on the outcome within two weeks of your interview. Successful candidates will be guided through onboarding and warmly welcomed to the team.
What you can expect
Being part of #TeamCPF means embarking on a challenging and rewarding career in a progressive workplace that values productivity and growth. Here’s what awaits you:
•	Opportunities to engage in a mix of formal and informal training, keeping your skills sharp in our ever-evolving technological landscape. 
•	Promotion opportunities based on your capability and on-the-job performance. 
•	A vibrant community of like-minded and friendly colleagues, where collaboration and creativity thrive. 
•	A hybrid work model that offers flexibility for remote work, subject to exigencies of service. 
•	Flexible dress code that empowers you to choose your appropriate outfit for the day. 
•	A comprehensive rewards package that includes annual leave, pro-family leave, medical and dental benefits, and access to recreational activities.

Reporting to the Team Lead, you will be part of a dynamic team of case worker responsible for conducting statutory social investigation and implementing intervention to protect the safety and best interest of individuals, families, children and vulnerable adults (VAs) experiencing violence, abuse or neglect under the Children and Young Persons Act, Vulnerable Adults Act and Women’s Charter.

MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers.   

Guided by our vision of a Singapore where everyone can grow in fulfilling careers, we live our promise of Building Skills, Growing Careers by nurturing lifelong learning, strengthening employability and enabling career growth for all, including our own officers, through a continuous learning culture and a supportive, flexible, inclusive working environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and well-being.

So, join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the national SkillsFuture movement and building a strong Singaporean core. Together, we create opportunities, transform lives, and shape the future of work.
jobDescription: You will play a key role in the Strategic Planning Division as an individual contributor and/or team lead, supporting the development of SWDA’s strategic direction, policy work and organisational development efforts. This includes working across SWDA and with external stakeholders such as MOM and Whole-of-Government partners to shape strategies, review policies, monitor emerging trends, and strengthen organisational alignment and effectiveness. Your responsibilities may include the following:
jobResponsibilities:
• Drive and support strategic planning work to shape SWDA’s long-term direction and priorities
    • Develop and coordinate strategies to inform policy, programmes and initiatives across SWDA
    • Work with SWDA divisions to translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans and actionable initiatives
    • Monitor and assess emerging trends and future developments, including working with the Futures Office, to strengthen SWDA’s strategic planning
    • Work on strategic communications issues arising from SWDA’s strategic priorities, in collaboration with the Strategic Comms Division where required

  • Formulate and review policies to support the achievement of SWDA’s mission
    • Conceptualize and coordinate whole-of-government policies to advance the Jobs and Skills agenda
    • Drive and coordinate policy reviews to ensure relevance and alignment to SWDA’s strategic objectives
    • Serve as a key interface with MOM and Whole-of-Government partners on policy matters, including supporting Budget/COS and responses to Parliamentary Questions

  • Drive and support organisational development efforts to strengthen SWDA’s effectiveness
    • Support initiatives that align SWDA’s structures, processes and ways of working with its strategic directions
    • Work across divisions including corporate planning and HR to strengthen organisational alignment, improve effectiveness
    • Enhance organisational capacity to respond to internal and external challenges through planning, coordination and capability-building efforts
jobRequirements:
Knowledge/Skills

  • Excellent writing and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, and able to understand issues beyond the surface
  • Good project management and problem-solving skills
  • Have a good theoretical understanding and application of principles and concepts in labour economics
  • Have a good understanding of public governance and its principles
  • Familiarity with data governance and principles is preferred

Aptitudes/Abilities

  • Strong interpersonal skills and able to engage external and internal stakeholders
  • Perceptive and able to problem-solve and work independently
  • Resourceful and pro-active in managing work assignments
  • Comfortable to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Organised, meticulous and detail oriented with an inquisitive mind that seeks to understand beyond the surface
  • Be committed to the ethos of public service
