jobTitle: Intern - Corporate Video Development using Al
agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.
jobDescription: This role involves working on a project to develop (a) corporate video(s) using Al and (b) learning materials to guide colleagues on the processes of such video development.
jobResponsibilities: The project will first involve developing a corporate video using Al and then developing the appropriate learning materials (videos, guides, etc.) to raise awareness and educate colleagues on how they can adopt the same processes to use Al in creating their own videos.
jobRequirements: A combination of human creativity and technical knowledge of Al tools and skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills.

jobTitle: Inspection Officer, Building Resilience Group (1-Year Contract)
agencyDescription:
The Building and Construction Authority (BCA) is an agency under the Ministry of National Development, whose mission is to shape a safe, high quality, sustainable and friendly built environment. As the lead public agency, we champion transforming Singapore into a future-ready built environment.

Our people set us apart as we champion the development of a future-ready built environment for Singapore. Our people’s commitment to regulating building safety, leading and transforming the built environment and the industry, helps us to build a safe, high quality, sustainable and friendly built environment. 

Join us in our journey to transform the way we shape Singapore’s landscape.

Impactful: Champion an inclusive and sustainable built environment for people of all ages, abilities and needs.

Transformational: Lead the transformation of the built environment sector to deliver a safe, high quality, sustainable and friendly built environment.

Forward-Looking: Shape the landscape to prepare for the future of Singapore, rally the built environment sector to achieve far-reaching goals that reach beyond today and improve the living environment for Singaporeans from all walks of life.
jobDescription:
The Building and Construction Authority (BCA) champions the development of a future ready built environment for Singapore. Besides regulating building safety, we lead and transform the built environment sector in delivering a safe, high quality, sustainable and friendly built environment.

We are looking for resourceful, energetic and self-motivated individuals who are inspired to play an active role to make a difference to Singapore’s built environment.
jobResponsibilities:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team specializing in building and façade safety and compliance. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive inspections of windows and unauthorised structures, ensuring compliance with Building Control Regulations. This position requires understanding of the regulations, good communication and writing skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with various stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

Surveillance and Investigation/ Regulatory Compliance:

  • Conduct regular inspections to identify non-compliance windows and unauthorised structures.

  • Investigate complaints related to windows and unauthorised constructions and gather relevant information to assess compliance.

  • Interpret and enforce building regulations to ensure structures adhere to regulations.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of window inspections and unauthorised structures, including photographs, violation notices, and correspondence with property owners.

  • Prepare detailed reports outlining findings, compliance status, and recommended actions for regulatory bodies.

Communication/ Conflict Resolution:

  • Communicate with property owners, developers, and other stakeholders to explain regulations, address concerns, and facilitate compliance.

  • Handle property owners, seeking amicable and compliant resolutions.
jobRequirements:
• Trained in civil/structural engineering.

  • At least 2 years of relevant site experience.

  • Good command of spoken and written English

Successful candidates will be offered contract employment.

Interested applicants, please apply online.

jobTitle: Senior Manager / Manager (Emerging Technologies), Strategy and Planning Division
agencyDescription:
About the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore 
Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. It maintains an oversight of national cybersecurity functions and works with sector leads to protect Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure. CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. CSA is part of the Prime Minister’s Office and is managed by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information. For more news and information, please visit www.csa.gov.sg
jobDescription: The Emerging Technologies team develops, implements, and manages cybersecurity policies and strategies in emerging technologies (including quantum, cloud, artificial intelligence), and emerging risks, to advance and strengthen Singapore’s national cybersecurity interests.
jobResponsibilities:
As a member of the Emerging Technologies team, you will assist in the strategy and policy development for emerging technology, in support of national cybersecurity capability.  Your responsibilities will include to:

• Develop and recommend strategies, masterplans and efforts to senior management, to address the cybersecurity implications of emerging technologies, 
• Collaborate with technical and policy stakeholders in WOG, industry and international agencies to understand technology developments and risks, to inform the design and execution of cybersecurity strategies and masterplans
• Conduct research and analysis on strategic trends in emerging technologies
jobRequirements:
Requirements

You should have:
• A tertiary qualification, preferably in engineering, computer science or other technical fields 
• Experience with policy formulation and/or technology is preferred, as well as background in cybersecurity or digital security 
• Strong communication and analytical skills, both in presentations and written formats 
• Willingness to learn and take on a diverse range of work, and able to operate in ambiguous and unstructured work environments

If you share our passion to make a difference in the cyber security landscape, take up the challenge and apply now.

All applicants will be notified of whether they are shortlisted or not within four weeks of the closing date of this job posting. 

For any issues with the application, you may drop your resume with us at csa_recruit@csa.gov.sg.

jobTitle: LECTURER, BIOMEDICAL ENGINEERING - SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING
agencyDescription:
At Ngee Ann Polytechnic, our nine academic schools offer over 40 full-time diplomas to a growing student population of more than 15,000. As a public tertiary institution, internationally-recognised for its academic excellence and close industry links, NP prides itself on having a dedicated and professional teaching faculty, complete with campus facilities that are among the finest in the world.

An institution of higher learning, Ngee Ann Polytechnic believes in giving every student an enriching learning experience and every employee the opportunity to build a meaningful career.

If you are a self-starter with an innovative mind, a versatile person with the drive for all-rounded excellence, and a dedicated team player who shares our vision and values, we invite you to join our inspired team.
jobDescription: This is a 2-year contract position as a Lecturer, Biomedical Engineering in the School of Engineering.
jobResponsibilities:
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Involvement in developing curriculum, facilitating student learning, conducting assessment and performing tasks for modules related to Biomedical Engineering.

  • Spearhead and identify new opportunities and collaboration with industry.

  • Undertake administrative tasks related to course management.

  • Work on consultancy project to stay relevant in your profession.

  • Lead or support applied R&D projects in collaboration with healthcare institutions and industry partners, focusing on assistive and rehabilitative technologies, wearable health monitoring systems, diagnostic devices, AI and data analytics in healthcare, 3D printing or rapid prototyping for medical applications

  • Develop functional prototypes and demonstrators for teaching, research, and clinical validation.

  • Support student development in the area of education.
jobRequirements:
• Relevant qualification in Biomedical Engineering, with at least 3 years of relevant industry experience in the areas of engineering design and development and/or manufacturing of medical technologies, including biomedical devices. Specifically, experiences in assistive/rehabilitation technology and/or wearable monitoring devices will be advantageous.

  • Passionate about education and possess strong interest in nurturing, teaching, mentoring and interacting with students.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Self-driven, independent and possess readiness to work as a team.

agencyDescription:
Established in 2001, the Health Promotion Board’s (HPB) vision is to build a nation of healthy people.

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference?
Join us at the Forefront of Shaping Healthier Lives

The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people. Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.


You will be a part of HPB’s School Dental Service, which strives to provide oral health care services to school-going children to ensure good oral health and dental fitness.
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of the School Dental Service team, you will be setting a foundation for oral health in school-going children by providing dental examinations and diagnosis, educational talks and managing the mobile dental clinic.

You’ll also be focusing on the cleaning, scaling and polishing of teeth, application of fissure sealants, restorations of permanent and primary teeth and extractions of primary teeth under local anesthetic.

And last but not the least, you’ll be in charge of tracking and updating pupils’ clinical records and setting the standards of customer service.
jobRequirements:
Join us if you are a dynamic and self-motivated individual with a Diploma in Oral Health that can be registered with the Singapore Dental Council. You should also possess:

a) Proficiency in clinical skills

b) Effective social and communication skills

c) Effective time management, planning and organisational skills

d) Ability to establish close rapport with children, parents and school staff

e) Ability to work independently and in a team

In addition, having relevant knowledge in IT applications and skills will be an added advantage.

Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for emplacement/renewal subject to meeting criteria.

agencyDescription: At the National Parks Board (NParks), we take pride in conserving our natural heritage and enhancing green spaces for all to enjoy in our City in Nature. We have a multi-talented and highly passionate team that is driven by the goal to create a unique world-class living environment through excellence in biodiversity conservation, greenery and recreation, and veterinary care in partnership with the community. If you share our love for nature and animals, and our zest for innovation and continuous learning, we have the perfect working environment for you.
jobDescription: You will assist in tree management work, landscaping and related projects.

You will have the opportunity to learn and use modern tree inspection devices. You will also be involved in landscape design, implementation and maintenance, which include working with contractors to oversee operations such as planting, pruning, and removal of trees, shrubs and turf. You are also required to attend to greenery-related public feedback and proactively share our City-in-Nature initiatives.
jobRequirements:
• Someone who appreciates greenery, enjoys outdoor work, and has a keen interest in landscape design and maintenance

  • Area of study in Arboriculture, Horticulture, Landscape Design or Landscape Management an advantage

  • Strong interest in the flora of Singapore, especially trees and their care

  • Effective team player

Successful candidates will be offered an 11-month employment contract. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

agencyDescription: The People’s Association was set up in 1960, in a time of racial and communal strife, to foster racial harmony and social cohesion. Today, we continue to be driven by the same purpose - to build an inclusive, united and resilient Singapore.  We create spaces and opportunities for people of different backgrounds to participate and volunteer in their community. Through community participation, we connect people and deepen relationships to build communities of mutual care and trust.
jobDescription:
What the role is

You will support the Constituency Office (CO) in driving community volunteer (CV) management.

In addition, you will serve as an administrator and facilitator in the formation, development and consolidation of GROs at the constituency level, thereby promoting social cohesion, racial harmony and community bonding.

What you will be working on

Engagement with Internal and External Stakeholders
• Identify meaningful causes/ interests and volunteering opportunities of CVs (individuals/groups) across different sign-up platforms (e.g. referrals, Community Marketplace, CV Secretariat or PA units) and facilitate their engagement through existing/new projects

Partnership Management

• Map and work with the CO team to grow and cultivate CV individuals, groups/ networks at Division level
• Nurture CVs as PA advocates to fulfil PA’s People-to-People, People-to-Government or Government-to-People objectives
• Match volunteers and volunteer opportunities with internal and external stakeholders at Division level
• Share best practices with internal and external partners at suitable platforms

Marketing and Communications

• Promote the CV Scheme to increase public awareness and to obtain buy-in from current grassroots leaders and stakeholders in the Division
• Work with external partners to cross-share contents on each partner’s publicity platforms
• Curate and maintain an archive of CV stories and materials that depict the work of managing CVs
• Update calendar of local programmes which will support the overall CV marketing plan

Training and Development of CVs

• Work with other PA units and external partners to identify suitable training for (i) staff/ grassroots leaders; and (ii) CVs

Resource Planning
• Match and deploy CV-related resources within the CO (e.g. application of CV grant)
• Adhere to internal checks and controls, SOPs and templates for proper accounting, tracking and compliance

Data Management

• Submit templates to capture the data of CVs and their involvement at the Division
• Submit regular reports on CV management efforts and outcomes

What we are looking for

• Has a keen interest or experience in community work.
• Has a keen interest in current affairs, national policies and keeps updated about news in the community
• Able to write well in English. Has knowledge of Mandarin, Malay or Tamil, with the ability to speak and proofread written text
• Social media user; enjoys collaboration and networking
• Motivated Team player

(Only shortlisted candidates will be notified)
Shortlisted candidates will go through PA’s structured interview.
Successful candidates will be given a 3-year contract and deployed to the CO/CC.

jobDescription:
What the role is

You will support the Constituency Office (CO) in driving both external and internal communications. You will also be responsible for producing content for different audiences and communications channels, including social media and mainstream media. You will work in tandem with the PA HQ Communications Group to amplify PA and Whole of Government (WOG) messages through the CO’s communications networks. In addition, you will serve as an administrator and facilitator in the formation, development and consolidation of GROs at the constituency level, thereby promoting social cohesion, racial harmony and community bonding.

• Work with PAHQ and volunteers to develop and amplify content and disseminate communications materials.
• Monitor media reports and online conversations for opportunities and issues related to PA’s mission and programmes and prepare relevant reports.
• Oversee CO colleagues in the development of marketing communication materials (banners, posters, digital display panels) to ensure brand alignment as well as appropriateness of content and translation.
• Understand the demographic profile of specific groups in the local community.
• Develop programmes to engage the groups to be in tune with their sentiments and issues of concerns.
• Facilitate the formation of interest groups and local communication channels/networks to build/sustain relationships and increase community connectedness.
• Work with different partners (e.g. VWOs, educational institutions) to identify and grow local demographic-based networks in the community.
• Communicate government policies, gather feedback and channel feedback to appropriate government agencies.
• Formulate, implement and review plans for the development of GROs and the community.
• Plan and co-ordinate the recruitment, appointment and reappointment of volunteers and members of the GROs to ensure sufficient residential representation.
• Ensure proper accounting/procurement, fund utilisation and cash management of the GROs to comply with PA financial rules.

What we are looking for

• Has a keen interest or experience in communications, including social media.
• Has a keen interest in current affairs, national policies and keeps updated about news in the community.
• Able to write well in English. Has knowledge of Mandarin, Malay or Tamil, with the ability to speak and proofread written text.
• Social media user; enjoys social networking.
• Motivated Team player.

Shortlisted candidates will go through PA’s structured interview.
Successful candidates will be given a 3-year contract and deployed to CO/CC.

agencyDescription:
In Singapore, having the rule of law and advancing people’s access to justice are not just lofty ideals but the backbone of a functioning and a progressive society. At the Ministry of Law, not only do we contribute to developing the legal frameworks and policies that uphold our way of life, but also to providing community legal services that Singaporeans benefit from. The key policies we oversee include Singapore’s legal and intellectual property infrastructure, the civil and criminal justice systems as well as land resources.

Our officers are experts from different fields, and enjoy an excellent and challenging career in a fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunity to grow. If you share our vision of shaping the future of Singapore, you will definitely fit right in here at MinLaw.
jobDescription:
You will be part of the Transformation Office within MinLaw’s Strategic Planning and Policy Division. The Transformation Office coordinates and drives public sector transformation efforts within the Ministry and supports transformation, innovation and organisation development efforts in line with WOG initiatives.

We would like to invite an independent and self-motivated individual to join us in shaping and building MinLaw’s transformation journey.
jobRequirements:
*Key Competencies*

•	[Systems Thinking]: See the different levels of the system in the organisation, their interconnections and interdependencies, and applies understanding to the work performed.
•	[Change]: Assess change risk and readiness to develop and implement interventions that help officers transit through the change to achieve the intended successful outcomes
•	[Stakeholder Management]: Work with relevant stakeholders at the different levels of the system to engage them on relevant input to support the interventions for organisational change
•	[Ethics and Values]: Establish strong grounding in OD ethics and values to ensure that actions are based on professional principles and role-model them in the course of practice.
•	[Sense & Evaluate Impact]:
a)	Set indicators, and/or identify suitable output and outcome indicators (leverage prevailing resources, where appropriate), and collect data 
b)	Analyse data and evaluate effectiveness of engagement based on intended outcomes (leverage prevailing resources, where appropriate)


*Work Experience / Personal Traits*

•	Specialist in Organisational Development and/or Change Management
•	Preferably be familiar with public service transformation, innovation and organisational development work in public service sector 
•	Preferably at least 2 years of relevant work experience 
•	Be able to translate ideas into strategies and action plans. 
•	Be resourceful and able to identify and tap on, or seek resources, to implement action plans.
•	Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills 
•	Strong planning, organisational, and interpersonal skills 
•	Be a results-orientated, highly self-motivated and resilient person 
•	Enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, including tight deadlines, and be able to work independently as well as in a team/cross-team setting.

While officers are hired for specific roles within the division at the start, officers have the opportunity to work in different or multiple sections within the division, taking into consideration the officers’ competencies and development needs, as well as the needs of the division.

agency: Ministry Of Social And Family Development
agencyDescription:
Join Us at MSF for a Meaningful, People-Centric Career!

At MSF, our mission is to nurture and build resilient individuals, strong families, and a caring society. We offer meaningful and impactful people-centric careers in the design and delivery of policies, services and programmes. We are an all-inclusive and family friendly workplace where career growth is prioritised through a comprehensive suite of development opportunities to help our officers succeed today as well as be future-ready. We do this through various formal and informal learning and development programmes for officers to build different competencies and gain diverse work experiences within MSF, the Public as well as the Social Service Sectors.
jobDescription:
Manpower Policy and Planning (MPP) Division develops manpower policies in the social and early childhood (EC) sectors to support the attraction and retention of social sector manpower and enhance the capabilities of social sector professionals.  

We are looking for an individual who is a strong conceptual and analytical thinker and is interested in developing evidence-informed policies.

The role spans policy analysis, data analysis, design of strategies and schemes, stakeholder engagement, public communications, policy and scheme reviews, and will provide exposure and build experience in different stages of the policy formulation cycle.
jobResponsibilities:
•	Conceptualise the Division/Ministry’s views on matters, weighing various policy considerations and factors

•	Conduct data analyses to sharpen our understanding on matters

•	Commission or co-conduct policy research to inform manpower policies

•	Develop strategies to attract, retain and develop key professionals for the sector in areas such as salaries and working conditions

•	Develop guidelines for the social service sector

•	Review schemes for social sector professionals 

•	Take reference from national frameworks and make intelligent applications to the social service sector setting

•	Work with MSF divisions and National Council of Social Service on the implementation of strategies
jobRequirements:
•	Strong conceptual and analytical abilities which are foundational to policy thinking

•	Comfortable with data analysis, detail oriented 

•	Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

•	Able to see the interlinkages across multiple issues and appreciate different dimensions of a given issue, capable of handling complexity 

•	Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable working with people of all levels and able to build good collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

•	Previous experience in Singapore Public Service would be an advantage

•	Good understanding of Singapore’s social service sector/ landscape would be helpful

jobDescription:
Sector Strategy and Development (SSD) is a central policy directorate within the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) that oversees sector-wide policies and programmes to ensure (a) sustainable and well-planned services; (b) a competent and future-ready workforce; (c) future-ready social service agencies that deliver quality services, and (d) a well-resourced sector with active contributions from the community.

Under SSD, the Manpower Policy and Planning (MPP) division identifies sector-wide manpower challenges using analysis of manpower trends. This allows for informed policies and schemes designed to ensure sufficient and capable manpower, by building sustainable pipelines, improving attraction and retention, and strengthening capabilities of the social service workforce.

•	Oversee the manpower demand-supply projections model for key professions, including review of the parameters and assumptions used in manpower demand-supply projections to evaluate relevancy and robustness of the methodology
•	Process and transform datasets through cleaning, fusion and structuring, to refresh projections or into user-friendly data visualisations for presentation to senior management.
•	Conceptualise and develop strategies to meet sector manpower needs and optimize sector manpower through alternative manpower models and job redesign.
•	Collaborate with Institutes of Higher Learning, social service agencies and other public sector organisations to ensure sufficiency of pre-employment (PET) and continuing education and training (CET) pipelines for key professions. 
•	Assess manpower implications of new or updated services, including staffing ratios and competency requirements.
jobRequirements:
•	Background in a related discipline, with interest in the social sector. 
•	Good understanding of Singapore’s social service sector/ landscape would be an advantage.

•	Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable working with people of all levels and able to build good collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
•	Effective team player with good team and project management skills

o Plan and secure resources to ensure our community-based care programmes are accessible and have sufficient capacity to meet future demand.
o Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of existing policies and initiatives to address the needs, challenges, and aspirations of caregivers of PwDs.

The Singapore Department of Statistics is the National Statistical Authority responsible for statistics on the Singapore economy and population.

jobDescription: SENIOR/ DATA SCIENTIST
jobResponsibilities:
The Rail Digitalisation Division is a cross-functional and multi-disciplinary team set up to drive and deliver LTA’s Railway Common Data Platform (CDP), which includes data analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities to support rail performance and operational/maintenance enhancements. You will be responsible for building the "intelligence layer" of the CDP, developing systems that not only detect anomalies in complex railway time-series data but also reason about them to provide clear, actionable outcomes for maintenance and operations.

We are seeking a Data Scientist / Senior Data Scientist who excels at converting use cases into a data problem and analyzing data to generate value to support decision making. You should have a proven track record of delivering end-to-end machine learning solutions—from data discovery and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring. The ideal candidate balances deep technical expertise with a value-driven mindset, ensuring that analytical outputs directly translate to better cost efficiency and improved commuter experience. A degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is required.

Technical Skills

  • Modeling & Time-Series Analysis: Expert proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep experience in time-series forecasting and anomaly detection (e.g., Z-score, growth rate analysis, and statistical thresholds).

  • Data Engineering Synergy: Competence with modern data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and real-time data ingestion via APIs to build scalable, production-ready pipelines.

  • MLOps & Automation: Experience in managing the full ML lifecycle, focusing on "operational AI" that triggers automated workflows or maintenance alerts.

  • Visualization & UI Collaboration: Ability to translate complex model outputs into requirements for UI/UX designers to create intuitive, data-rich enterprise dashboards.

  • Decision Intelligence: Proven ability to build autonomous systems that go beyond simple detection, including experience with AI agents that combine statistical triggers with LLM-based reasoning to automatically categorise, prioritise, and/or escalate operational issues.

Key Attributes

  • Analytical Problem Solver: Strong ability to take vague operational "pain points" and structure them into rigorous analytical frameworks that drive ROI.

  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to explain algorithmic logic and "uncertainty" to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proactive Learner: A self-starter who stays updated on the latest in Agentic AI and can independently drive design initiatives end-to-end.

  • Collaborative: High comfort level working in a "squad" format alongside UI/UX designers, Product Managers, and Railway Engineers.
jobRequirements:
• Background knowledge in Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is required.

  • At least 2 years of proven relevant experience in data science, preferably with data-heavy industrial or enterprise products.

  • Experience in transportation, IoT, or large-scale condition-monitoring systems with AI agents is advantageous.

  • Those without working experience but has strong interest in quantitative fields are welcome to apply

  • Successful candidates may be expected to undertake technical assessments or case study presentations as part of the interview process.

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.
jobDescription:
The Analyst will be responsible for conducting in-depth research and analysis to drive value-based healthcare transformation including supporting the national strategy for Patient Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs). They will work in close partnership with health system stakeholders. The role focuses on translating data and evidence into actionable insights to improve healthcare delivery, inform policy decisions, and enhance the way care is delivered.

The role will support the introduction and strategic implementation of value-based healthcare including PROMs, to measure and improve healthcare delivery, policymaking, clinical outcomes and care transformation. This includes conducting research and analysis on implementation strategies, analysing healthcare data, using benchmarking to improve health outcomes sustainably, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to develop evidence-based strategies for improving patient outcomes and care quality.  

You will join a highly dynamic and mission-driven team, working alongside diverse stakeholders across the health system to design, execute and continuously refine strategies that measure what truly matters to patients. The role requires strategic foresight, strong implementation capability, and the ability to translate data and policy into actionable change on the ground.
jobResponsibilities:
1.	Lead the development and implementation of PROMs, working closely with stakeholders to ensure successful and sustainable deployment

2.	Translate national policy intentions into practical implementation plans, conducting research and analysis to optimise PROMs deployment and integration into care delivery.

3.	Provide insights and recommendations to inform strategic planning and policy development focused on improving patient outcomes.

4.	Develop and standardise outcome indicators and approaches for value-based healthcare transformation.

5.	Design and execute research studies to assess the performance, effectiveness, and efficiency of health systems and transformation initiatives.

6.	Analyse outcomes data to identify disparities, trends, and opportunities for improving the health and well-being of communities served by the healthcare organization.

7.	Develop and maintain value-based healthcare performance metrics, dashboards, and reports to monitor key indicators.

8.	Collaborate with and actively engage interdisciplinary teams including public health professionals and healthcare providers to transform the way that care is delivered by assessing and optimizing care pathways, interventions, and programmes aimed at addressing population health needs in the context of public health and healthcare policy.
jobRequirements:
Key Competencies Required:
•	Thinking Clearly & Making Sound Judgements – Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations; ability to grasp timelines, operating context and ground realities.
•	Learning & Putting Skills into Action - Possesses the drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge and new ways of working. 
•	Improving & Innovating – Ability to seek continual improvements, and to innovate and experiment while managing the risks involved. 
•	Working Effectively with Stakeholders – Ability to mobilise and rally partners and stakeholders towards a collective purpose.

Qualifications and Skills:
1.	Bachelor's or master's degree in public health, health policy, health economics, implementation science, or a related field.
2.	Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark, R) for analysing and visualising clinical and patient outcome data sets. 
3.	Able to synthesise data points and possess good sense of realities on the ground for health policy, healthcare delivery systems and PROMs.
4.	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider short- and long-term implications when translating clinical outcomes data into actionable insights and interventions.
5.	Excellent communication skills and the ability to proactively identify opportunities for collaboration with diverse stakeholders, including healthcare providers and policy teams.
6.	Relevant experience in the healthcare sector, implementation science, intelligence or strategic planning is advantageous, and will be considered favourably.

jobDescription:
About Heritage Conservation Centre, Singapore

The National Heritage Board (NHB) preserves, presents and promotes the cultural heritage of Singapore. Our vision is to make heritage as the Pride in our Past, Legacy for our Future.

The Heritage Conservation Centre (HCC) is a purpose-built facility for the storage and conservation of all artefacts under the custodianship of NHB (i.e., the National Collection), with the mission to care for, manage and facilitate access for these artefacts. To enhance the current and long-term access to the National Collection, HCC is committed towards consolidating its capabilities to care for the growing time-based media (TBM)collection, in analogue or digital format. HCC is now seeking an experienced individual to spearhead the development of the preservation and conservation of the TBM subset of the National Collection.
jobResponsibilities:
The individual will join a large team of conservators with various specialties such as paintings, objects, paper/photo, textiles alongside a small conservation science lab. The team is also involved in carrying out cross-department activities around issues pertaining to preventive conservation or to care of contemporary art/ design.

Reporting to the Senior Conservator, you will be:

  • responsible for contributing to the preservation of Singapore’s National Collection (NC) by participating in a wide range of conservation activities such as producing various condition reports and proposals, providing expert advice on the condition and future maintenance needs of proposed acquisitions and works planned for loans and exhibition, and ensuring preventive maintenance necessary for digital and media works in the NC.

  • playing an integral role in the development of conservation policies, procedures, and workflows within the HCC regarding the care of TBM collections in analogue and digital forms while likely contributing to the current HCC Contemporary Art Working Group. This includes but is not limited to supporting acquisition, developing guidelines for storage and display, best practices for conservation treatment, procedure and the proper care and handling of digital and media works of the collection;

  • conducting specialised research on the materials and techniques of artists represented in the collection whenever necessary and while working in collaboration with all relevant parties;

  • playing a leading role in advising and training HCC staff in best practices for the care, handling, display, storage, packing and shipping of digital and media works;

  • playing a fundamental role in supporting, planning and implementation for HCC digital storage and the HCC digital and media art conservation & preservation workstation and engaging as necessary in conservation and preservation-related special projects;

  • supervising conservation fellows or interns as required; and supporting the development of the professional field involved in the preservation of the cultural heritage digital form in Singapore and SEA region by actively developing &/or contributing to knowledge and expertise sharing and dissemination activities.
jobRequirements:
• Background in conservation with specialisation in time-based media or digital art preservation; or equivalent skills and knowledge acquired through specialised professional experiences.

  • Preferably at least 5 years of practical postgraduate experience working with digital and media artworks; Institutional / museum experience is preferred. Candidate with less experience may be considered for the assistant conservator level.

  • Team player, at ease with dialogue-based decision-making process and collaboration with a diverse group of HCC conservation team and stakeholders while actively developing and contributing to the collaborative effort that care and display of TBM works required.

  • Ability and experience to address the preservation needs of complex works that include film, slide, video, audio, software-based, web-based, electronic, and other types of digital art including migration strategies to a high standard with full consideration of practical and ethical issues.

  • Capable of assisting with collection care activities such as assessments for new acquisitions, facilitation of loans, securing appropriate storage, cataloguing of active and obsolete equipment and creation of installation instructions as well as dealing with the presentation and maintenance of digital and media artworks on display. Experience with complex contemporary installations is desirable.

  • Ability to use diagnostic tools to examine condition and document the construction of digital art items.

  • Familiarity and experience with cultural materials in South East Asia would be advantageous.

  • Innovative and enthusiastic team player with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, have strong oral, written and interpersonal communication skills in English.

Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract in the first instance.

jobTitle: Cybersecurity Consultant / Senior Cybersecurity Consultant (DID), CIOO
agencyDescription:

Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. jobDescription:

This involves developing dashboards and visualisations using business intelligence tools, implementing self-service analytics platforms, creating predictive models for analysis, and presenting complex data in accessible formats for various stakeholder groups.

Requirements

Leadership and Communication
•	Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple technical projects simultaneously
•	Strong stakeholder management skills with experience engaging both technical and business audiences
•	Exceptional communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to non-technical audiences
•	Experience translating business requirements into technical data solutions

Domain Knowledge
•	Understanding of cybersecurity, risk management, or related domains would be advantageous
•	Experience working in government or highly regulated environments preferred
•	Knowledge of data governance, privacy regulations, and compliance requirements

Personal Attributes
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail
•	Self-motivated individual who can work independently and drive technical initiatives forward
•	Collaborative approach with ability to work across diverse teams
•	Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with data engineering technologies

This role offers the opportunity to shape CSA's data engineering capabilities while ensuring robust data governance and security standards that support our cybersecurity operations and digital transformation initiatives. You will be part of a dynamic team that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence in delivering insights that matter.

If you share our passion to make a difference in the cybersecurity ecosystem, take up the challenge and apply now.

jobTitle: Executive/ Senior Executive, Private and Shared Mobility (Shared Mobility)
agencyDescription:
The Mission of Ministry of Transport is to develop Singapore's land, sea and air transport sectors so as to enhance our economic competitiveness and quality of life in a knowledge-based economy. MOT oversees the development and regulation of the following sectors:

• Civil Aviation and Air Transport
• Maritime and Ports
• Land Transport

Besides providing an efficient and cost-effective transportation in Singapore, it also strives to make Singapore an international civil aviation and maritime centre for the region.

The ministry sets the strategic and policy direction while operations and regulatory works are carried out by the statutory boards under its charge. There are four statutory boards which are established by Acts of Parliament: the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS), the Land Transport Authority (LTA), the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) and the Public Transport Council (PTC). The ministry also oversees the operation of the Transport Safety Investigation Bureau (TSIB).

The Intellectual Property Office of Singapore works with creators, innovators and innovative companies to catalyse the ideas of today and transform ideas into the assets of tomorrow. We leverage our deep technical, legal and business expertise to help innovative enterprises grow using their intangible assets, including IP.

The Registries of Patents, Designs and Plant Varieties supports IPOS’ vision by building and maintaining a top-ranked IP regime in the world.

About the Role
As a Senior Assistant Director in the Registries of Patents, Designs and Plant Varieties, you will play a key role in shaping Singapore’s innovation infrastructure by developing trusted, forward-looking policies, legislation and programmes for one of the world’s top-ranked IP regimes. This role offers exposure to high-impact national policy work, senior stakeholders, regional and international engagement, and leadership development through the opportunity to guide officers and build team capability.

You will work on issues at the intersection of law, technology, business and innovation, with the opportunity to influence national IP policy and legislation, contribute to Singapore’s position as a trusted hub for innovation and intangible assets, and represent Singapore in regional and international engagements. You will also lead meaningful cross-functional projects, mentor officers, and deepen your expertise in a specialised and strategically important area of public policy.

• Represent Singapore in regional and international forums, including ASEAN and the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), and build strategic relationships with overseas counterparts and stakeholders. This offers exposure
to international IP policy developments and may require overseas travel 1–3 times a year, with each trip typically not exceeding five days.
• Lead and develop a small team of officers by setting clear priorities, reviewing outputs, mentoring officers and building capabilities for higher-impact policy and programme work.

agencyDescription:
In Singapore, having the rule of law and advancing people’s access to justice are not just lofty ideals but the backbone of a functioning and a progressive society. At the Ministry of Law, not only do we contribute to developing the legal frameworks and policies that uphold our way of life, but also to providing community legal services that Singaporeans benefit from. The key policies we oversee include Singapore’s legal and intellectual property infrastructure, the civil and criminal justice systems as well as land resources.

Our officers are experts from different fields, and enjoy an excellent and challenging career in a fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunity to grow. If you share our vision of shaping the future of Singapore, you will definitely fit right in here at MinLaw.
jobDescription:
Who we are

The Legal Policy Group (LPG) in the Ministry of Law (MinLaw) plays a critical role in upholding the rule of law, advancing access to justice, and ensuring a sound and progressive legal framework for Singaporeans. 

What the role is

Under LPG, officers at the Civil & Legislative Policy Division (CLPD) do not just review laws — we play an important role in helping to shape the future of legal policy and governance in Singapore. Our team has driven reforms that touch the lives of Singaporeans every day. Some recent initiatives include:

•	Relief for victims of harassment: In 2021, we established the Protection from Harassment Court to give victims of harassment faster, more accessible and affordable relief through simplified court processes. 

•	Modernisation of laws: In 2023, we modernised our laws through legislative reforms that make it possible for statutory declarations, oaths, affirmations, and notarisations to be done through electronic means.

•	Strengthening family therapeutic justice: The Maintenance Enforcement Process (MEP) was introduced in May 2023 under the Family Justice Reform Act to improve the enforcement of maintenance orders, deter non-payment, and improve access to justice for maintenance applicants through efficient enforcement procedures and sustainable outcomes. In 2025, the Maintenance Enforcement Division was established within the Insolvency and Public Trustee's Office to administer the MEP, with Maintenance Enforcement Officers working to achieve these objectives.

•	Enhancing the management of community disputes: In 2024, we worked closely with the MND and MCCY on enhancements to our Community Disputes Management Framework. The enhancements strengthen our community mediation framework and court processes to address neighbour disputes. Government agencies also worked together to introduce a Community Relations Unit that has powers to intervene in and address serious neighbour disputes.

•	Safer online spaces for Singaporeans: In November 2025, MinLaw and MDDI passed the Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) Act. The Act strengthens online safety and protects Singaporeans from online harms. It empowers victims to seek timely relief and obtain redress through a new Online Safety Commission, and through new statutory torts that provide clear legal basis for victims of online harms to take action against those responsible for such harms. 

We are a small, multidisciplinary team that values thoughtful debate, moves with gumption, and is unafraid of breaking the mould. Officers will have the space to challenge assumptions and propose new ideas.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about making a difference, thrives on intellectual challenge, and enjoys working collaboratively in a dynamic environment — and who wants their work to have tangible, national-level impact.
jobResponsibilities:
You will join us in a variety of ongoing and upcoming policy reviews and reforms for the policy areas set out below:

•	Lead legal reform: Work with fellow officers to review laws, propose reforms and pursue new initiatives, tackling both classic and frontier issues. These include civil, family, and community justice issues, access to justice, criminal law and procedure, and more. If you ever wanted to rewrite the rulebook (legally, of course), this is your chance.

•	Drive change, turn ideas into reality: Turn complex policy challenges into tangible solutions that improve real lives — take legislation from idea to Parliament, collaborating with legislative drafters, experts, and stakeholders. Become the bridge between policy vision and practical reality.

•	Engage stakeholders: Work with stakeholders and partners to develop creative, practical solutions to issues of national significance. 

•	Drive implementation: Take an active role in implementing policy initiatives —assist with drafting subsidiary legislation, provide policy inputs on operations, and ensure that sound policy design together translates into practical execution.
jobRequirements:
Key Competencies

•	[Excellent writing skills] Able to crystallise core issues through clear and concise writing
•	[Deep critical thinking] A sharp and analytical mind capable of distilling critical issues and sense-making from a wide range of information to arrive at effective policy solutions
•	[Domain-specific expertise] Have familiarity with law reform work and/or regulatory frameworks; develop domain knowledge to collaborate and/or co-create policy solutions with experts and professionals
•	[Design for implementation and communication] Able to develop policy that factors in strategic communications considerations upfront, and has a grounded perspective of implementation considerations

Work Experience Required / Personal Traits

•	Basic law degree — Bachelor of Laws or Juris Doctor
•	A strong foundation in litigation and/or advisory work
•	Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both written and spoken
•	Self-motivation and discipline
•	Strong teamwork and ability to work with stakeholders

•	A passion to serve the public and make a difference to society
•	Senior Executive: 0 – 2 years’ PQE

•	Senior Assistant Director: 4–7 years’ PQE

Description of Group: 
Looking for a workplace with passion and commitment to empower and restore lives of the vulnerable population in Singapore? Join the Rehabilitation and Protection Group (RPG)! RPG undertakes the statutory functions in the rehabilitation of adult and youth offenders, and the protection of children and families. Our mission is to empower individuals and families to break cycles of abuse, neglect and offending. You influence and shape lives, and in the process, the future of the rehabilitation and protection landscape in Singapore. To support your professional development, you will receive comprehensive training and develop foundational capabilities and knowledge on rehabilitation and protection work. You will also be given the opportunities to rotate to different exciting roles within RPG and broaden your perspectives, skills and experiences.

Description of Division: 
As part of the RPG family, the Protective Service (PSV)/Operations (OPS) Division is dedicated to safeguarding the safety and well-being of individuals vulnerable to abuse, neglect, or exploitation—including children, vulnerable adults, and families affected by domestic violence. We provide statutory interventions and supportive services for those who have been seriously harmed or are at high risk of serious harm, ensuring timely, coordinated responses to meet their needs and uphold their protection.

Additionally, PSV/OPS plays a key role in facilitating the child adoption process, ensuring the welfare of both the child and adoptive family. PSV/OPS adopts a holistic approach through early intervention, comprehensive assessments, case management, and crisis response. Our team works in close collaboration with social service agencies, healthcare professionals, law enforcement, and community partners to identify risks, develop safety plans and provide ongoing support.

jobDescription: [LTA-T&ID] MANAGER / DEPUTY/ ASSISTANT MANAGER, DEPLOYMENT OPERATIONS
jobResponsibilities:
The Centre for Autonomous Mobility (CAM) leads Singapore’s national effort to deploy autonomous vehicles (AVs) safely and at scale. AVs will reshape how Singapore moves — across use cases spanning passenger cars, public buses and goods vehicles. In the Deployment Ops team, you take each AV deployment from plan to operating service – owning the programme schedule, driving delivery across workstreams, and managing the operators, developers, infrastructure stakeholders, to ensure AVs are deployed smoothly.

Responsibilities

Plan and manage each deployment programme

  • Work with operators and developers to evaluate, review and fine-tune service routes and concepts of operations.
  • Build and own the programme plan, schedule and milestones for each AV deployment, tracking progress against baseline and reporting status.
  • Identify risks, dependencies and bottleneck early, to develop mitigation plans to keep deployments on track.
  • Align deployment operational plans with longer-term AV deployment strategy and transport plans, so that AV services improve overall transport connectivity.

Drive deployment operations on the ground

  • Run deployments end to end — from planning through AV applications, vehicle approvals, testing and service launch — keeping multiple workstreams on tight timelines.
  • Work with industry and technology partners to resolve issues quickly and get vehicles tested and deployed on schedule.
  • Oversee operational readiness and develop standard operating procedures for the smooth running of AV services once launched – monitor performance, surface issues, manage incidents, and drive continuous improvement.

Coordinate across stakeholders

  • Bring together industry players, operators, government agencies and internal teams, aligning their requirements, securing their support, and resolving operational issues.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications, industry media teams and CAM’s Engagement team to align public announcements and high-signature events around key deployment milestones.

Communicate deployment progress to leadership

  • Prepare clear progress reports on deployment plans, and statuses for senior management, including distilling complex operational detail into clear recommendations.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge preferably in Engineering or a related field
  • Has a strong programme or project management track record — preferably at least 2 years planning and delivering medium-to-large-scale projects or programmes.
  • Organised and meticulous — comfortable owning detailed plans, tracking progress against baseline, and keeping many moving parts on schedule while working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Works well across stakeholders — listens, builds alignment across cross-functional teams and external partners, and drives to outcomes independently while having the right instincts to know when to escalate for decision-making.
  • Communicates clearly — writes and reports well, with an eye for detail.
  • Takes initiative and stays calm in ambiguity — AV deployment is new ground, so plans will change and you’ll help shape them.
  • Hands-on programme management and project planning.
  • Experience in operations management, contracts or vendor management.

  • As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and /or undergo further assessment.

agencyDescription:
About the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore 
Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. It maintains an oversight of national cybersecurity functions and works with sector leads to protect Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure. CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. CSA is part of the Prime Minister’s Office and is managed by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information. For more news and information, please visit www.csa.gov.sg
jobDescription:
The Operations Policy and Plans Office (OPPO) serves as the National Cyber Resilience (NCR) Cluster's central planning and coordination office, responsible for shaping how Singapore prepares for, coordinates and responds to cyber threats. OPPO works across CSA, government agencies and industry stakeholders to drive national-level cyber operations, develop new operational concepts and policies, and strengthen Singapore's cyber defence capabilities.

As part of OPPO, the Operations Policy and Plans Officer will help shape the future of Singapore's cyber defence by developing operational policies, plans and frameworks, coordinating cybersecurity operations, and driving initiatives that strengthen the nation's resilience against evolving cyber threats.

The role sits at the intersection of technology, operations and policy, requiring the officer to tackle complex cybersecurity challenges through a combination of strategic thinking, operational planning and stakeholder engagement. The officer will work closely with cross-functional teams across CSA and government to develop and implement new approaches to cyber defence, influence national-level capabilities and preparedness, and contribute to the transformation of how cyber operations are conducted.
jobResponsibilities:
• Operations Policy and Planning. Develop cyber operations policies, concepts of operations, standards and plans to strengthen Singapore's cyber resilience. Assess emerging cyber threats and identify improvements to Singapore's cyber defence capabilities and preparedness.

• Operations Coordination and Implementation. Coordinate national-level cyber operations across CSA, government agencies and key stakeholders. Develop and implement operational plans, support major cyber operations, campaigns and incidents, align resources against operational priorities, and provide timely assessments and reporting to support decision-making by senior leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination. Coordinate stakeholders across CSA, government agencies and industry partners to support national cyber operations and resilience efforts. Support key operational forums and working groups, monitor the implementation of decisions, and drive collaboration across stakeholders to achieve operational objectives.

• Cyber Defence Transformation. Strengthen Singapore's cyber defence capabilities and drive improvements in how cyber operations are conducted. Develop and implement policy initiatives and new technologies to strengthen the national cyber ecosystem, including the adoption of AI-enabled tools, automation and other innovative approaches to cyber defence.

• Team Leadership (for senior officers). Provide guidance and mentorship to junior officers. Maintain awareness of significant cybersecurity developments and ensure appropriate planning and coordination measures are put in place when required.
jobRequirements:
•	Relevant degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, public policy, economics or equivalent.
•	Interest in working across technology, operations and policy to address complex cybersecurity challenges.
•	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, oral and written communication skills, including the ability to distil complex technical and operational issues into clear reports, assessments, strategy papers and briefing materials for decision-makers.
•	Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and internal/external stakeholders.
•	Professional cybersecurity certifications are preferred but not mandatory.

BPA Responsibilities: -

  • As a first point of contact with Donors at our blood collection centres, handle enquires, assist with next appointment bookings, and manage feedback accordingly.
  • Perform registration duties which include registering donor for donation and phlebotomy linking.
  • Conduct haemoglobin testing and capping which includes taking blood for haemoglobin test, explaining to donor on deferral if required, checking, sorting blood bags and sample tubes before passing it to the laboratory.
  • Support blood collection team with necessary Operational Admin follow up duties.

SBPA Responsibilities: -

  • Those with limited exposure to Phlebotomy will assist with the following blood collection support processes while undergoing training;
  • Assist phlebotomist in Whole Blood (collection of blood in its complete form, not separated into its various components) pre and post donation procedure which includes blood bag preparation, bandaging and stripping of blood bags
  • Support Apheresis (an automated process where plasma, platelets or red cells in the blood drawn is separated and remaining components are returned to donor during the donation process) pre & post donation which includes registering donors and test tubes preparation
  • Conduct capping which includes taking blood for haemoglobin test, explaining to donor on deferral if required, checking, sorting blood bags and sample tubes before passing it to the laboratory

Requirements: -

  • Applicants with recognised Phlebotomy skills and/or 2 year or more of working experience in similar settings will be considered for SBPA positions

Our Blood banks operate 6 days a week*, between 9am – 8pm*

MPA is the driving force behind Singapore's port and maritime development, taking on the roles of Port Authority, Port Regulator, Port Planner, IMC Champion, and National Maritime Representative.

jobDescription:
MPA is seeking a candidate to be part of the newly formed Integrated Operations Capability within the Operations Transformation & Planning Division (OTPD) under the Ops-Tech Cluster.
The OTPD supports MPA’s mission by ensuring that policies, plans, and procedures are operationally ready to address crisis scenarios as well as ensure port security and maritime safety. OTPD is also entrusted with developing future operating concepts in the multi-domain (space, air, sea, sub-sea and cyber) areas of operations and translating them into operational requirements for the purpose of capability development in MPA.
Crisis scenarios include severe events caused by geopolitical risks, pandemics, natural disasters, and climate change effects, as well as major incidents such as piracies, vessel collisions and sinkings, oil/fuel/chemical spills etc. which could cause disruptions to the global supply chain and negatively impact port security and maritime safety.
To ensure that Maritime Singapore is well-prepared for crisis scenarios, there is a critical need to strengthen and future-proof our operational responses and safeguard Singapore’s national and maritime interests. The complexity of such crises necessitates capability development and collaboration across multiple domains in the assigned area of operations. Future operating concepts must leverage capabilities and sensors across multiple domains in order to ensure effective and timely response in a crisis.

You are responsible to support the development of MPA’s maritime multi-domain capabilities and innovation strategies. You will need to understand and provide solutions to integrate the systems across domains such as space, air drones, surface, subsea and cyber. Core objective is to integrate across various domains and utilise technological solutions and innovations to achieve comprehensive shared maritime awareness via an interconnected data-driven eco-system; enabling MPA to direct and coordinate with agencies and industry partners for resource optimization, carbon emission reduction, productivity and safety.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Lead the initiatives to conceptualize, plan, develop, implement and manage integrated operation hub that possesses Maritime AI and Digital Twins systems for pervasive maritime awareness.

  • Conduct feasibility studies and analysis to identify how emerging technologies can be leveraged to enhance systems and products with future-ready capabilities such as optimised resource planning, automated decision making, anomaly detection and delivery of unified responses for maritime incidents

  • Enable comprehensive understanding and monitoring of vitality of marine environment with the implementation of operational forecast system for maritime and port applications.

  • Enable MPA to direct and coordinate with agencies and industry partners for resource optimization, carbon emission reduction, productivity and safety.

  • Responsible for project management, infrastructure and system design, deployment, and operations of the integrated operation hub.

  • Knowledge and experience on geospatial systems, satellite and terrestrial communications, radars, Unmanned systems, underwater technologies and/or cyber capabilities will be an added advantage.

  • Relevant work experience, preferably in ICT Operational Systems. Experience in database, Security Information and Event Management, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing and cloud security will be an added advantage.

  • Preferably have knowledge of command & control system, video management system, and/or IT application systems.

  • Preferably possess crisis leadership, project management and/or system management skills.

Job Description

IMDA is spearheading Singapore’s drive to be a world leading Digital Economy. IMDA aims to empower our companies and workforce with digital technologies and enable Singapore to be a leading Digital Economy.

We are currently seeking a Modelling and Simulation Lead with a focus on End-to-End Systems to join our team and help us analyse the performance of enterprise applications across various communication networks. You will play a crucial role in modelling and simulating the performance of enterprise applications, including industrial applications, across communication networks such as mobile, wired, and quantum networks. Your expertise in end-to-end system modelling and simulation techniques will ensure a thorough understanding of application performance metrics, such as response time, latency, and error rates. The successful candidate is a strategic and analytic thinker who also enjoys understanding new and emerging technologies.

Join us in our journey and jointly architect Singapore’s digital future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a small team of 1 or 2 members specializing in end-to-end system modelling and simulation for enterprise and industrial applications.
  • Develop and utilize modelling and simulation tools to analyse the performance of various communication networks, including mobile, wired, and quantum networks/internet.
  • Conduct scenario analysis and simulations to assess application response time, latency, estimated error rates, and other performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, researchers, and industry partners to understand the requirements and constraints of various communication networks.
  • Identify potential bottlenecks, inefficiencies, or areas for improvement in end-to-end systems and propose solutions to optimize performance.
  • Stay current with advances in communication technologies, end-to-end system modelling, and simulation tools to contribute to the development of new techniques and methodologies.
  • Prepare technical documentation and present project updates to stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and leadership to junior team members.
  • Collaborate with whole of government teams, industry and academic partners to develop strategies on developing emerging technologies.
  • Work in a cross-functional teams to develop strategy, implementation design and plan for nationwide communications infrastructure solutions.
  • Stakeholder management of internal and external stakeholders and to write think pieces on technology use and technology fundamentals to non-technical audience.

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • At least 7 years of experience working on end-to-end system modelling and simulation projects, with a focus on enterprise and industrial applications.
  • In-depth understanding of various communication networks, including mobile, wired, and quantum networks/internet.
  • Proficiency in end-to-end system modelling and simulation tools, such as OPNET, NS-3, QuNetSim, or similar.
  • Strong leadership skills, with experience managing small teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

agencyDescription:
The Internal Security Department (ISD) confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 75 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists.

At the heart of our work are the collection of intelligence that enables us to size up the threats to Singapore’s internal security, and taking the executive actions necessary to overcome those threats. Every day, we collect and analyse intelligence, make impartial assessments, and take decisive action to counter the threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability, and sovereignty.
