jobDescription:
The Finance Associate Programme (FAP) is AGD’s flagship management associate programme designed to groom talent pipeline for Public Sector Finance.  Associates on the programme will be rotated systematically to acquire strong foundations in key domain areas of finance, operations and policy formulation across the Whole-Of-Government. 

Fresh graduates joining AGD under the FAP (General) track will be developed and given exposure to different finance functions to allow them to acquire necessary competencies which will accelerate their career development as they take on leadership responsibilities early in their career.

The FAP (General) track aims to develop Finance Professionals to take on apex C-Suite Finance and Governance positions across Public Service agencies.

Read more about the Finance Associate Programme here: https://www.agd.gov.sg/careers-at-agd/finance-associates-programme/
jobResponsibilities:
You will be involved in developing financial systems and policies, driving the adoption of financial analytics across the Whole-of-Government, transforming business processes, preparing financial budgets and reports, managing Government's liquidity, internal audit, reviewing internal controls and evaluating Government's programmes. 

You will also get the opportunity to undergo postings in different ministries and agencies and be involved in different aspects of public finance. Associates are expected to participate in AGD-wide projects to build their knowledge in Public Sector Finance.

agency: Ministry Of Social And Family Development
agencyDescription:

jobDescription: The Rehabilitation, Protection and Residential Care (RPR) Division is part of the Rehabilitation and Social Mobility Policy Directorate of the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF). RPR plays a pivotal role to develop and review policies, strategies and legislation that address the unique needs and challenges faced by vulnerable groups through evidence-based research, community engagement and collaboration with stakeholders. RPR is also the Secretariat for the Inter-Ministry Committee which monitors and implements our obligations as a State Party to the United Nations Conventions on the Rights of the Child. Our goal is to create a society with opportunities for all to succeed.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of a dynamic team that drives evidence-based policy formulation, decision making and uplift the division’s analytical capabilities. 

You will be working on:

(i)	Planning and Prioritisation: Work with policy team to identify problem statements and analytical priorities; coordinate and develop the research and analytics agenda for RPR to inform policy and legislative reviews that support MSF’s strategic outcomes 
(ii)	Research and Analytics: Conduct research and analytics to generate insights into trends, drivers and intervention outcomes. Work with academics, consultants and various stakeholders on selected projects, including development of reports, to inform key decision makers and public on our work on supporting vulnerable groups in Singapore 
(iii)	Data Support: Support RPR’s business units in data requests to meet policy/strategy needs, including ensuring data quality and cleanliness
jobRequirements:

jobTitle: Senior / Researcher (Economics), Research & Strategy Management Division
agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.
jobDescription: We would like to invite interested applicants to apply for the position of a Senior / Researcher (Economics) in the Research and Strategy Management Division (RSM) at the Ministry of National Development (MND). As part of a dynamic and multi-disciplinary research team, you will contribute to wider policy and planning efforts to ensure that Singapore remains An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City.
jobResponsibilities:
You will undertake economic research, using theory and empirical methods to deliver timely and incisive analytical insights that inform MND’s housing policies, and land use planning and development efforts. The increasingly complex nature of research questions will also require you to work closely with dedicated researchers that straddle the social sciences and data science. To this end, your role will entail the following:

•	Conceptualise, design, and execute research that informs policy and planning. This will involve primary data gathering (e.g. stated preference surveys), secondary data analysis using various empirical methods (e.g. econometrics/ quasi-experiment methods for causal analysis, structural estimation, time series, and machine-learning algorithms), and developing and managing platforms, such as recurring surveys and dashboarding tools. 

•	Conduct think pieces that thoroughly examine housing-related topics to inform policy and planning. This will involve applying economic theories to real-world scenarios to explain market dynamics and policy mechanisms, challenge existing assumptions and offer new perspectives, as well as identify societal implications and propose feasible policies/ solutions. 

•	Synthesise and present research insights to Policy Divisions and Senior Management. This will involve making sense of diverse data points and sources and where necessary, draw upon economic and behavioural theories, as well as academic and policy research, to meet practical policy and planning needs.

•	Engage colleagues and stakeholders to support research and non-research work in MND and the Government. This will involve building relationships with other divisions and agencies, and academia, and meeting administrative and functional needs in RSM and MND, such as secretariat duties.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for applicants with the following traits:

•	At least a good bachelor’s or graduate degree in Economics; additional knowledge in relevant fields would be advantageous (e.g. Statistics and Data Science).
•	Strong interest in housing-related research, and ability to think creatively on how data can be used to inform policy.
•	Proficiency in econometrics required for carrying out complex data analysis (e.g. regression analysis and various policy evaluation methods).
•	Experience and ability to utilise data analytics tools to prepare and analyse data (e.g. R or Python).
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including translating and presenting research findings to address policy and planning needs.
•	Proactive, curious, resourceful, with good attention to detail; able to work independently and collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary team and manage diverse stakeholders.

jobDescription:
[What the role is]

1. Oversee compilation, analysis and reporting of key tourism statistics, ensuring that communication of tourism performance outcomes and delivery of insights are done in a timely manner.
2. Translate data and research into actionable and meaningful insights that would guide both internal teams and external industry stakeholders, with the objective of driving data-driven decision making across the organisation.
3. Liaise and coordinate with information agencies across Whole-of-Government (WOG).
4. Fulfilment of analytics deliverables and where applicable, data partnerships with external stakeholders.
jobResponsibilities:
[What you will be working on]

1. Lead, manage and drive data cleaning, exploration, ingestion, compilation and analysis to derive insights and support business outcomes related to STB’s key tourism performance measures including Visitor Arrivals, Tourism Receipts, Hotels Stats.

2. Direct and coordinate data collection and analytics strategies, analysis of data collected from both quantitative and qualitative methods to come up with evidence-based insights that will help drive business outcomes. This includes performing data wrangling and transformation to prepare raw data into analysis-ready formats, manage data ingestion, applying statistical/analytical methods to extract insights from data, utilising data visualisation tools to communicate findings effectively.

3. Deliver tourism performance insights to stakeholders.

4. Monitor and lead a team on regular reporting, publications and data requests from stakeholders and maintain key databases from which analysis is drawn from.

5. Oversee all aspects of project management, ranging from contract and vendor management to end-to-end data operations, including fulfilling data custodian role of ensuring good quality data, developing and/or enhancing existing datasets and dashboards.

6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as product managers, data scientists/engineers and business stakeholders, to integrate and deploy models and dashboards into analytics platforms.

7. Provide data advisory support to internal (within STB) and external (WOG, industry) stakeholders as relevant. This may include the assessment of economic contributions from major tourism projects.

8. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather intelligence on emerging issues and provide actionable insights.

9. Provide effective leadership and guidance to the analytics team in the areas of operational data analytics including data manipulation to extract insights, synthesis of results and ensuring data accuracy and alignment with organisational outcomes and communicating the findings to stakeholders.

10. Grow a high-performance analytics team.
jobRequirements:
[What we are looking for]

a) Trained in Data Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative discipline

b) A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, interpretation and visualisation, with at least 3 years’ experience in leading teams.

c) Strong foundational knowledge of data analytics methodologies and analytics skills, with a good eye for detail and possess an aptitude/experience in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches.

d) Good mastery of market research methodologies.

e) Advantageous if you have experience in research applications in a client-side context.

f) Working knowledge in statistical modelling and forecasting.

g) Proven track record and hands on experience in integrating and synthesising research and data across multiple sources to derive meaningful conclusions.

h) Proven track record in engaging different groups of stakeholders (within and outside of the organisation).

i) Fluency in data manipulation to extract insights, strategic direction and narrative, forecasting and project future visitor demand.

j) Strong business orientation with the ability to connect understanding from data to key business outcomes.

k) Strong presentation skills and ability to communicate complex data/ concepts and outcomes of analysis to business users.

l) Mature and comfortable presenting to and interacting with people from senior management levels.

m) Strong organisation, project and time management skills

n)Possess statistical knowledge and comfortable working with large datasets.

o) Proficient in usage of analytics tools e.g. R, SQL, Python.

p) Highly self-motivated, able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines, adapt to and lead a team effectively in dynamic situations.

q) Meticulous, detail-oriented and able to work independently.

r) English written and verbal fluency required.

s) Proven ability to influence without authority.

t) Creativity and willingness to advocate new approaches.

u) Passion for learning new technologies/ tools.

v) Understanding of economic impact and cost benefit assessment is a plus.

jobDescription:
[What the role is]

STB takes a data-driven approach in tourism planning and marketing, and at the heart of it is Stan (Singapore Tourism Analytics Network, Stan), a tourism data analytics platform that allows both internal STB users and external tourism industry stakeholders to access tourism data and derive actionable insights about Singapore's tourism landscape and visitors.

As Data and AI Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the data product roadmap for STB and its industry stakeholders to drive tourism growth. You'll be at the forefront of leveraging data and AI to transform Singapore's tourism industry, not just defining what needs to be built, but getting hands-on to prove it works before it scales. Success in this position means delivering data and AI-enabled products that measurably enhance tourism decision-making capabilities, with demonstrated user adoption, stakeholder satisfaction, and measurable business impact on Singapore's tourism sector.

This role sits within the newly established Data Exploration and Partnerships department, reporting directly to the Head of Department, and works closely with line units across Singapore Tourism Board, government agencies, and industry partners to drive data-driven decision-making and insights generation in tourism.
jobResponsibilities:
[What you will be working on]

As a Data and AI Product Manager, your key responsibilities include:

1. Data Products Roadmap Development, Planning and Execution:

a) Develop and execute the data product roadmap, defining data products required by STB and industry stakeholders, and aligned with STB's organisational goals.

b) Create and maintain comprehensive data products requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and test cases.

c) Develop mock and/or POC dashboards and datasets, to support requirements specifications and acceptance criteria.

d) Work with Stan product team to plan and implement the data products onto Stan.

e) Support testing and production verification as part of productisation process.

f) Lead product launches and go-to-market plans for major releases of data products.

g) Drive innovation in data products, constantly seeking ways to enhance value for stakeholders.

h) Proactively identify opportunities for new data products or features based on industry trends and stakeholder needs.

2. AI Roadmap, Use Cases and Proof-of-Concept Development

a) Ideate and develop the AI roadmap for STB's data platforms, identifying high-value AI use cases that enhance data accessibility and user productivity for internal and industry stakeholders.

b) Prioritise AI roadmap items using sound evaluation frameworks that weigh feasibility, impact, and implementation readiness.

c) Lead hands-on development of AI proof-of-concepts, starting with natural language query (NLQ) for conversational access to STB's datasets and analytics.

d) Design evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and test cases for AI features, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and appropriateness before productisation.

e) Identify and shape AI use cases in close collaboration with line units, translating domain needs into technically grounded AI applications.

f) Work closely with the product implementation team to ensure AI PoCs are documented and specified to a standard that enables direct handover for productisation.

g) Stay current on applied AI developments relevant to data platforms, analytics, and public sector use cases.

3. Requirements Gathering and Product Design:

a) Conduct deep dives into business scenarios, use cases, user journey mapping as part of data and AI product solution design.

b) Translate complex stakeholder needs into clear, actionable product requirements and specifications.

c) Collaborate with Data Partnerships and Stan product team to ensure product feasibility and technical alignment.

d) As part of data and AI product design and specifications, review the end-to-end processes involved in implementing and maintaining the data products, ensure processes are streamlined and efficient.

e) Leverage digital and automation tools where possible as part of the end-to-end process design i.e. WOG tools like FormSG and Plumber to automate data collection and simple data validation checks.

4. Data Governance and Quality Management for Industry-facing data domains:

a) Ensure adherence to data governance policies for data integrity, security, and compliance.

b) Support data quality management processes, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data products as part of productisation process.

c) Apply appropriate guardrails and evaluation criteria to AI features to ensure outputs meet governance and quality standards.

5. Stakeholder Management and Communication:

a) Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across STB line units, government agencies, and industry partners, with varying levels of data and tech maturity.

b)Translate complex data and AI concepts into clear, structured communications for non-technical stakeholders, facilitating understanding and buy-in.

c) Drive alignment and clarity across stakeholders, ensuring well-defined problem statements, expectations, and outcomes.

d) Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment between product development, business needs, and technical capabilities.

e) Facilitate structured discussions and decision-making, especially in ambiguous or exploratory problem spaces.

6. Analytics, Experimentation and Continuous Improvement:

a) Support data pilots in identifying and solving complex data-related problems, applying critical thinking and analytical skills.

b) Support data pilots in advanced analytics, data integration and data wrangling needs.

c) Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for data products implemented.

d) Analyze usage pattern, stakeholder feedback and performance metrics to inform continuous improvement.
jobRequirements:
[What we are looking for]

The ideal candidate is formally trained in Business, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with at least 3–5 years of experience in data product management, data engineering, or related roles with a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions.

Essential Skills and Knowledge

-Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear, actionable components, and navigate uncertainty with confidence.

-Experience evaluating pilot projects and experimental initiatives for scalability and productisation potential.

-Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data quality management, and regulatory compliance requirements.

We engage with a diverse range of professional services firms - including accounting, consulting, marketing, engineering services, legal, and risk management, among others - to support their establishment and expansion in Singapore. • Civil Aviation and Air Transport
• Maritime and Ports
• Land Transport

We are looking for talented Software Engineers to build digital products that enhance organizational effectiveness and drive workforce productivity. You’ll be part of a product team using cloud-native technologies to deliver robust, scalable enterprise applications.

Our product teams build web applications using cloud-native technologies and enterprise COTS/platform integration to deliver feature-rich applications to achieve better efficiency, effectiveness and employee experience for the organisation. Our teams adopt an agile delivery approach with a focus on building products by taking a user centered design.

As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain software applications. You’ll collaborate with teams to deliver quality features, write clean code, and apply best practices. You’ll also stay current with new technologies to improve development processes.
jobResponsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy software applications using modern web technology stack
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable and reliable technical solutions
• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code
• Actively contribute to iterative sprint cycles by participating in peer code reviews, engaging with users, and proactively resolving issues
• Implement CI/CD pipelines and contribute to automation efforts
• Ensure application observability through proper logging, metrics, and monitoring instrumentation
• Contribute to the technical community by sharing best practices, publishing internal tech blogs, leading knowledge-sharing sessions, or mentoring peers across engineering teams
jobRequirements:
• Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
• Strong foundation in programming languages, data structures, and software design patterns
• Familiarity with modern software development tools (e.g. Cloud technologies, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git) and frameworks (e.g. Spring Boot, React)
• Experience with relational (e.g. MSSQL), and NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB) and observability tooling and frameworks (e.g. OpenTelemetry)
• Proficiency in Python and experience with Elasticsearch is a plus
• Experience with integrating Generative AI capabilities and using AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot is an advantage

Note: Suitable candidates that possess and demonstrate relevant working experience could be considered for senior software engineer position.

As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.

jobDescription:
Our product teams build robust web applications and data platforms to equip users with the ability to be more analytical and efficient in their critical decision-making and operations. We develop a wide spectrum of systems from interactive visualisation tools (charting, relationships, geospatial, etc), to complex data platforms, to intelligent search engines. In addition to delivering feature-rich systems, our teams focus on building systems for humans by emphasing user experiences and automation. We believe in technology as a critical enabler to allow organisations to achieve more.

We are looking for a designer who excels in distilling complex user workflows and crafting coherent experiences, to lead the design of new and existing products.

What we offer / Culture
• As an early member of our design team, you will have strong influence over how our design culture grows.
• You will also get to define how enterprise-type SAAS applications can balance function and form, whilst working with a team of product managers and engineers also passionate about bringing our products to the next level.
• The work you do here will impact Singapore’s national security needs, and be based on cutting-edge digital technologies.
• At CSIT, we approach work with professionalism, a high bar for excellence, and a sense of humour whilst keeping sane working hours.
• We believe strongly in innovation and teamwork, and that ideas can come from bottom up. Integrity is core to our identity.
jobResponsibilities:
• Solving complex interaction problems, humanise product ideas and develop these into elegant application design 
• Own the end-to-end design process, in close partnership with product managers and engineers, to create and rapidly iterate on concepts through design exploration, ideation and user validation
• Drive appropriate user research activities such as discovery interviews, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, post-launch feedback, metrics review, and the translation of research insights into actionable recommendations
• Balance between the practicalities of user requirements and business needs
• Align the execution of design with the rest of the product and design organisation
• Present design solutions to stakeholders, defend design decisions and incorporate feedback into the design cycle
• Build design capabilities amongst product team members, through collaboration, storytelling, and digital evangelism
jobRequirements:
• Background in disciplines related to digital product design or development.
• Minimum 5+ years of professional experience designing solutions for software applications
• Strong command of information architecture, interaction design, and visual design, and with a mind for simplicity of design
• Proven expertise turning complex business problems into simple and engaging design concepts
• Proactive self-starter, and capable of communicating and prototyping interactions at all levels of resolution
• Familiarity with modern digital design tools (e.g. Sketch, Figma)
• Good awareness of software development processes and frontend development technologies

Requirements (Preferred qualifications)
• Background in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Prior experience helping others grow in design proficiency will be an added advantage

We know that applying to a new role takes a lot of time and effort. To facilitate the process, a link to your professional portfolio, showcasing a few functional designs that you have developed, is required as part of your application. Please do detail your role and involvement in these projects. There will be no take-home design exercises – only an on-site whiteboarding session with members from the product team.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of collaboration technology, driving advancements in digital collaboration systems, content sharing and real-time communication, while ensuring seamless user experiences and platform reliability.

If you're passionate about harnessing technology to transform the way employees work together, we would love to hear from you.

jobDescription:
This role sits within the Connectivity, Cybersecurity & Resilience Group
(C2R) Group. C2R strengthens the cybersecurity and resilience posture of
the telecommunication and media sectors in Singapore.
The Group keeps Singapore’s digital connectivity secure,
trusted, and robust against an evolving and increasingly
complex threat landscape.
jobResponsibilities:
• Conceptualise, design and deliver end-to-end Penetration Testing programmes to proactively identify and address security vulnerabilities across IMDA's digital infrastructure.
  • Research attacker Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs) to continuously enhance existing penetration testing techniques, procedures and tools, ensuring assessments remain relevant against the latest threat landscape.
  • Participate in and plan attack scenarios for cyber security exercises, simulating real-world adversarial conditions to test and improve organisational readiness and incident response capabilities.
  • Perform Penetration Testing in close coordination with asset owners, ensuring assessments are conducted in a controlled and responsible manner with minimal disruption to operations.
  • Draft comprehensive reports and present findings, recommendations and remediation strategies clearly to both technical teams and senior stakeholders.
jobRequirements:
• Background in Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science or an equivalent discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on work experience in information security, with demonstrated experience in penetration testing or offensive security roles.
  • Possession of OSCP certification or equivalent industry-recognised offensive security certification.
  • Experience in networks and cloud technologies would be a distinct advantage, particularly in the context of emerging technologies such as 5G.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a passion for tackling complex cybersecurity challenges and staying ahead of the evolving threat landscape.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will be gazetted as a Commercial Affairs Officer with criminal investigative powers under the MAS-CAD Joint Investigation Arrangement, where you will exercise comprehensive criminal investigative powers, including searching premises, seizures of evidence and effecting arrests during raid operations.

As financial crimes are often complex and multi-faceted, you would be working closely with fellow investigation officers, and other specialists within the Enforcement Department such as market surveillance analysts, computer forensic specialists, legal officers, as well as officers from the Commercial Affairs Department, market experts/professionals and Deputy Public Prosecutors from the Attorney-General's Chambers.

Reporting to the Head of AI Security & Safety, you will act as the technical builder and operator, responsible for engineering, integrating, and deploying AI security products (e.g., LLM guardrails, vulnerability scanners) into enterprise environments.

This role will also include applying tools for supporting the automation and execution of testing, evaluation, validation, and verification lifecycle for AI models. The scope of tests includes rigorous adversarial robustness testing and systematic benchmarking to provide critical assurance to various stakeholders that deployed AI systems remain safe, reliable, and resilient against evolving threats. You will bridge the gap between AI innovation and enterprise security engineering, ensuring AI applications are "Secure by Design".

•	AI Model Test, Evaluate, Validate, Verify: Design and conduct systematic tests to evaluate AI model safety, security, and performance. This includes researching and applying various security/safety test domains, industry benchmarks, and advanced evaluation methodologies (e.g., benchmark based evaluations, LLM-as-a-Judge, etc).
•	Adversarial Robustness Testing: Conduct targeted adversarial testing (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion) on in-house and commercial AI models to identify vulnerabilities and edge-case failures, directly contributing towards and supporting the CISO office's risk assessment processes.
•	Product Engineering & Integration: Design, develop, and integrate AI security tools (e.g., input/ output guardrails, real-time monitoring sidecars) into existing AI inference pipelines and API gateways.
•	Enterprise Deployment: Deploy and manage AI security solutions across both Cloud (e.g., Government Commercial Cloud - GCC) and On-Premise containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), while pushing the frontier of complex trade-off between ensuring high availability, low latency, and security.
•	DevSecOps for AI: Automate TEVV workflows and integrate AI vulnerability scanners and benchmarking tools into the organization’s CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous security testing.
•	Threat Mitigation: Work closely with application developers, data scientists, project managers, and cloud engineers to understand use cases translating into design and implementation of robust mitigating controls and secure configurations across the end-to-end AI lifecycle (pre-training, fine-tuning, RAG, and inference).

•	Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years in Software Engineering, DevSecOps, AI/ Machine Learning Engineering, or Cybersecurity.
•	AI Testing & Evaluation: Good understanding of AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarking datasets, and methodologies for qualitatively and quantitatively measuring model performance and safety (e.g., LLM-as-a-Judge, automated test case generation).
•	Software Engineering: Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building and consuming APIs securely.
•	Cloud & Containerization: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and deploying workloads in both Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCC) and On-Premise environments.
•	AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with the AI development lifecycle, ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), and LLM inference engines (e.g., vLLM, HuggingFace).
•	Cybersecurity Expertise: Knowledge of AI-specific threat frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS) and traditional application security principles.
•	Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications in Cloud, DevSecOps, AI/ Machine Learning, or Cybersecurity.

o	Ability to multi-task and deliver high-quality engineering work under tight deadlines.
o	Meticulous in planning, test design, documentation, and system architecture.
o	A strong team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., application developers, data scientists, governance teams).
o	Demonstrates resiliency, drive, and a continuous learning mindset to keep pace with the rapidly evolving AI threat landscape.

Climate change is one of the defining issues of our time. It is a complex global challenge that calls for concerted international action and collaboration between governments, industry and individuals. As a low-lying city state, Singapore is particularly vulnerable to the effects of climate change and has a strong interest in shaping effective global climate action. 

The Green Economy and Sustainability (GES) team sits within MTI’s International Trade Division, which is charged with formulating Singapore’s foreign economic policy and advancing Singapore’s economic interests in the internationally. The GES team leads Singapore’s international economic engagement on green trade issues. We also work closely with agencies, such as MSE, MOF, NEA and PMO(NCCS), to formulate and coordinate strategies to chart the path forward for Singapore’s transition to a low-carbon economy.
jobResponsibilities:
As a TIER officer in the International Trade (GES) Division in the Ministry of Trade and Industry, you will be part of a high-performing team operating at the forefront of international economic diplomacy and climate policy, shaping the rules and frameworks that will define the global green economy. You will work on one or more of the following work streams: 

a.	Negotiation of Article 6.2 bilateral/plurilateral agreements. Develop and implement strategies and policies to strengthen bilateral cooperation with like-minded countries on carbon credits aligned with Article 6 of the Paris Agreement. Officer will negotiate binding bilateral and plurilateral agreements with foreign governments, drive technical cooperation initiatives, and build robust project development pipelines — directly contributing to Singapore's ability to meet its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC).

b.	Global carbon market rules and standards setting. Monitor and analyse evolving global carbon market developments and develop strategies to actively shape the international rules and standards that govern high-integrity carbon markets, positioning Singapore as a credible and influential voice in this space.

c.	Green trade policy development. Synthesise geopolitical, trade, and climate trends to craft Singapore's green trade policy agenda, safeguarding the country's long-term economic competitiveness through the low-carbon transition. The officer’s work will directly inform how Singapore positions itself in an increasingly climate-conscious global trading environment.

d.	Green trade instruments negotiation. Negotiate international instruments across multilateral, plurilateral, and bilateral fronts to advance Singapore's green trade interests. Officer will work with Ministries across the government to tackle complex, cross-cutting issues spanning environmental goods, services and investments, trade-related climate measures (TrCMs), environmental attribute certificates (EACs), and sectoral areas such as sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and green buildings.


e.	Multilateral negotiations. Represent Singapore at the highest levels of international climate diplomacy, including at the UNFCCC Conference of the Parties (COP). You will advocate for Singapore's green economy and low-carbon interests, building coalitions and influencing outcomes that have real-world consequences for global climate action.

As the climate space is fast evolving, an officer may be deployed across different workstreams, based on the officer’s development and MTI’s organisational needs.

People: Our team invests in building human capital. jobTitle: SCDF Fire and Rescue Officer (Direct-Entry Lieutenant)
agencyDescription:
The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is a uniformed organisation under the purview of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The main role of SCDF is to provide fire-fighting, rescue and emergency ambulance services; mitigating hazardous materials incidents, as well as formulate, implement and enforce regulations on fire safety and civil defence shelter matters.

In 1982, the National Civil Defence Plan was launched which spearheaded the emergency preparedness for the nation. With the enactment of the Civil Defence Act in 1986, the SCDF was established as an independent organisation under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). In the same year, the Hotel New World collapse paved the way for joint operations between the SCDF and Singapore Fire Service (SFS). Due to the similarity in roles and functions, the SCDF and SFS were formally integrated on 15 April 1989.

Over the years, the SCDF has improved its life saving operations through innovations and programmes to enhance her fire-fighting, rescue capabilities and public education plans. The Light Fire Attack Vehicle (The Red Rhino) and Tracked Fire-Fighting Vehicle are some of the customized solutions which the force has developed to increase its operational capabilities. The SCDF also actively engages the local community through its wide-ranging public educational programmes and community-based activities to enhance the resilience and emergency preparedness of the civilian population.

Today, the Force is recognised by the population as a professional body of well-trained officers and men geared to respond to all types of life-threatening emergencies round-the-clock. An operationally ready SCDF, working hand-in-hand with a prepared and resilient population, helps to ensure that the nation is capable of handling any untoward eventualities.

We are an elite team of emergency response professionals from the Fire and Rescue Service (FRS) and Emergency Medical Service (EMS), dedicated to saving lives and protecting property. jobResponsibilities:

You will be involved in policy development and implementation to keep Singapore a safe and emergency-ready nation.

We believe in grooming our officers as leaders. Through our talent management programme, you will embark on diverse foundational postings before specialising in your unique career pathway. Mentorships, varied job exposure, and opportunities to participate in overseas missions and international learning exchanges will help nurture your strengths and prime you for real-life challenges.

Upon joining SCDF, you can look forward to securing stable full-time employment with an attractive remuneration package. Candidates can earn between $5,821 - $6,997, inclusive of monthly frontline allowances.

jobDescription:
[What the role is]

You are the technical engine of our data exploration efforts. In the fast-paced world of tourism, new data opportunities emerge constantly, but their true value is often locked away. Your mission is to be the key that unlocks it.

This role is the technical counterpart to our Data Partnership Managers, forming a dynamic duo to accelerate our data pilots. While the Partnership Manager defines the business problem/opportunity and secures the data, you will deep-dive into the data - to wrangle the data, test hypotheses, and build compelling proof-of-concept dashboards and analyses. You are the "technical expert" in our "tech sales" model.

Success in this position means rapidly transforming raw, messy data from new data pilots and data partnerships into tangible, high-impact prototypes that showcase the possibilities and maximum potential we can achieve with our data. You will deliver the evidence and initial insights that determine which data pilots graduate to become scaled, industry-wide data products.

This contract role sits within the Data Exploration and Partnerships (DXP) department. We are looking for a data practitioner who is passionate in data exploration, experimentation, and moving quickly to create tangible impact.
jobResponsibilities:
[What you will be working on]

Technical Design & Feasibility Assessment:

  • Partner with Data Partnership Managers in later-stage discussions with potential data partners to finalise the scope and specifications of data exchange.

  • Act as the technical expert, assessing the quality, structure, and feasibility of using STB’s and our partner's data.

  • Help translate business problems into specific, testable analytical questions.

Hands-on Data Analysis & Prototyping:

  • Take the lead on the entire technical pilot process: data ingestion, cleaning, and transformation of new and diverse datasets.

  • Perform advanced exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Python to uncover hidden patterns, correlations, and insights that go beyond basic reporting.

  • Apply statistical methods to test hypotheses with rigour and build simple predictive models where applicable.

  • Lead technical discovery and experimentation, defining your own hypotheses and analytical approaches to uncover the most valuable insights.

  • Design and build compelling, interactive proof-of-concept dashboards (using tools like AWS QuickSight) that answer business questions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Insight Generation & Storytelling:

  • Synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, concise insights and recommendations.

  • Collaborate with the Data Partnership Manager to present pilot findings back to internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating the value of the data collaboration.

  • Where possible and relevant, stretch the data pilots to include predictive and prescriptive insight.

Knowledge Transfer & Scaling Preparation:

  • Meticulously document the data sources, cleaning logic, analytical methodologies, and code for successful pilots.

  • Create a "recipe book" for each successful pilot that enables a smooth handover to the Data & AI Product Manager for evaluation and potential productisation onto our core Data and Analytics platform, STAN.
jobRequirements:
[What we are looking for]

Technical and Analytics skills:

  • Trained in a quantitative field such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or Economics.

  • At least 3 years of demonstrable, hands-on experience in exploratory data analysis, data ingestion, transformation (cleaning, aggregation), and data modeling using large, real-world datasets.

  • Strong proficiency in statistical programming (e.g., Python) and database scripting (SQL) is essential.

  • Proven ability to develop compelling data visualizations and dashboards. Experience with tools like AWS QuickSight is highly advantageous.

  • Solid applied statistical knowledge (e.g., regression, classification, significance testing).

  • A portfolio of projects (e.g., via GitHub, a personal website, or a slide deck) showcasing your hands-on data analysis and coding work is required.

Work Approach:

  • Collaborative Partner: A strong team player who sees yourself as the technical counterpart to our business-facing managers. You are comfortable owning your technical workstream end-to-end while working closely with others to achieve a shared goal.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: A self-starter who thrives in an environment where priorities evolve and the path isn't always clear. You can take a vague business problem and messy data, and proactively find a path forward without waiting for instructions.

  • Accountable & Driven: Balance creativity and exploration with discipline and follow-through. You take ownership of your projects, manage your timelines effectively, and are responsible for communicating progress and challenges clearly.

  • The Pragmatic Storyteller: Strong analytical skills with a good eye for detail, but you also know how to translate complex technical findings into clear, concise language that a business audience can understand and act upon.

  • A Continuous Learner: Humble and curious, open to feedback, new techniques, and better ways of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

jobDescription: Lecturer (Architectural Technology & Building Services) / School of Engineering
jobResponsibilities:
• Design, develop and deliver industry-relevant curriculum, courseware and e-learning for full-time and part-time programmes, incorporating innovative and sustainable practices to strengthen integration across architectural, mechanical and electrical disciplines.
  • Lead and supervise student projects, work-based learning and internships to enhance industry exposure and build practical competencies aligned with sector needs.
  • Collaborate with industry partners to support student projects and internships, fostering applied learning and strengthening engagement in Built Environment innovation and sustainability.
  • Support academic administration, committee work, outreach initiatives and local or overseas study trips to enhance programme quality and student experience.

jobRequirements:

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in green or sustainable Built Environment projects.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in building performance simulation for environmental impact analysis, energy efficiency and occupant well-being.
  • Relevant experience in the application of Building Information Modelling (BIM) for integrated project delivery, coordination and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation and technical documentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with students, industry partners and stakeholders.
  • Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and adapt to evolving academic and industry requirements.
  • Demonstrated passion for education, with a commitment to mentoring, coaching and engaging meaningfully with learners.
  • Postgraduate qualifications in sustainability, Built Environment, engineering, project management or related disciplines (preferred).
  • Professional certifications such as GMAP, LEED AP, WELL AP, EDGE Expert or GRI Certified Sustainability Professional (preferred).
  • Certifications or demonstrated expertise in Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud or other industry-recognised BIM/CDE platforms (preferred).
  • Experience in innovation-driven or sustainability-focused projects within the Built Environment sector.

jobTitle: SCDF Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) - 3 Year Contract
agencyDescription:
The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is a uniformed organisation under the purview of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The main role of SCDF is to provide fire-fighting, rescue and emergency ambulance services; mitigating hazardous materials incidents, as well as formulate, implement and enforce regulations on fire safety and civil defence shelter matters.

In 1982, the National Civil Defence Plan was launched which spearheaded the emergency preparedness for the nation. With the enactment of the Civil Defence Act in 1986, the SCDF was established as an independent organisation under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). In the same year, the Hotel New World collapse paved the way for joint operations between the SCDF and Singapore Fire Service (SFS). Due to the similarity in roles and functions, the SCDF and SFS were formally integrated on 15 April 1989.

Over the years, the SCDF has improved its life saving operations through innovations and programmes to enhance her fire-fighting, rescue capabilities and public education plans. The Light Fire Attack Vehicle (The Red Rhino) and Tracked Fire-Fighting Vehicle are some of the customized solutions which the force has developed to increase its operational capabilities. The SCDF also actively engages the local community through its wide-ranging public educational programmes and community-based activities to enhance the resilience and emergency preparedness of the civilian population.

Today, the Force is recognised by the population as a professional body of well-trained officers and men geared to respond to all types of life-threatening emergencies round-the-clock. An operationally ready SCDF, working hand-in-hand with a prepared and resilient population, helps to ensure that the nation is capable of handling any untoward eventualities.
jobDescription:
The 3-Year Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) contract position with the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) presents an exceptional opportunity for individuals seeking to gain invaluable medical experience as part of the esteemed Life Saving Force. This role offers an exclusive pathway for passionate individuals to immerse themselves in frontline emergency response scenarios.

Applicants who hold a valid Class 3 Driving License, coupled with academic credentials such as ‘N’-Levels,  'O' Levels, NITEC, Higher NITEC, or Diploma qualifications, and aspire to contribute to the Lifesaving Force upon graduation, will find the 3-Year EMT position to be an attractive proposition. This career trajectory allows individuals to concurrently engage in meaningful work, earn a competitive salary, and delve into the realm of life-saving endeavours.

Upon joining the SCDF, officers can expect to secure stable full-time employment accompanied by a compelling remuneration package. This package encompasses a potential base monthly salary ranging from approximately $2,940 - $4,370, augmented by supplementary allowances and bonuses.

As valued members of SCDF, employees stand to benefit from a range of perks and privileges, including:
•	Competitive salary range, inclusive of frontline / shift allowance
•	Annual Increments
•	Performance Bonuses
•	14 to 18 Days of Vacation Leave
•	Medical and Dental Subsidies
•	Employee Welfare Benefits
•	Group Insurance Coverage
•	Vocational Section Commander Certification
•	Emergency Medical Technician Certification
•	Emergency Vehicle Ambulance Driving Certification

Successful applicants will receive a $6,000 sign-on bonus (subject to eligibility), with officers also having the chance to secure full-time employment and an additional $24,000 sign-on bonus  (subject to eligibility) upon emplacement as a Fire and Rescue Specialist or Paramedic Specialist.

Embracing this role not only offers professional growth opportunities but also enables individuals to make a tangible difference in emergency medical care provision. Join us in safeguarding lives and property, while embarking on a fulfilling career journey with SCDF.
jobResponsibilities:
Officers enrolled in this course will join the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) as an Emergency Medical Technician-Driver, entrusted with the vital mission of preserving lives and property in diverse emergency scenarios while operating ambulances. Within this capacity, their duties entail swift response to medical incidents and other rescue operations, leveraging their training to deploy essential medical procedures and administer aid to individuals in distress.

Embracing a role within SCDF not only signifies a commitment to community service but also presents a profound opportunity to contribute significantly by safeguarding lives and property amid emergencies.

As a 3-Year EMT Contract Officer, individuals can anticipate a structured career trajectory that encompasses rigorous training in Vocational Section Commander and Emergency Medical Technical skills. Upon successful completion of these training modules, officers will be stationed at a designated fire station. For further insights into your career progression, please refer to our corporate website for EMT Contract Officers.
jobRequirements:
The eligibility criteria for the 3-Year EMT Contract role include: 
•	Applicants with NS obligations must be medically classified as PES C2 or above
•	Possesses a valid Class 3/3A Driving License with more than 1 year of validity, as successful applicants will be required to drive an ambulance that requires either a Class 3 or 3A license.
•	GCE 'N' Level and above

agencyDescription:
Championing Human Potential for a Thriving Singapore
Singaporeans are at the heart of what we do. The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) empowers our people and fosters a thriving, inclusive workforce that drives Singapore's growth and prosperity. By working closely with our tripartite partners, industry and community stakeholders, we strive to create workforce and workplace policies that foster resilience, adaptability, and a bright future for a thriving Singapore. 

As an MOM officer, you will be part of this meaningful mission, contributing across diverse and impactful areas - from shaping forward-looking and effective manpower policies and strengthening industrial relations, to enhancing workplace safety standards and ensuring balanced local and foreign workforce regulations. Here at MOM, we are committed to creating an inclusive experience not just for our national workforce, but also for our officers who work tirelessly to champion human potential for a thriving Singapore.
jobDescription:
MOM’s Work Pass Division (WPD) is modernising its Work Permit (WP) eServices (known as WINS-WP) to deliver reliable, adaptive, and user-friendly eServices that streamlines WP transactions for our customers. The WINS-WP Policy & Planning Office (WPPO) drives this modernisation effort through formulating a transformation roadmap, conducting thorough business process reviews (BPRs), and driving change management.

As a member of the WPPO team, you will play a key role in shaping and transforming the service delivery of Singapore’s Work Permit policies. Working at the intersection of policy, operations and systems, you will lead complex business process reviews and ground-up policy reviews to support the development of the WINS-WP system. You will also conduct engagements and prepare communications materials to ensure that users are well-equipped to navigate the changes. This role is critical in ensuring that WP workflows are robust, future-ready and user-centric, while remaining aligned with policy intent and operational realities.

The roles offers:
•	Meaningful work that contributes directly to national workforce and manpower outcomes
•	Opportunities to work on large-scale policy and digital transformation initiatives
•	Exposure to cross-divisional and cross-agency collaboration
•	A professional environment that values learning, initiative and teamwork
jobResponsibilities:
•	Chart out the WINS-WP transformation journey by contributing to transformation roadmaps, defining user journeys, and shaping success metrics from a business and policy perspective.
•	Conduct complex Work Permit Business Process Reviews (BPRs), re-examining end-to-end workflows, challenging legacy practices, and designing streamlined “to-be” processes.
•	Work closely with MOM policy divisions and operational teams to carry out ground-up policy reviews, translating policy intent into workable operational and system designs.
•	Engage internal and external stakeholders, including system and technology teams and other government agencies, to assess impacts, manage trade-offs, and adjust to changes arising from process and policy changes.
jobRequirements:
•	At least 2 years of working experience is preferred
•	Experience in policy, strategic planning, business process improvement, or operational transformation portfolios, or familiarity with work pass processes and foreign worker policies will be advantageous
•	Strategic thinker with the ability to challenge the status quo while balancing policy objectives, operational feasibility and user experience
•	Good interpersonal and communication skills, and ability to work across agencies and diverse stakeholders to reach mutually beneficial outcomes
•	Strong time management skills, including the ability to adapt, manage multiple projects simultaneously and work under pressure to meet tight timelines
•	Candidates with no working experience are welcome to apply

*PwDs are welcome to apply

agencyDescription:

Our technical focus areas include Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure and Services. We conduct applied research and develop customised digital solutions to support national missions such as cyber defence and counter-terrorism.
 
Please visit our website (https://www.csit.gov.sg/) for more info on what we do, for scholarship/internship/career opportunities and more!
jobDescription: As a product engineer in the Investigation Product and Platform team, you will be instrumental in driving the development and delivery of innovative digital solutions that enhance national security operations. Working within an agile, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with product managers, UX designers, software engineers, and mission stakeholders to understand user challenges and operational requirements. Your role involves translating these insights into scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications that modernize investigative workflows, integrate advanced technologies for information analysis and dissemination, and enable faster, more accurate decision-making. You will directly contribute to mission success in a dynamic environment that values innovation, collaboration, and real-world impact.
jobResponsibilities:
• Collaborate with diverse stakeholders to gain a deep understanding of user challenges and operational requirements, and leverage these insights to design and develop intuitive, user-friendly solutions that drive effective outcomes.
• Design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications using industry-standard full-stack technologies and frameworks (such as React, Spring Boot, and Kubernetes) to improve operational efficiency and optimize user workflows.
• Design, develop, and deploy scalable data processing systems using industry-standard technologies and frameworks to ingest, transform and enrich datasets with high performance and reliability.
• Design and implement APIs to facilitate seamless communication between frontend applications and backend microservices, databases, and in-house systems.
• Leverage and integrate frontier AI models into web applications and data systems, building robust pipelines to optimize complex user workflows and drive productivity.
• Provide ongoing support and maintenance for production software systems, ensuring reliability, resolving issues promptly, and implementing updates to optimize performance and stability.
• Opportunity to explore and leverage cutting-edge AI tools across the software development lifecycle to enhance coding efficiency, automate testing, improve debugging, and accelerate delivery.
jobRequirements:
• Background in computer science, software engineering, information technology or related fields.
• At least 3 years of experience in software engineering for Senior Engineer
• Proficient in Java, Python and Javascript/Typescript.
• Proficient in at least one of the following frameworks: React, Spring Boot.

Nice-to-haves:
Familiar with database concepts, queries and optimisation techniques.
Familiar with DevOps and SRE concepts.
Good understanding of Linux/Unix environment.
Experience in working on Cloud environment eg. Google, AWS, Azure.

As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.

jobTitle: Assistant Director/Senior Assistant Director (Standards and Practice Innovation)
agency: Ministry Of Social And Family Development
agencyDescription:

At MSF, our mission is to nurture and build resilient individuals, strong families, and a caring society. Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. It maintains an oversight of national cybersecurity functions and works with sector leads to protect Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure. CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. CSA is part of the Prime Minister’s Office and is managed by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information. For more news and information, please visit www.csa.gov.sg
jobDescription: We are seeking a Cybersecurity Consultant to conduct horizon scanning and AI security assessments. The successful candidate will participate in assessing new security and threat developments in the AI landscape, conduct security assessment of AI, and participate in Whole-of-Government (WoG) forums to provide technical advice on AI security risks, mitigation strategies, and best practices. This role requires a good understanding of AI technologies, cybersecurity principles, and risk management methodologies. The Consultant will also collaborate with other government agencies and industry partners to develop coordinated approaches to AI security challenges, while staying at the forefront of global AI security trends and regulatory developments.
jobResponsibilities:
Responsibilities

•	Developing methodologies for assessing security risks of AI systems and designing robust security architectures for AI systems 
•	Conducting hands-on security testing and assessments of AI systems and components, identifying vulnerabilities and potential attack vectors
•	Developing technical guidance for the secure adoption of AI technologies, providing recommendations to de-risk AI adoption for government agencies, critical information infrastructures Owners and enterprises.
•	Collaborating with cross-functional teams, government agencies and industry partners through developing and implementing coordinated approaches to address AI security challenges.
jobRequirements:
Requirements
•	Relevant qualifications and experience in cybersecurity and AI security (e.g., ML, GenAI, Agentic AI).
•	Possession of a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
•	Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, SANS) and knowledge in security testing methodologies 
•	Working knowledge of threat modelling and threat risk assessments to identify attack paths and exploitation opportunities across AI systems and technologies
•	Provide practical cybersecurity guidance and engineering capabilities to support stakeholders in securing critical systems and emerging technologies
•	Good knowledge and hands-on experience of AI technologies (e.g., ML, GenAI, Agentic AI), including neural networks, deep learning, and reinforcement learning.
•	Familiarity with relevant AI security frameworks and standards (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, OWASP).
•	Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills
•	Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Possess experience working in cross-functional and interdisciplinary teams.

If you share our passion to make a difference in the cybersecurity ecosystem, take up the challenge and apply now.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

For any issues with the application, you may drop your resume with us at csa_recruit@csa.gov.sg.

jobTitle: [LTA-ITCD] LEAD / PRINCIPAL / SENIOR CYBER THREAT INTEL ANALYST

jobDescription: [LTA-ITCD] LEAD / PRINCIPAL / SENIOR CYBER THREAT INTEL ANALYST
jobResponsibilities:
The Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for identifying, tracking, and analysing emerging cyber threats, with a focus on protecting critical IT/OT systems in the land transportation sector. This role goes beyond passive news consumption and emphasises active threat research, transforming global threat data into localised, actionable monitoring strategies and detection logic.

Key Responsibilities

  • Intelligence Programme Development: Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Threat Intelligence (TI) function, including the implementation of of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and CTI solution for intelligence collection, analysis, and dissemination.
  • Threat Research & Actor Tracking : Conduct proactive research into the Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) of threat actors, with particular focus on the Asia‑Pacific region and Industrial Control Systems (ICS).
  • Monitoring List Management : Curate, validate, and maintain high‑fidelity monitoring lists, including Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), for ingestion into SIEM, EDR, and Network Traffic Analysis tools.
  • Detection Engineering Support : Translate research findings into technical detection artefacts, such as YARA, Sigma, or Snort rules, to strengthen proactive threat hunting and detection capabilities.
  • Incident Response Integration : Act as the Tier- 3 intelligence lead during critical incidents, providing real‑time threat context, infrastructure pivoting, and attribution support to the CERT team.
  • Vulnerability Intelligence : Monitor and prioritise newly disclosed CVEs based on the organisation’s technology stack, providing actionable, risk‑based assessments to patching and infrastructure teams.
  • TTP Mapping : Map observed adversary behaviours to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to identify visibility gaps and areas for improvement in existing security controls.
  • Stakeholder Reporting : Produce high‑quality intelligence report/ update (including Flash Alerts) for emerging or imminent threats and monthly strategic summaries for management and public transport operators.

Technical Skills & Competencies

  • OSINT & Investigation - Strong capability in conducting open‑source investigations across surface, deep, and dark web sources, including forums, code repositories, and social media, to identify leaked credentials or planned threat campaigns.
  • Automation - Proficiency in scripting to build custom scrapers, automate Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) workflows, and manage large‑scale intelligence datasets.
  • Log Analysis - Ability to correlate threat intelligence with internal telemetry (e.g. proxy, firewall, EDR logs) to validate malicious activity and identify early indicators of compromise.
  • Framework Knowledge - Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis, and Cyber Kill Chain.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 4 years in Threat Intelligence, Advanced SOC Operations, or Incident Response roles.
  • Education - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Certifications - GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI) or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Desired Technical Certifications - Relevant technical certifications such as GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA) or GIAC Reverse Engineering Malware (GREM) would be advantageous.
  • Demonstrated track record in mentoring junior analysts and uplifting SOC/CERT capabilities.
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership and executive stakeholders on complex cyber risk matters.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross‑matrix environment, as well as independently and decisively in a fast‑paced, high‑impact operational setting.

agency: Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore
agencyDescription: The Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (“CCS”) administers and enforces the Competition Act 2004 and the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003, to guard against anti-competitive activities and unfair trade practices. Additionally, CCS ensures that businesses observe fair trade measurement practices by administering the Weights and Measures Act 1975, and ensures the supply of safe consumer goods by enforcing and implementing the Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act 1975 and its associated Regulations.
jobDescription:
The Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCS) administers and enforces Singapore’s competition, consumer protection and legal metrology laws. Amongst various things, CCS conducts investigations and takes enforcement action in appropriate cases, whilst providing effective advice to the Government and public authorities on national needs and policies in competition, consumer protection and legal metrology matters. 

(Interested Applicants, please include a cover letter and your education qualification certificates and transcripts in your application)
jobResponsibilities:
You will assist in the Commission's administration and enforcement of the Competition Act against cartels, dominant companies that abuse their position and mergers which substantially lessen competition. You will also be involved in the administration and enforcement of the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act, the Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act, and the Weights and Measures Act. In this regard, you will play an important role in protecting consumer interests and ensuring fair trading practices, consumer product safety, and a reliable system of weights and measures in Singapore.   

Your work will include conducting investigations and interviews, participating in dawn raids, gathering field intelligence, assessing notifications (including mergers), working on policy and law reform matters relating to competition law and consumer protection law, and representing the Commission in the Courts and Tribunals, as required. You will also be part of the Commission's team of lawyers, working on policy matters and initiatives, providing legal advice on wide-ranging issues, and assisting to vet and draft contracts. 

Appointment and remuneration will be based on relevant experience and post-qualification experience (“PQE").
jobRequirements:
•	A recognized law degree, with preferably at least 2-3 years PQE
•	Called to the Singapore Bar (preferred)
•	Applicants with no experience but have keen interest in Competition Law and Consumer Protection Law are welcome to apply
•	A background in Enforcement, Investigation, Prosecution, Litigation, or Economics will be an advantage
•	Strong communication, teamwork and interpersonal skills
•	Fresh graduates may apply

agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
agencyDescription:
"The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) was established on 2 February 1996, with the mission to develop Singapore as a premier global hub port and international maritime centre (IMC), and to advance and safeguard Singapore's strategic maritime interests.

MPA is the driving force behind Singapore's port and maritime development, taking on the roles of Port Authority, Port Regulator, Port Planner, IMC Champion, and National Maritime Representative.

MPA partners the industry and other agencies to enhance safety, security and environmental protection in our port waters, facilitate port operations and growth, expand the cluster of maritime ancillary services, and promote maritime R&D and manpower development."
jobDescription: The officer plays a key role towards the Whole-of-Government approach to detect and deter maritime security (MARSEC) threats in the Port of Singapore and Singapore Territorial Water (STW). This is particularly important as Singapore is strategically located at the convergence of key shipping routes around the world, with up to 70% of the world’s global maritime economy transiting through the Singapore Straits. Maritime Security is important to safeguard Singapore’s strategic maritime interest and maintains Singapore’s status as the premier hub port as well as the international maritime centre.
jobResponsibilities:
As a MPA representative, the officer will be seconded to Singapore Maritime Crisis Centre (SMCC) full time and serve as a subject matter expert for shipping industry developments, commercial shipping practices, and national and international regulations governing the shipping industry. Working closely with stakeholders, the officer is required to provide insights on maritime security and regulatory matters to support sharper sense-making to plan for a successful maritime operation. The officer will also be the key liaison between MPA departments and the seconded agency to ensure cross-agency initiatives are well communicated and executed. The officer will be required to support the conduct of exercises and workshops as well as training sessions/ visits/ seminars to enhance the Maritime organisation’s awareness and knowledge of the shipping industry.

Other operational duties can also include :

• Representing MPA on maritime security issues with other government agencies at various committees, working groups, and taking turns to perform secretariat function for these working groups etc

• Part of the planning and execution team for the Whole-of-Government (WoG) maritime security operations for key coastal events, where the officer is required to be the MPA Liaison Officer and perform duties during these Maritime operations to ensure the security of major national events, which may fall on weekends and public holidays.

• Performing Duty Officer duties (12hrs duty both day and night shift at the Command Centre) on an average of 4 times per month to manage incidents and ensure smooth operations
jobRequirements:
• Strong analytical, writing, communication and interpersonal skills, as well as able to work efficiently in teams

• Highly driven, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities

• Good knowledge of the shipping/ marine industry, with prior experience in this industry would be an advantage

• Candidate with working experience in related security functions in the military or national security agencies as well as good understanding of the National Maritime Security System framework will have an advantage.

• Candidate's job title at Singapore Maritime Crisis Centre (SMCC) will be in accordance with SMCC's job title framework.

• Upon the completion of the 2-year contract, suitable candidate may have the opportunity to work in other Divisions within MPA or may have their contract extended further.

jobDescription: MANAGER, GIS SOLUTION & ADOPTION
jobResponsibilities:
We are looking for an experienced GIS professional to lead the standardisation and adoption of GIS solutions across LTA's engineering functions. In this role, you will work closely with engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify opportunities where GIS can add value, and develop reusable solutions that can be scaled across the organisation. You will also play a key outreach and enablement role — helping teams discover, adopt, and get the most out of GIS capabilities.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing a thorough understanding of engineering workflows and processes across the organisation, building a clear picture of functional needs and priority pain points.
  • Defining and maintaining a structured framework of GIS use cases organised by common workflows, user groups, and data needs — mapping existing solutions against this framework to identify gaps, duplication, and opportunities for standardisation.
  • Designing and maintaining reusable GIS templates and solution frameworks, including for areas not yet served by existing tools, and assessing enterprise systems and platforms to ensure GIS solutions are fit for purpose.
  • Creating clear, task-based user guides and quick-start materials to help non-expert users get up and running with reusable templates.
  • Planning and leading outreach initiatives across Groups to showcase GIS capabilities, gather feedback, and drive uptake — including facilitating workshops and clinics to support users, address technical queries, and foster knowledge sharing.
  • Continuously scanning for opportunities to broaden the application of GIS across the organisation, translating these into proposed pilots, standards, or roadmap items.
jobRequirements:
• At least 10 years of experience in GIS, geospatial solutions, or related fields, with a demonstrated track record of delivering solutions for engineering, infrastructure, utilities, or asset management contexts.
  • Strong ability to elicit requirements from users, understand end-to-end workflows, and translate them into practical, scalable solutions — from prototype through to full rollout.
  • Hands-on experience creating reusable GIS assets such as templates, data models, map and app patterns, symbology standards, and reference architectures.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise applications and data platforms — such as EAM/CMMS, document management systems, BIM/CAD tools, and data lakes — and how GIS integrates with them.
  • Ability to produce clear, accessible documentation for diverse audiences including engineers, planners, and operational teams.
  • Experience designing and delivering workshops, training, or enablement programmes to drive adoption and build user capability.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate alignment and influence outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.
  • A proactive and strategic mindset — with the ability to spot opportunities, prioritise value, and drive continuous improvement through well-designed standards and reusable solutions.

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and /or undergo further assessment.
